jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (DevOps - Kubernetes)
jobs.description:
Den Haag* 
* Hbo bachelor
* 32 \- 36 uur
* Schaal 11 / €4\.132 \- €6\.275 (bruto)
* ICT

  
Solliciteer voor 2 oktober 2026
  
**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


Als systemen stilvallen, merkt iedereen het. Jij zorgt dat het zover niet komt.


Als Senior Operations Engineer (DevOps) bij Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) in Den Haag werk je aan digitale dienstverlening die dag en nacht beschikbaar moet zijn. Je kijkt verder dan incidenten en richt je op structurele verbetering.


Jouw rol
  

Als Senior Operations Engineer ben je onderdeel van een DevOps\-team en werk je aan het componentenlandschap (.NET) of het Openshift\-landschap, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. De verschillen in technologie en werkwijze zorgen voor inhoudelijke variatie en vragen om een brede blik op zowel applicatie\- als platformvraagstukken.


Binnen het Scrumteam werk je met refinements, planningen en reviews. De werkzaamheden zijn backlog\-gedreven en worden ondersteund door tooling zoals Jira. Tegelijk beweeg je je binnen een bredere, programmatische context waarin meerdere teams, ketens en stakeholders samenwerken.


Jouw focus ligt op het borgen en verbeteren van stabiliteit en performance van applicaties. Je automatiseert processen, optimaliseert CI/CD\-straten en zorgt dat deployments voorspelbaar en schaalbaar worden. Hierbij vormen technologieën zoals Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, Git en cloud\-native tooling vormen de basis, vaak in combinatie met GitOps\-oplossingen zoals ArgoCD. Daarbij kijk je kritisch naar bestaande oplossingen en draag je actief bij aan verbetering.


Als senior lever je niet alleen een inhoudelijke bijdrage, maar speel je ook een rol in kennisdeling en het verder brengen van collega’s en het team als geheel. Je werkt in een omgeving waarin wet\- en regelgeving en een politiek\-bestuurlijke context een belangrijke rol spelen. Dit vraagt om zorgvuldige afwegingen en het kunnen onderbouwen van keuzes.


Binnen DUO is Nederlands de voertaal in de dagelijkse samenwerking, documentatie en (delen van) de codebase.


Dit krijg je
  

Je krijgt de ruimte om richting te geven aan techniek en werkwijze binnen een complexe IT\-omgeving.


Daarnaast:
  

* Hybride werken met standplaats Den Haag
* Veel autonomie en verantwoordelijkheid
* Werken met moderne technologie en grootschalige systemen
* Samenwerking met ervaren engineers in een professionele omgeving

  
**Dit krijg je**
----------------


* Schaal 11
  

€4\.132 \- €6\.275 (bruto)
* Arbeidsovereenkomst voor onbepaalde tijd
* 32 \- 36 uur
* Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur.

  
**Dit bieden we nog meer**
--------------------------


Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je jouw werk goed met jouw privéleven kunt combineren. Diverse verlofregelingen, zoals ouderschapsverlof, en flexibele werktijden dragen bij aan een goede balans. Daarnaast bieden we je ook andere aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals:


* een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) van 16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris, voor bijvoorbeeld de aflossing van je studieschuld, een (elektrische) fiets inclusief accessoires, verduurzaming van je woning, extra verlof of andere fiscaalvriendelijke doelen
* omruilen van belangrijke feestdagen zonder dat je daar een vrije dag voor hoeft op te nemen
* volledige vergoeding van je ov\-reiskosten. Reis je met de auto? Dan geldt een kilometervergoeding
* een pensioenregeling bij ABP
* studiemogelijkheden voor je ontwikkeling
* de mogelijkheid om te sporten via bedrijfsfitness

  
**Dit vragen wij**
------------------


Je weet wat er nodig is om systemen stabiel te houden én structureel te verbeteren. Je neemt daarin verantwoordelijkheid en helpt anderen hetzelfde te doen.


Daarnaast breng je mee:
  

* Ervaring in een Operations\- of DevOps\-rol binnen complexe IT\-omgevingen
* Ervaring met Kubernetes, CI/CD en automatisering
* Het vermogen om structurele problemen te analyseren en op te lossen
* Ervaring met het verbeteren van processen en deployments
* Je neemt initiatief en pakt eigenaarschap
* Je helpt collega’s groeien en deelt actief kennis

  
**Hier kom je te werken**
-------------------------


### **Meer over DUO/DFS\-ICT**


Binnen DUO ICT werken we elke dag aan betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige dienstverlening voor het onderwijs. Daarnaast ontwikkelt en beheert DUO honderden geavanceerde applicaties voor alle mensen en organisaties in Nederland die met onderwijs, kinderopvang en inburgeren te maken hebben. We werken met innovatieve en complexe ICT\-infrastructuren.


Jij gaat aan de slag binnen de afdeling ICT OI van DUO ICT. Dit is een afdeling van zo’n honderdvijftien ICT professionals. Samen ben je verantwoordelijk voor het waarborgen van de continuïteit van de bekostiging van onderwijsinstellingen. Dat is essentieel voor het functioneren van het onderwijsveld. Daarom investeren we continu in het onderhoud en de vernieuwing van onze systemen, zodat we ook in de toekomst het onderwijs betrouwbaar en efficiënt kunnen blijven bekostigen.


### **Over Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO)**


Bij de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) werk jij aan momenten die ertoe doen. Denk aan het starten met een studie, slagen voor een examen of het behalen van een diploma dat telt. Grote kans dat je ons al kent van één van die stappen.


Samen met duizenden collega’s zorgen we ervoor dat studenten, onderwijsinstellingen en inburgeraars op ons kunnen rekenen. We regelen studiefinanciering, organiseren examens en erkennen diploma’s. Ook helpen we onderwijsinstellingen bij het uitwisselen van gegevens, het werken met onze systemen en het regelen van de financiering van onderwijs.


In ons werk denken we steeds vanuit de mensen die onze diensten gebruiken. We zorgen voor duidelijke informatie en betrouwbare dienstverlening, zodat mensen verder kunnen met hun studie, werk of toekomst.


We werken voor mensen in heel Nederland. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat verschillende achtergronden en perspectieven samenkomen in onze organisatie. Zo begrijpen we beter wat mensen nodig hebben en kunnen we onze dienstverlening blijven verbeteren. Daarom staan alle vacatures ook open voor mensen uit het doelgroepregister van de Banenafspraak. Meer weten? Kijk hier voor meer informatie.


  
**Bijzonderheden**
------------------


* Bij de Rijksoverheid beschrijft het Kwaliteitsraamwerk Informatievoorziening (KWIV) eenduidige kwaliteitsprofielen voor alle IV\-professionals. KWIV bestaat uit een aantal kwaliteiten (KWIV)\-profielen, waarbij per KWIV\-profiel specifieke competenties, kennis en trainingen zijn geformuleerd. Elke IV\-functie is te koppelen aan één (best passend) KWIV\-profiel, dat beschrijft wat de IV\-professional zou moeten kunnen en kennen. Het KWIV profiel van deze functie is Applicatiebeheer. De inhoud van de functie wijkt niet af van wat er in de vacaturetekst is opgenomen.
* We ontvangen graag je reactie uiterlijk op 1 oktober 2026\.
* Na de sluitingsdatum zijn de vacaturetekst en de gegevens van de contactpersonen online niet meer zichtbaar. Om te voorkomen dat je deze moet opvragen, vragen wij je de vacaturetekst te downloaden en te bewaren.
* Controleer regelmatig je ongewenste/spam e\-mailmap. Het kan voorkomen dat mailwisseling vanuit DUO in deze map(pen) terechtkomt.
* Ben je een intermediair? Wij werven zelf of met onze vaste partners via het Rijksinkoopstelsel. Acquisitie is niet gewenst.

  
**Over de functiegroep Senior Medewerker Iv**
---------------------------------------------


Door het Functiegebouw Rijk worden medewerkers en leidinggevenden geholpen bij het maken van resultaat\- en ontwikkelafspraken in functioneringsgesprekken en krijgt men inzicht in de loopbaanmogelijkheden binnen de Rijksoverheid.


  
**Stel gerust je vraag**

jobs.title: DWS - Solution Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Employer:** **DWS Group**

**Title:** **Solution Architect (m/f/d)**

**Location:** **Frankfurt**

**About DWS:**

At DWS, we’re capturing the opportunities of tomorrow. You can be part of a leading, client\-committed, global Asset Manager, making an impact on individuals, communities, and the world.


Join us on our journey, and you can shape our transformation by working side by side with industry thought\-leaders and gaining new and diverse perspectives. You can share ideas and be yourself, whilst driving innovative and sustainable solutions that influence markets and behaviours for the better.


Every day brings the opportunity to discover a new now, and here at DWS, you’ll be supported as you overcome challenges and reach your ambitions. This is your chance to lead an extraordinary career and invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The Chief Technology Office (CTO) within the DWS COO division is responsible for shaping and delivering the firm's technology strategy, transformation agenda and innovation priorities. Working across business and technology functions, the CTO Office enables the delivery of scalable, secure and efficient technology solutions that support DWS's strategic objectives, operational effectiveness and long\-term growth.


The Solution \& Data Architecture team shape the architecture standards, patterns, and guidance that enable delivery teams to build scalable, secure, and future\-ready solutions. They work closely with Domain Architects, Security specialists, Data SMEs, platform teams, and delivery squads to ensure that solutions are aligned with DWS strategy, architecture principles, and policy requirements.


The team supports delivery from early requirements shaping through to solution design, design governance, and implementation support. This includes defining data ingestion, transformation, and consumption approaches, designing application and service architectures, and contributing reusable patterns, decision trees, and architecture decision records. The team also explores emerging technologies and develop practical guidance to continuously improve the DWS technology landscape.


**Your responsibilities**

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:


* Translate functional and non\-functional requirements into solution designs, building blocks, services, data pipelines, integrations, and user\-facing components.
* Own and drive end\-to\-end solution design, ensuring alignment with DWS architecture principles, technology strategy, security requirements, and design governance.
* Work closely with data architects to define effective approaches for data ingestion, transformation, management, and consumption.
* Guide and coach engineering teams during implementation to ensure designs are understood, practical, and delivered as intended.
* Collaborate with Domain Architects and fellow Solution and Data Architects to create architecture decision records, reusable patterns, and practical guidance for recurring design challenges.
* Support delivery teams in presenting and defending solution designs through relevant architecture and design authorities.
* Evaluate, prototype, and assess new technologies, deriving practical usage patterns that help modernize and continuously improve the DWS technology estate.

We are looking for **:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a comparable technology role.
* Strong understanding of modern application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, integration patterns, and cloud\-native design principles.
* Experience in designing and building or integrating with ABAC or RBAC controls or systems (IAM)
* Strong Java experience, including the Java ecosystem, Spring Boot, J2EE/Jakarta EE, and modern JDKs.
* Ability to break down complex problems into clear, actionable, and implementable solution components.
* Experience working with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and architecture or governance forums.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience in financial services, asset management, or another regulated environment.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience with .NET, TypeScript, Python, or modern front\-end and service development approaches.
* Understanding of data architecture, data pipelines, data governance, and data consumption patterns.
* Experience with TOGAF, SAFe, or comparable architecture and delivery frameworks.
* Experience defining reusable architecture patterns, decision trees, architecture decision records, and design standards.
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with the ability to assess their practical relevance for enterprise adoption.
* Confident conversational and professional proficiency (B2\)—you can comfortably negotiate, present, and collaborate with German\-speaking clients.
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

**Posting Period** : 08\.09\.2026 until further notice


**What we’ll offer you:**

Without the ambitions of our people, our achievements wouldn’t be possible. And it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


**Some of our core benefits:**  



* Physical and Mental Health Well\-Being benefits including (but not limited to) Statutory Health Insurance (BKK), sickness benefit allowance and support helplines for employees
* Family friendly benefits including generous parental leave packages (supporting all variations of family set\-ups) and support in finding childcare options including DWS’s own kindergarten service
* A wide selection of pension plans, Personal Budget Accounts to enable sabbaticals or early retirement and capital\-forming benefits
* The opportunity to support our CSR strategy which is focused on combatting climate change \& achieving greater social justice. You can make donations to our partnered organisations or take part in corporate volunteering opportunities in your local communities by providing on hand support.

DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let us know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotic Systems
jobs.description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.



Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission. Every one of these solutions starts as physical hardware — robotic workcells that we design, build, and commission in our own labs before they go into production.



We are looking for a passionate Senior Mechanical Engineer for Robotic Systems to turn robotics concepts into reliable physical systems. In this role, you will design the mechanical parts of our workcells, build and assemble them in our labs, and make sure they meet the relevant safety standards. You will own our lab infrastructure, tooling, and material, and be the hands\-on partner for our robotics, software, and application engineers. The role is based in Munich, Germany.


#### **Responsibilities**


* Design mechanical parts, fixtures, grippers, mounts, and enclosures for the robotic workcells in our labs and in customer projects
* Validate workcell and production line concepts in simulation — reachability, collisions, and cycle times — before any hardware is built
* Construct, assemble, and commission complete robotic workcells — from the frame and mounting concept to cabling and final integration
* Create and maintain CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials, and prepare parts for manufacturing via CAM and 3D printing
* Build up a library of reusable mechanical modules, standard components, and design templates, and feed lessons learned from existing workcells back into it, so that each new cell is faster to design than the last
* Own the organization of our labs, including tools, equipment, material stock, and the procurement of mechanical components
* Ensure that our workcells adhere to the relevant machine safety norms and support risk assessments, safeguarding concepts, and technical documentation
* Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to translate application requirements into robust mechanical solutions
* Travel to customer and deployment sites to support the installation, commissioning, and on\-site adaptation of workcells (up to 20% of working time)

#### **Essential Skills**


* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience, e.g. a technical apprenticeship with several years of relevant work
* Minimum of four years of professional experience in mechanical design, machine building, or industrial automation
* Solid CAD skills (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360, Inventor, Creo) for part and assembly design including technical drawings
* Experience with robot simulation and offline programming environments (e.g., RoboDK, RobotStudio, Visual Components)
* Practical experience with CAM and common manufacturing processes (milling, turning, sheet metal) as well as with 3D printing, including design for manufacturability
* Experience with aluminum profile systems, linear axes, fixtures, and standard mechanical components
* Experience with robotic hardware (robot arms, grippers, cameras, AGVs, sensors, etc.)
* Hands\-on mindset — you enjoy building, assembling, and commissioning hardware yourself
* Knowledge of machine safety norms and a structured approach to safe workcell design
* Structured and independent working style with a strong sense of order in the lab
* Fluency in English

#### **Beneficial Skills**


* Knowledge of electrical engineering: wiring, control cabinets, and the integration of sensors and actuators
* Experience with pneumatics: valves, cylinders, vacuum grippers, and air supply
* Familiarity with functional safety standards and safety equipment (e.g., EN ISO 10218, ISO/TS 15066, EN ISO 13849, safety scanners, light curtains, emergency stop circuits)
* Experience working with external manufacturing suppliers and in procurement
* Basic programming skills (e.g., Python) or experience with PLC programming
* German language skills

### **What we offer**


* A dynamic high\-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world\-class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60\+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
* Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks \& fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

### **About us**



**Agile Robots SE** is an international high\-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than **3500** employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state\-of\-the\-art force\-moment\-sensing and world\-leading image\-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user\-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.



This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!



We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Integrations)
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!


Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.


We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.


It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

**Kraken Generation Flex**
--------------------------


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.


Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market\-access and integration efforts.

**Where you’ll fit in and role summary**
----------------------------------------


As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.


You will be bringing your **regional technical expertise** to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross\-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900\+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).


The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware\&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK\-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.


You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering\-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Market Access \& Prequalification:** Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid\-scale and C\&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary\-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3\.0\. Support **prequalification (Präqualifikation)** with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO\-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. *(Grid\-code and plant\-compliance obligations such as VDE\-AR\-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.)*
* **Integration Technology (your core deliverable):** Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.
* **Regional Technical Expertise:** Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber\-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary\-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.
* **Stakeholder Liaison:** Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.
* **Hardware \& On\-site Support (occasional):** Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O\&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands\-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on\-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to **Kraken’s Berlin office** and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

**What you'll bring to the party**
----------------------------------

* **Language:** Native or professional fluency in **German and English**, essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.
* **Engineering background:** Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field (**or equivalent practical experience** in industrial/energy integration).
* **Integration \& connectivity:** Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).
* **Power\-plant systems:** Working understanding of power\-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.
* **German market knowledge:**


	+ TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.
	+ Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.
	+ Redispatch 3\.0 regulatory framework.
* **Customer\-facing delivery:** Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.
* **Travel:** Occasional travel may be required.
* **A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment**, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi\-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

**️ Bonus points**
------------------

* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: **IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61400\-25 (wind), OPC\-UA, Modbus**, or similar IEC protocols.
* Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (**NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness**; IEC 62443 a plus).
* Familiarity with **CLI tools** for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux\-based environments.
* Familiarity with software languages, version\-controlled configuration, and general tooling.
* Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO\-E frameworks beyond Germany.

*Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!*

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.*

These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). jobs.description:
* Berlin (DE)
* Munich (DE)
* Wuppertal (DE)
* Wurzburg (DE)
* Software Development
* Fulltime
* Published: 2026\-07\-07
**What do we do?**
------------------


**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**


Thinkproject is a European leader in the digitalization of the construction industry, with
  

offices and customers spanning Europe and beyond.


Founded in 2000 — when construction project planning was still predominantly manual — Thinkproject was built on deep industry expertise and a mission to make complex
  

construction projects manageable. Today, we call it Construction Intelligence: software
  

that makes construction projects more efficient, safer, more punctual, and above
  

all, more sustainable.


**VDC Manager** is one of the flagship products in our portfolio — a complete openBIM
  

platform at the intersection of 3D modeling, process management, and data
  

intelligence.


**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------


**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a C\+\+ Software Developer to join the team behind VDC
  

Manager — Thinkproject's complete openBIM software, developed by industry experts
  

and trusted by AEC professionals worldwide.


VDC Manager enables the merging of diverse data and information into BIM processes,
  

including model checking and clash detection in 3D models, construction schedule
  

creation and 4D simulation, quantity and dimension determination for cost calculations, and much more. As a member of the engineering team, you will take ownership of complex features, drive technical decisions, and help shape the future of one of Europe's leading BIM platforms.


**What You Will Do**
  

**Core Development**


* Architect, design, develop, and test new and existing features within VDC Manager
* Write clean, well\-structured, secure, and testable modern C\+\+ code (C\+\+17/20\)
* Take ownership of complex technical areas — from geometry processing and 3D rendering to data exchange and cloud connectivity
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
* Drive technical analysis and research, including evaluation and selection of technical approaches and third\-party components

**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX designers, and BIM domain experts to translate requirements into robust technical solutions
* Demonstrate and present technical work to product owners and stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
* Work as part of a distributed, international team — contributing to technical discussions on implementation approaches and user interfaces
* Continuously learn and apply modern tools, frameworks, and engineering processes
**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------


**Must\-Have**


* Knowledge of C/C\+\+, including modern standards (C\+\+14/17/20\).
* Hands\-on experience with graphics programming (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar)
* Strong skills in software architecture, data structures, and design patterns
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills — able to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software quality practices (performance, scalability, security, testability)
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) — our working language across the engineering team

**Strong Advantages**


* 2\-3 years of professional software development experience.
* Experience with Qt for desktop application development
* Knowledge of BIM concepts, workflows, and data formats (IFC, BCF) and/or experience in the AEC industry
* Experience with JavaScript (user scripts), Python (utilities and build tooling), or C\# (plug\-in development and web services for Thinkproject cloud connectivity)
* Familiarity with web services and REST APIs for cloud platform integration
* German language skills are a plus but not required

**Code Sample (Required)**
  

As part of your application, please share a C/C\+\+ code sample that best represents your coding style and preferences.


* It does not need to be executable or a complete program
* It can come from a personal project or a previous role (anonymization is perfectly fine)
* You are welcome to supplement it with screenshots, videos, papers, or prototypes — anything that helps showcase your work and engineering thinking
* This is not a test — it is an opportunity to show us how you think and how you write code.
**What we offer**
-----------------


**Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Language courses \| Great learning opportunities \| Headspace access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events**
  

  

Employee satisfaction is our top priority. Our people make Thinkproject what it is today.
  

We value a work environment where everyone can help shape our culture through open
  

feedback and mutual respect. We believe that flexibility and a diverse benefits program
  

are key success factors — for our employees and for our business.
*We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all*
  

*backgrounds, nationalities, and career paths.*

Preethika Ramdass

jobs.title: CO-ABTEILUNGSLEITER*IN - DIGITAL HEALTH ENGINEERING
jobs.description:
Die Fraunhofer\-Gesellschaft ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.


Du arbeitest als Co\-Abteilungsleiter\*in in der Abteilung Digital Health Engineering am Standort Kaiserslautern. Die Abteilung Digital Health Engineering (DHE) wurde 2022 gegründet und wird weiter aufgebaut. Du bist also ganz vorne mit dabei, kannst deine Ideen mit einbringen und zur Entwicklung der Abteilung beitragen! Wir beschäftigen uns mit Forschungsfragen rund um das Design und Engineering von verlässlichen Gesundheitslösungen der Zukunft und transferieren diese in die Industrie. Dies reicht von der Identifikation innovativer Anwendungsfälle bis hin zur Umsetzung konkreter Lösungen. Die Abteilung beschäftigt sich schwerpunktmäßig mit Dependable Artificial Intelligence und Dateninteroperabilität (FHIR) für den Gesundheitsbereich und weiteren spannenden Themen, wie beispielsweise auch militär\-medizinischen Themen.

  


**Hier sorgst Du für Veränderung**


* Du übernimmst im Rahmen einer Doppelspitze den weiteren Aufbau und die Führung einer Gruppe von wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeitenden.
* Du bist mitverantwortlich für die Strategieentwicklung und die Forschungsroadmap der Abteilung
* Du trägst zum Business Development der Abteilung bei und entwickelst Wertversprechen und Services für den Industrietransfer
* Du arbeitest in spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Forschungs\- und Kundenprojekten mit namenhaften Partnern aus Forschung und Industrie zusammen
* Du beschäftigst dich mit Themen und Herausforderungen rund um Daten und Software im Gesundheitsbereich, z. B. KI\-Anwendungen rundum LLMs, Simulationen, Softwarelösungen usw.
* Du trägst mit deinem Knowhow zu Anträgen für Förderprojekte und Angeboten an industrielle Kunden bei und übernimmst die Leitung von Projekten
* Du präsentierst Ergebnisse bei Auftraggebern sowie auf Konferenzen und Fachtagungen
* Du arbeitest dich in vielseitige Themen ein und entwickelst deine Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter
* Du bringst dein Knowhow in verschiedenen Teams ein, diskutierst und forschst mit unterschiedlichen Talenten und disziplinübergreifend

  


**Hiermit bringst Du Dich ein**


* Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Diplom oder Master, ggfs. Promotion). Das Studienfach sollte einen klaren Bezug zur Informatik, Data Science und/oder Medizininformatik haben
* Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der angewandten Forschung und Erfahrung im Business Development wären wünschenswert
* Du bringst Programmierkenntnisse in z.B. Python, JAVA, ggfs. C\#/C\+\+ mit
* Du besitzt Kenntnisse im Bereich Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Digital Health und/oder Software Engineering
* Du hast sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Level C1\)
* Du willst gemeinsam im Team etwas bewegen
* Du bringst eine proaktive und eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Kommunikationsstärke mit
* Du bist kreativ, neugierig und interessierst dich für Neues und Innovationen
* Du kannst dich leicht motivieren und bringst innovative Ideen ein

  


**Was wir für Dich bereithalten**



Als wissenschaftliche\*r Mitarbeiter\*in und Führungskraft bist du bei uns Teil eines engagierten und kollegialen Teams, das dich bereits während der Einarbeitung umfassend unterstützt. Am Fraunhofer IESE leben wir eine familienfreundliche und internationale Kultur. Wir bieten die Möglichkeit flexibler Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeitens, um individuelle Anliegen zu berücksichtigen. Wir bieten dir persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL) sowie Zugang zu einem vergünstigten Deutschland\-Jobticket.

  



Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber\*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern.

  



Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen richten sich nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD).

  



Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer\-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.


**Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt, und mach einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Deiner Online\-Bewerbung erhältst Du eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Dir, wie es weitergeht.**

  

Bei Rückfragen zur Stellenausschreibung wende dich bitte per E\-Mail an:



Florian Gogolin



florian.gogolin@iese.fraunhofer.de



Fraunhofer\-Institut für Experimentelles Software Engineering IESE

jobs.title: Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
**About The Company**



GROPYUS is a technology\-based construction company focused on building multi\-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

**About the Role**



You will be part of a highly collaborative product team working at the core of our manufacturing facility, transforming digital models into physical elements at scale.



Product Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including underlying infrastructure, build pipelines, automated testing, release and rollout management, monitoring, and support. You will bring your experience in working with PLCs and/or other OT systems like e.g. robots, into the team.



As a Software Engineer (PLC / OT), you will work with your team on evolving the rather traditional architecture of MES like systems integrating via OPC\-UA with PLCs into a future\-proof architecture built with **Software Defined Manufacturing** in mind. You should be looking forward to developing less PLC / OT code over time and building a solution that allows for full **simulation** of upcoming manufacturing orders.



Furthermore, our teams are also responsible for operating and troubleshooting the software they have developed during working hours of the factory.


**What you'll be doing**



As a Software Engineer (f/m/d) on the Product Delivery team, you will be responsible for:


* **Understanding and explaining** the existing PLC / OT code base from our vendor to the rest of your team.
* Working together with your team and other teams in Product Delivery to **evolve** the current architecture into a truly **Software Defined Manufacturing** setup.
* Bringing an o**perational mindset** to monitor, maintain, and improve software uptime including reliable updates, latency, and efficiency
* Acting as a bridge between digital product delivery \& physical logistics and manufacturing systems, ensuring both are aligned and integrated
* Helping define, monitor and evolve **SLAs/SLOs** as well as other important KPIs like e.g. OEE for critical systems


**What you bring**


* You are an experienced software / automation engineer with experience in **PLC** or other **OT** technologies
* You are willing and excited to adopt modern software engineering approaches like code reviews, testing, CI/CD, etc.
* You have operated and supported large\-scale software / OT systems
* You have worked in companies with **strong operational cultures**, ideally in logistics or manufacturing – understanding the commercial impact of system downtime
* You are proficient with most of the following technologies:
* + PLC programming (TIA19 is a plus)
	+ Robot programming (KRL is a plus)
	+ OPC\-UA
	+ MQTT is a plus
	+ Python / C\+\+ / C\# is a plus
* You are familiar with monitoring and alerting practices for production systems
* You have experience defining and working with SLAs/SLOs
* You are willing to travel to our manufacturing site in Richen whenever needed and within Germany and Austria for in\-person team events

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* An **unlimited** contract with 30 vacation days.
* **Flexible, hybrid work:** You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day.
* **Attractive perks and benefits**: We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions.
* **Virtual Shares Program**: Participate in the success of GROPYUS through our Virtual Share Program.
* **Ownership**: You can truly make your mark with your work and contributions – on all our organizational levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them.
* **The chance to be part of something big**: Our mission is to rethink an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and fostering sustainable, affordable living.
* **A diverse and enriching work environment**: Become a valued member of a wonderfully diverse team of individuals from over 50 countries. At GROPYUS we value inclusion above all, ensuring that everyone feels they belong – no matter their background. In this way, our differences become strengths that help us grow as a team.

#### **Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.**

**We can't wait to get to know you.**
**For more information, visit our** **website****.**

**About The Company**



GROPYUS is a technology\-based construction company focused on building multi\-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

**About the Role**



You will be part of a highly collaborative product team working at the core of our manufacturing facility, transforming digital models into physical elements at scale.



Product Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including underlying infrastructure, build pipelines, automated testing, release and rollout management, monitoring, and support. You will bring your experience in working with PLCs and/or other OT systems like e.g. robots, into the team.



As a Software Engineer (PLC / OT), you will work with your team on evolving the rather traditional architecture of MES like systems integrating via OPC\-UA with PLCs into a future\-proof architecture built with **Software Defined Manufacturing** in mind. You should be looking forward to developing less PLC / OT code over time and building a solution that allows for full **simulation** of upcoming manufacturing orders.



Furthermore, our teams are also responsible for operating and troubleshooting the software they have developed during working hours of the factory.


**What you'll be doing**



As a Software Engineer (f/m/d) on the Product Delivery team, you will be responsible for:


* **Understanding and explaining** the existing PLC / OT code base from our vendor to the rest of your team.
* Working together with your team and other teams in Product Delivery to **evolve** the current architecture into a truly **Software Defined Manufacturing** setup.
* Bringing an o**perational mindset** to monitor, maintain, and improve software uptime including reliable updates, latency, and efficiency
* Acting as a bridge between digital product delivery \& physical logistics and manufacturing systems, ensuring both are aligned and integrated
* Helping define, monitor and evolve **SLAs/SLOs** as well as other important KPIs like e.g. OEE for critical systems


**What you bring**


* You are an experienced software / automation engineer with experience in **PLC** or other **OT** technologies
* You are willing and excited to adopt modern software engineering approaches like code reviews, testing, CI/CD, etc.
* You have operated and supported large\-scale software / OT systems
* You have worked in companies with **strong operational cultures**, ideally in logistics or manufacturing – understanding the commercial impact of system downtime
* You are proficient with most of the following technologies:
* + PLC programming (TIA19 is a plus)
	+ Robot programming (KRL is a plus)
	+ OPC\-UA
	+ MQTT is a plus
	+ Python / C\+\+ / C\# is a plus
* You are familiar with monitoring and alerting practices for production systems
* You have experience defining and working with SLAs/SLOs
* You are willing to travel to our manufacturing site in Richen whenever needed and within Germany and Austria for in\-person team events

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* An **unlimited** contract with 30 vacation days.
* **Flexible, hybrid work:** You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day.
* **Attractive perks and benefits**: We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**


As our Application Security Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and strengthening the security of our products and platforms. Working closely with highly skilled engineering, platform, and security teams, you will help build secure, resilient, and trusted software while driving a security\-first culture across the organization. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on modern products, influence security strategy, and continuously develop your expertise in a collaborative and innovative environment.

* Drive product security across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Perform threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security assessments for applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Identify, assess, prioritize, and support the remediation of security vulnerabilities.
* Integrate, operate, and continuously improve security tooling within CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency scanning, and secrets\-scanning solutions.
* Define, promote, and support secure coding standards and security best practices across engineering teams.
* Review and advise on authentication, authorization, identity management, secrets management, and service\-to\-service communication designs.
* Support penetration testing activities, conduct targeted security testing, and drive remediation efforts.
* Contribute to security policies, standards, and security awareness initiatives.
* Partner closely with software engineers, architects, and platform teams to embed security into development processes and strengthen our DevSecOps culture.

#### **Your profile**

* 5\+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Software Security, Secure Software Development, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of secure software development practices and common application security vulnerabilities.
* Proven experience performing threat modeling, architecture reviews, code reviews, and application security assessments.
* Hands\-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency\-scanning, and secrets\-scanning tools.
* Strong knowledge of application security, API security, and distributed\-system security.
* Experience securing authentication, authorization, and identity\-related workflows.
* Solid understanding of OWASP, CWE, security testing methodologies, and modern security engineering practices.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and applying DevSecOps principles.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering, platform, and DevOps teams.
* Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are a plus.

**Nice to have**  

* Development experience in C\#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
* Experience securing cloud\-native applications and services in Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, OSWE, or GIAC Secure Development certifications.
* Experience working in agile software development environments.

#### **Why us?**

**Modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro:** Nur 5 Gehminuten von der Haltestelle Bahrenfeld entfernt \- bequeme Anreise garantiert!  

  

**Offene Unternehmenskultur:** Tauche ein in ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Ideen und Vielfalt gefördert werden.  

  

**Kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre:** Genieße eine Arbeitsatmosphäre, die von Zusammenarbeit und Hands\-on\-Mentalität geprägt ist.  

  

**Hybrides Arbeitsmodell:** Flexibilität \- Kombiniere Arbeit vor Ort und im Home Office.  

  

**30 Tage Urlaub:** Mehr Zeit für Erholung und Freizeit. Zusätzliche freie Tage am 24\.12\., 31\.12\. sowie einen halben Tag an deinem Geburtstag.  

  

**Attraktives Vergütungspaket:** Wir honorieren deine Leistung angemessen.  

  

**Betriebliche Altersvorsorge:** Mit großzügigem 25% Arbeitgeber\-Zuschuss bis zu 75 €.  

  

**Pluxee\-Gutscheine:** Für unbeschwerte Verpflegung während der Arbeit.  

  

**HVV\-Abo\- oder Tiefgaragenstellplatz\-Zuschuss:** Unterstützung für Deine bequeme  

  

**JobRad:** Nutze die Möglichkeit, nach der Probezeit ein JobRad zu leasen.  

  

**EGYM Wellpass:** Nutze die Möglichkeit, nach der Probezeit dich körperlich und mental fit zu halten.

#### **About us**


Telio is a medium\-sized, internationally active, rapidly growing company in the field of telecommunications and IT services in the prison sector. As the European market leader, we have been providing communications solutions for prisons and their inmates worldwide for over 25 years. With more than 300 employees, we are active in 23 countries and develop, install and operate communication and media systems that make an important contribution to resocialization in prisons as well as in correctional facilities.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Enterprise Architect (Azure/Data Fabric/AI agents)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment


Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting\-edge cloud technologies.


Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices


Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.


Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment


Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues

AI Landing zones,

self\-driven/self\-motivated.

jobs.description:
##### **Upgrade Your Career With Aira**


Clean\-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net\-zero emissions.


Aira's mission is to advance the next generation of home energy solutions, creating intelligent, sustainable homes for a meaningful impact. Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy\-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting\-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

##### **About the role as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**


The survey/design visit is a key aspect of the customer journey to ensure an installation goes ahead as planned, and as the customer expects. You will find solutions to problems, ensure the project works in the interests of both the customer and Aira, and provide excellent customer service along the way. You will have the technical expertise to offer additional products and services we may offer in the interests of the customer.

##### **What you’ll be doing as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* Have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.
* Gather information from the quote, property and your survey data to generate an accurate heat loss calculation and emitter output requirements
* Find solutions to any technical issues where possible to ensure an installation can still go ahead
* Report any issues which may affect installation to your line manager from the customers property.
* Keep up to date with all manufacturer's guidance, and any legislative changes including but not limited to heat pumps, low carbon heating, clean energy, and building regulations.
* Operate within required Aira’s efficiency guidelines as well as MCS etc.

##### **What might a day look like?**

* Attend customer properties in your designated area
* Conduct a site survey and collect data relevant to the installation requirements
* Carry out a room by room heat loss assessment
* Determine which radiators need to be replaced, and communicate this with your customer
* Answer any technical queries the customer may have
* Communicate any price changes with the customer and explain the reason for these
* Obtain approval from the customer for your proposal to go ahead
* Create a list of materials required for the installation to be carried out

##### **What you'll need to have as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* You'll need to have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.


The following would be useful to have;

* Qualifications in System design such as Heat Geek Heating Mastery
* Level 3 Award in installation and maintenance of air source heat pump systems
* Water regulations certificate (WRAS) course
* Level 2 / 3 Award in plumbing
* Level 3 Award Low temperature heating and hot water systems in dwellings

**What is in it for you?**

* **Salary of £42,000**
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays
* Health Cash Plan
* Reward Gateway (shopping discount)
* Life insurance
* 25 days Annual Leave plus Bank Holidays
* iPad, Phone and all equipment provided

*(We encourage early applications as we may close the role once we find the right candidate.)*


At Aira, We’re not just champions of next\-generation energy, we’re champions in Diversity and Inclusion too. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks innovation and creativity and enables us to better serve our customers and communities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. We will never accept any form of discrimination and believe that together, we can drive a new era for our people and planet.

jobs.title: Apprentice Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Apprentice Technical Support Engineer**

**Location: Truro, with UK\-wide travel and overnight stays during busier seasonal periods**

**Contract: Apprenticeship Contract**

**Salary: £10\.85 per hour**

**Start your engineering career while helping make heating better for everyone**


At Kensa, we’re making heating better \- for people, for the planet and for the future. Since 1999, we’ve been leading the way in ground source heat pump technology, delivering affordable, low\-carbon heating solutions that support the UK’s transition to net zero.


We’re now looking for an Apprentice Technical Support Engineer to join our Technical Support team. This is a practical, varied opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, build valuable engineering skills and begin a career in the growing low\-carbon heating sector.


If you’re curious about how things work, enjoy solving problems and are keen to learn, this could be a great first step. You’ll combine hands\-on experience with a Low Carbon Heating Technician apprenticeship at Cornwall College, attending the Camborne campus one day each week.

**The role**


You’ll join our friendly Technical Support team and learn how to help engineers, installers and customers get the best from ground source heat pump systems. With training and mentoring from experienced colleagues, you’ll build confidence in fault\-finding and diagnostics, provide clear support by phone, and gain practical experience both remotely and on site.


As your skills and experience grow, you’ll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and explore a future career within Kensa’s technical team.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Support engineers, installers and customers by telephone, listening carefully and communicating clearly and professionally.
* Learn how to diagnose technical faults remotely and help identify practical solutions.
* Assist senior engineers and follow technical guidance, processes and instructions.
* Build knowledge of heat pumps, plumbing, electrical systems and renewable heating technologies.
* Gain experience of zero\-carbon central heating and hot water systems, including installation, commissioning, servicing, maintenance and repair.
* Support site\-based activities when required. The role may involve significant travel during seasonal peaks, potentially across the UK, including overnight stays and time away from home.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues while developing the confidence to complete tasks independently.

**Your apprenticeship**


You’ll complete the Low Carbon Heating Technician apprenticeship with Cornwall College, attending the Camborne campus one day each week. Your off\-the\-job training will take place during your contracted working hours, so you’ll have dedicated time to learn and develop. We’re ideally looking for someone to start the apprenticeship in October.


The programme will help you develop the knowledge and practical skills to work with low\-carbon heating and hot water systems, including ground and air source heat pumps, associated pipework, components, and mechanical and electrical controls.

**What we’re looking for**

* Enthusiasm for engineering, renewable energy or learning how things work.
* A positive attitude and willingness to learn, ask questions and develop new skills.
* Clear communication and the ability to listen carefully and work well with others.
* A thoughtful, customer\-focused approach and an interest in solving problems.
* Reliability, attention to detail and a willingness to take responsibility for your work.
* Willingness and availability to undertake significant travel during seasonal peaks, which may be UK\-wide and involve overnight stays.
* A full UK driving licence would be helpful but is not essential.


You don’t need previous experience with heat pumps or to meet every point above. What matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in building a career in low\-carbon heating. If the role appeals to you, we encourage you to apply.

**What we offer**


At Kensa, we’re committed to creating a supportive, rewarding and purpose\-driven place to work. When you join us, you can expect:

* 25 days’ annual leave, increasing to 30 days after five years, plus bank holidays.
* Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options where possible.
* Career development support, including training and support for recognised qualifications.
* Free 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for you and your immediate family.
* Private healthcare after one year of service.
* Paid volunteering days to support community impact.
* Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme.
* Company pension scheme with employer contributions.
* A collaborative culture where your work directly supports the UK’s transition to greener, more affordable heating.

**Ready to apply?**


If you’re excited to learn, develop practical skills and start a career in a growing low\-carbon business, we’d love to hear from you.


We welcome applications from all backgrounds and communities. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know \- we’ll be happy to support you.


You’re welcome to include a short cover note explaining what draws you to Kensa and why this apprenticeship interests you, but it’s optional \- please apply in the way that suits you best.

**Closing Date: Friday 2nd October 2026**
