jobs.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs.description:
**Senior Python Developer**

**Salary:** From £50,000 per annum, depending on experience

**Location:** Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the UK. If you like to work alongside colleagues in person, our offices are in Birmingham, Bristol, Exeter and London.

**Term/Hours:** Permanent, 32–40 hours per week. We are flexible on working pattern, so please tell us what suits you in your application.

**Closing date for applications:** Monday 12th October 2026

**We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.**

**We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).**

**Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.**

**About the Role**


We are looking for a **Senior Python Developer** (or someone operating close to senior level) to join our five\-person energy development team. You will help lead the design and implementation of Python packages building on the Home Energy Model that will enable the next generation of energy performance assessment.


You will work closely with DESNZ, external collaborators, our internal domain experts and your dev team, turning tangible and pressing user needs into reliable, maintainable Python software. The team is supportive and high\-performing, and the work has a direct impact on carbon reduction.


This role includes **line management**. You may already manage one or more developers, or you may be ready to take that step, supported by our programme of leadership and management training. Either way, you will help the people you manage to do their best work and develop their careers.

**What you will do**

* Design, build and improve Python packages for modelling, simulation and data processing.
* Lead engineering decisions, architecture discussions and technical problem solving.
* Turn analytical and modelling needs into shippable software.
* Line manage one or more developers: regular one\-to\-ones, objective setting, performance reviews and support for their development.
* Mentor colleagues across the team and set a strong example through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain high code quality through testing, documentation and thorough code reviews.
* Work across disciplines to integrate tools and deliver results for our customers.
* Drive continuous improvement in our tools, processes and engineering standards.
* Own your deliverables and keep projects moving with urgency and accountability.

 **About Us**


City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with one core mission: delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations that are serious about net zero achieve meaningful, quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.


We work collaboratively across the business to provide integrated solutions for a wide range of clients, from national bodies such as DESNZ and the Climate Change Committee (CCC) to forward\-thinking local authorities such as Oxfordshire County Council. Our award\-winning research, software and product development team builds innovative digital tools, such as our GIS software, Cadence, that sit at the heart of how we deliver our projects.

 **Essential**

* Strong professional experience as a Python developer, at or near senior level.
* Excellent command of Python and its ecosystem, including libraries, tooling and best practice.
* A track record of building production\-grade applications, ideally in data\-rich or scientific domains.
* The ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code.
* Experience line managing or formally mentoring developers, **or** a clear willingness and motivation to take on line management responsibilities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary teams.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Pydantic and/or JSON Schema.
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD.
* A strong grasp of geometry and physics, ideally including building physics.
* Understanding of decarbonisation and energy systems.
* Experience supporting the growth of more junior engineers, such as onboarding or coaching.

**Aligned to Our Values**

* **Excellence:** You hold high standards in your code, your solutions and your engineering decisions.
* **Ownership \& Accountability:** You take responsibility for outcomes and proactively drive progress.
* **Data Driven:** You use evidence, analytical thinking and testing to guide your choices.
* **Results Orientated:** You focus on delivering outputs that create real\-world impact.
* **Adaptability \& Learning:** You embrace change, seek out new knowledge and learn quickly.
* **Passion \& Urgency:** You care about what you build and work with purpose.
* **Meritocracy:** You value competence and fairness, and you help raise the bar for everyone around you.
* **Entrepreneurial:** You are resourceful and creative, and you bring ideas that move the business forward.

 **What We Offer**

* **Fully remote working**, with optional access to **our offices in Birmingham, Bristol, Exeter and London** whenever you want them.
* **Flexible working hours** to support a healthy work–life balance.
* A **talented, friendly and supportive team** of engineers, data scientists and domain experts.
* **Impactful projects in decarbonisation and sustainability.**
* Real opportunities to grow, including as a people leader, and to shape exciting new products and capabilities.
* 25 days’ annual leave, plus bank holidays.
* Buy/sell annual leave policy.
* Membership of our group pension scheme.
* Enhanced maternity and paternity policy.
* Eye care policy.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* Employee assistance programme.

 **How to Apply**


Please include:

* Your CV, highlighting relevant experience.
* Examples of projects that show your technical skills.
* Links to relevant code repositories or portfolio work.
* A short note on any line management or mentoring experience, or what draws you to taking on line management.
* Your preferred working hours and pattern.


We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Senior Power Platform Consultant
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join our growing Data Analytics team within the Applied Technology Practice and play a key role in helping clients design, deliver and adopt high\-quality Power Platform solutions that improve how they manage information, automate processes and make decisions.


As a Senior Power Platform Consultant, you will combine deep technical expertise across Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and the wider Microsoft ecosystem with a practical consulting mindset. You will work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, shape solution options, challenge assumptions constructively and translate requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable low\-code solutions.


This is a client\-facing consulting role suited to someone who can operate as a senior technical specialist while also contributing to wider delivery leadership, capability development and business growth. You will act as a trusted advisor to project teams and clients, provide technical direction to colleagues, support bids and proposals where appropriate, and help strengthen the Power Platform capability through reusable patterns, assurance, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead the design, development and ongoing improvement of Power Platform solutions using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, model\-driven apps and wider Microsoft Power Platform capabilities.
* Work with clients, project teams and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, facilitate requirements discussions and translate complex or ambiguous challenges into practical digital solutions.
* Provide advisory input on Power Platform solution options, helping stakeholders understand technical trade\-offs, delivery risks, licensing implications, governance considerations and opportunities for value.
* Configure and extend Dataverse data models, relationships, business rules, forms, views, security roles, environment settings, APIs and appropriate integration patterns.
* Develop canvas apps, model\-driven apps and Power Automate cloud flows using appropriate Power Fx, connectors, reusable components and maintainable design patterns.
* Design and support integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power BI, Azure services and external systems where appropriate.
* Own or lead Power Platform workstreams through discovery, design, build, test, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement activities.
* Investigate and resolve complex issues across apps, flows, Dataverse, connectors, permissions, integrations and deployments, applying structured problem\-solving and sound technical judgement.
* Ensure solutions align with organisational governance, cyber security, data protection, licensing, regulatory and client assurance requirements.
* Apply good ALM practices, including solution packaging, environment strategy, deployment planning, documentation, release governance and appropriate technical assurance.
* Act as a senior technical specialist within the Data Analytics and Applied Technology community, providing guidance, peer review, coaching and mentoring to junior developers and less experienced Power Platform makers.
* Contribute to the development of reusable delivery patterns, templates, standards, technical guidance and lessons learned that improve consistency, quality and scalability across Power Platform projects.
* Build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders, identifying opportunities where Power Platform, automation, analytics or wider digital capability can deliver additional value.
* Support business development activity where appropriate, including contributing technical content to bids, proposals, demonstrations, case studies, solution shaping and capability development.
* Promote good practice in user\-centred design, accessibility, adoption, supportability and maintainability so that delivered solutions create lasting value beyond initial deployment.

**About you**
-------------

* Experience developing Power Platform solutions, including canvas apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and model\-driven apps.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, relational data modelling, security model, environment administration and ALM.
* Experience delivering enterprise\-grade Power Platform solutions in regulated or governance\-led environments.
* Experience using the wider Dataverse capability set, including custom connectors, APIs and appropriate integration patterns to support secure, scalable enterprise solutions.
* Good knowledge of Power Fx, Power Automate expressions, Dataverse configuration and solution deployment approaches.
* Experience integrating Power Platform with Microsoft 365 services such as SharePoint, Teams, Outlook and Power BI.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering and solution design skills.
* UK SC clearance required, or willingness and eligibility to obtain it where required.

**Desirable skills and experience:**

* Experience using Microsoft Copilot Studio to design, build and integrate copilots or agents with Power Platform solutions and enterprise data sources.
* Experience developing custom code components, including Power Apps Component Framework controls, using appropriate web development technologies and Microsoft development tooling.
* Experience developing and deploying Dataverse plug\-ins using C\# to implement server\-side business logic, validation and integration requirements.
* Experience developing Dataverse workflow extensions or custom workflow activities where standard Power Automate and platform capabilities are not sufficient.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications desirable, particularly PL\-200, PL\-400, PL\-600, AB\-410, AB\-100\.

**Rewards \& benefits**
-----------------------


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer**Locations:** DD, PH, TD, IV, KY and DG


Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?


At Utilita, we're growing our award\-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest\-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.


What is in it for you?


You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:


* **On\-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on\-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry\-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25\.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita\-sponsored arenas and football matches.


Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work\-life balance.**


We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.


You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.


We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First\-class training and support.**


Your journey will begin at our award\-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.


You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**


We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.


Through regular manager check\-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.


What you will be doing.


As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.


You will play an important role in delivering our customer\-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**


To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.


Who are Utilita?


Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.


As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick\-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.


We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030\. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.


Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**


Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.


Utilita is part of the Luxion group whichcomprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Advert

**About Us**


At **Everflow**, we’re on a mission to reshape the utility industry.


We’re an award\-winning, fast\-growing business delivering smarter, greener water, waste and connectivity solutions to businesses across the UK and we’re proud of the impact we make every day.


Our quest is simple but powerful: **bringing services together to make lives simple**. By saving our customers time, money, and energy, we give them the headspace to focus on what really matters growing their businesses and making an impact.


And while free coffee and ping pong are nice (very nice, actually), they’re not the reason people stay. Our culture is. We value authenticity over ego, curiosity over comfort, and progress over perfection. We trust our people, encourage bold ideas, and believe success should never come at the cost of wellbeing or belonging.

 **The Role**


This is where you come in.


As a **DevOps Engineer** in our Platform Team, you’ll be hands\-on with the cloud platform and pipelines our delivery teams build and ship software on. Reporting to one of our Engineering leads, you’ll work alongside colleagues in a multi\-disciplined team, take real ownership of your work, and need only light supervision to run with it.


This is an AI\-first role. As Everflow moves to an AI\-executed engineering model, you’ll use the AI code\-generation toolchain every day, and you’ll help keep the deployment pipeline that takes reviewed work to production fast and dependable. We’ll expect you to be comfortable reading, reviewing and correcting AI\-generated infrastructure code and your judgement about what good looks like matters.


In practice you’ll work across a mixed estate — greenfield AI workloads alongside established services we’re actively modernising, including .NET Framework — taking an automation\-first and AI\-first approach to delivery and designing efficient, secure cloud solutions with security considered at every layer. We’re a Microsoft house with a focus on staying cloud\-agnostic as our technology and tooling evolve.


You’ll be based at our Peterlee (SR8 2RU) office two days a week under our hybrid working pattern, with support for occasional planned out\-of\-hours work, such as releases and other changes best made outside business hours.


Candidates should expect a technical exercise as part of the selection process, which helps us understand how you think.

 **What You’ll Do**


You’ll be hands\-on, challenged, and trusted to make a real difference. You’ll:

* Build and maintain secure, scalable, highly available and cost\-optimised cloud infrastructure, collaborating on its design with our architects and the wider Platform Team.
* Use our AI code\-generation toolchain day to day, and review what it produces as carefully as you’d review your own work, automating throughput wherever possible.
* Contribute to our prompt libraries, treating prompts and AI configuration as versioned, tested code rather than throwaway text. You will help to keep our platform reliable and predictable.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure as code, as well as our CI/CD pipelines, principally in Terraform, keeping our modules and patterns reusable rather than one\-off.
* Build and manage services deployed into Kubernetes on Azure, including container configuration and the management of Helm charts.
* Monitor and manage our systems for availability and performance and help improve observability across the estate.
* Keep an eye on what we spend, applying FinOps practice to cloud resources and to AI toolchain alike.
* Work with our Security Engineers to build security into what you deploy rather than bolt it on afterwards.
* Support the team in the application of Agile through Scrum and Kanban, adopting the usual rituals and our end\-to\-end processes.

 **What We’re Looking For**


We’re less about ticking boxes and more about finding the right person — a team player and self\-starter who is prepared to contribute and help enrich how we do things. You’ll probably possess:

 **Essential**

* Solid experience developing, deploying and monitoring cloud infrastructure, with the judgement to analyse and diagnose problems under minimal supervision.
* Proficiency in infrastructure as code — Terraform.
* Hands\-on experience creating, monitoring and managing cloud resources in Microsoft Azure via Azure DevOps, working to the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF).
* Ability to build and manage services deployed into Kubernetes, including the role of container configuration and the management of Helm charts.
* Experience using AI to do real work — code generation, coding assistance or infrastructure automation — together with the judgement to review its output rather than take it at face value.
* Strong scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Bash, Python, YAML), plus a readiness to keep developing that skillset.
* Enough familiarity with software development practice — source control, branching, code review and testing — to work as a peer to the software engineers you support. An understanding of code written in C\# and .NET is an advantage.
* Working awareness of cloud security and DevSecOps practice, and the habit of considering security as you build.
* Clear communication and a genuinely collaborative style, with a can\-do approach and an appetite for continual improvement.

 **Desirable**

* Familiarity with other infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Bicep.
* Cost optimisation of deployable resources following FinOps practices, including an appreciation of AI compute as a material cost class in its own right.
* Exposure to prompt\-framework\-as\-code: prompts and AI configuration treated as versioned, tested and governed libraries.
* An understanding of observability platforms and of building alerting that people act on.
* Familiarity with Linux\-based operating systems (Ubuntu) for build servers and containerised deployment.
* Experience of running AI or ML workloads on Azure, such as AKS\-hosted models or vector data stores.
* Familiarity with Azure B2C or federated account security.
* Business continuity principles, and familiarity with Amazon Web Services (AWS) in that context.

 **What We Offer**


We take rewarding our people seriously (and not just with biscuits). You’ll get a competitive salary with annual reviews, a generous pension of up to 8% employer contribution, and life insurance worth up to three times your salary.


You’ll enjoy hybrid working (up to three days from home), the option to buy or sell up to five days of annual leave, an extra celebration holiday, and enhanced parental and sickness benefits.


There’s also free breakfast, free parking, an on\-site gym at our Peterlee HQ, access to an EV company car scheme, and a cycle\-to\-work scheme. For your wellbeing, we offer 24/7 counselling, virtual GP access, and a healthcare cash plan covering dental, physio, and optical care because looking after people shouldn’t stop at work.

**Equal Opportunities**


Everflow is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We’re committed to creating an inclusive, diverse workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to be themselves. Through our Equity, Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging (EDIB) policy, we ensure fair access to opportunities for all, regardless of background.

**Role: Data Engineer**

**Location: Sheffield (Hybrid \- 3 days a week)**

**Employment: Fulltime**

### **About the Role:**

* We are looking for an experienced **Azure Data Engineer** to support the design, development and delivery of modern data platform solutions, with a particular focus on **Microsoft Fabric migration and implementation**.
* You will play a key role in delivering data engineering and migration activities, working closely with engineering teams and stakeholders to deliver **high\-quality, scalable and well\-tested data solutions**.
* The role requires strong technical expertise across Azure data technologies, alongside the ability to provide technical guidance, communicate effectively and contribute to successful delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Configure data ingestion processes and solutions.
* Lead the execution of Microsoft Fabric migration activities.
* Lead and guide migration engineers and QA resources.
* Develop Python, PySpark and Spark SQL code for data validation and curation within notebooks.
* Create data integration test cases and support testing activities.
* Implement and amend data processing and worker pipelines.
* Implement data validation and curation rules.
* Translate data models and mappings into detailed technical data mappings.
* Design and implement data integrations.
* Support the implementation and execution of data migration activities.
* Perform data analysis and profiling.
* Configure Azure DevOps / GitHub environments and CI/CD processes for Azure Data Factory and Databricks code.

### **Essential Skills \& Experience:**

* We are looking for candidates with:
* Strong experience designing and delivering Azure\-based data platform solutions.
* Experience with technologies including: o Microsoft Fabric o Power Apps o Azure Synapse o Azure Data Factory (ADF) o Databricks o Azure Functions o Azure App Service o Logic Apps
* o Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) o Web Apps
* Hands\-on expertise in PySpark, SQL and Python.
* Good knowledge of real\-time streaming applications, preferably including Kafka, Azure Functions or Azure Service Bus.
* Strong understanding of Spark processing and performance tuning.
* Experience working with file formats and partitioning, including Parquet, JSON, XML and CSV.
* Experience with Azure DevOps / GitHub and CI/CD.
* Strong programming experience in Python, with knowledge of other programming languages beneficial.
* Experience with both synchronous and asynchronous interface approaches.
* Knowledge of data modelling, including 3NF, dimensional modelling and Data Vault 2\.0\.
* Experience working within Agile delivery environments.
* Ability to produce comprehensive technical documentation.
* Ability to set and manage realistic expectations around timescales, costs, benefits and measures of success.
* Power BI experience is desirable.

**The role requires experience across the following skill areas:**

* Data Engineering
* Software Design
* Analytics
* Data Management
* Data Modelling and Design
* Data Visualisation
* Database Design
* Release and Deployment

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience integrating and implementing data cataloguing tools such as Azure Purview / Collibra.
* Experience implementing and integrating visualisation tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with C\# application development, including ASP.NET MVC.

**About the Company**


At IMSERV, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award\-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

**About the Role**


As a Software Developer at IMSERV, you will be part of our Scrum teams, working with colleagues to craft software using modern Azure and C\# technologies. This includes creating unit tests, plus working with our Testers to meet our high quality standards. You will own the code throughout the entire product lifecycle, building an understanding of the market intent and tuning our outputs in conjunction with customer usage data to ensure success.

**Responsibilities**

* Write code and associated unit tests and documentation, plus resolve bugs as needed
* Update on progress as part of our scrum processes
* Be an active member of your Scrum team and the wider Product Engineering community
* Take part in sprint ceremonies, team events and similar activities
* Use agreed technical frameworks to design elements of software and contribute to larger elements as part of your team
* Manage the data required to perform your role, including conversion, test data generation and similar activities
* Design and create relevant MS SQL database elements as needed
* Manage artefacts within Azure DevOps
* Provide accurate estimates
* Contribute to the Scrum team productively

 **What you'll need**

*Knowledge and Qualifications*

* Has 5\+ Years of C\# as their primary language
* Strong appreciation for Object Orientation and designing good quality / well\-designed code
* Routinely practices TDD and a Unit Test first approach to their development
* Has worked in an Agile SCRUM team and is familiar with the associated ceremonies and artefacts
* Understands and can build or change tables and stored procedures written in SQL (in a Relational Database system)

*Skills*

Before making an application, please browse all graduate opportunities available as we will only accept **one application** per candidate. Once you have made an application you will not be able to make changes to your selection or make a new application. The exception is if we open new vacancies in the new year.  



**To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying** **as early as possible, as positions will close once filled.**

  

**Application process**

  

* Online strengths\-based assessment
* Application form
  

CVs and cover letters are not required as part of the application process. Candidates will be assessed through a single\-stage strengths\-based interview.

  

Start your career with a global, employee\-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one.

  

**Job Description**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we believe engineering is more than just infrastructure—it’s about shaping a future that’s resilient, inclusive, and sustainable. As climate change challenges our environment and communities, civil engineers are at the heart of creating solutions that protect natural resources, improve lives, and foster economic and social growth for generations to come.

  

We are looking for passionate Graduate Civil \& Structural Engineers to make a meaninful mpact across our Energy sectors, with opportunities in:

  

* Transmission \& Distribution
* Nuclear and Defence
* Hydropower
You’ll work alongside experienced professionals on projects that matter—helping to create better cities, reduce poverty, and improve public health. You’ll be immersed in a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

  

**Transmission \& Distribution**

  

  

You will play a key role in designing and delivering the infrastructure that powers the UK’s transition to Net Zero. With the growing demand for renewable energy, your work will help ensure clean energy reaches homes, businesses, and even international markets through interconnectors to Europe.You’ll be directly involved in the design of critical infrastructure that supports the transmission of low\-carbon energy across the UK.  



**Nuclear and Defence**

  

  

Play a vital role in delivering safe, sustainable, carbon\-free power. Our teams work across nuclear new build, existing generation, decommissioning, waste management and defence\-related programmes, helping clients solve highly regulated technical challenges throughout the project lifecycle. Working in this area offers the opportunity to contribute to safe, sustainable, carbon\-free power and critical national infrastructure, while being part of a trusted team committed to safety, innovation and long\-term impact.  



**Hydropower**


Focusing on the development and delivery of renewable power projects that generate electricity from water, including conventional hydropower and pumped storage schemes. Projects typically involve dams, reservoirs, tunnels, waterways, powerhouses and associated civil, structural and electro\-mechanical infrastructure. Working in hydropower offers the opportunity to contribute to low\-carbon energy, energy security and resilient infrastructure on complex projects in the UK and internationally.

  

Within each sector your role may include


* Front\-End Engineering Design (FEED) and Detailed Design phases
* Civil works design, including platforms (earthworks, embankments, retaining walls), access roads (temporary and permanent), and drainage systems (SuDS, Infodrainage)
* Structural design, covering foundations, beams, columns, and connections
* Feasibility studies and optioneering exercises to identify optimal solutions
* Site visits to assess conditions and support construction phases
**Candidate Specification**

  

At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose\-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in.

  

To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience **(excluding placements**) and have a minimum of a bachelors degree (obtained no earlier than 2025\) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines:


* Civil Engineering
* Structural Engineering
  

For some of our opportunities, a master’s degree is essential – this is reflected in the list of opportunities in the application form.

  

Some of these opportunities will require you to be eligible to achieve security clearance. Security clearance is dictated by the types of projects we work on and normally requires you to be a UK British national or lived in the UK for five years or more.

  

In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests \- such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects.

  

We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story.

  

We are looking for graduates with the following strengths:

  

* Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently.
* Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues.
* Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity.
* Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving.
  

**UK Immigration**


Mott MacDonald Ltd. are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\.


Our ethos is to develop, train and retain our graduates and therefore we are looking for a long\-term relationship with our graduates. For this reason, we cannot accept applications from candidates who would be working under the Graduate visa route or other time\-limited visas, (irrespective of visa duration), due to their temporary nature and the requirement for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route in future.


We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.

  

**AI Usage**


At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people\-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application.

  

**Accessibility**

We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at **reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com** and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help.

  

**About your development**


A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three\-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long\-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald.

  

**Our social side**

  

  

Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in.


From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community.


It's worth noting that sports and social committees tend to vary from office to office, so as well as getting involved in what’s already on offer, don’t be afraid to suggest new events or initiatives that you think could be a great addition. It doesn’t stop there. From your first day, you’ll have access to Perks at Work, giving you discounts on cinema tickets, travel, utilities and much more, helping you make the most of our employee benefits.

  

**Agile working**

At Mott MacDonald, we believe it makes business sense for you and your manager to choose how you can work most effectively to meet your client, team, and personal commitments. We offer a hybrid working policy that embraces your well\-being, flexibility, and trust.

  

**Equality, diversity, and inclusion**


We put equality, diversity, and inclusion at the heart of our business, seeking to promote fair employment procedures and practices to ensure equal opportunities for all. We encourage individual expression in our workplace and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where **everyone** feels they can contribute.

  

**We offer some fantastic benefits including:**

  

**Financial wellbeing**


* **Biannual salary reviews:** We believe hard work should be recognised and rewarded. To support your development and progression, you'll be eligible for salary reviews twice a year during your first three years with us, subject to successfully completing your probation period.
* We match employee pension contributions between 4\.5% and 7%.
* Life assurance equal up to 4 x your basic salary, with an option to increase the level of cover to 6 x your salary.
* Our income protection scheme provides a financial benefit, as well as absence and return to work support due to long\-term illness or injury.
* Flexible benefits, including increased life assurance cover, critical illness insurance, payroll saving and will writing.
* As an independently owned business we share the financial success of the business with all our colleagues in various ways including annual bonus schemes.
  

**Employee Ownership**


* Our employee ownership model means no external investors, just us, creating a culture of shared success.
* Our employees have a stake and a voice in our business, giving them a direct connection to our success through our personal and group performance bonuses.
* As your career grows, so does your stake, recognising your long\-term impact and contribution.
* Your voice matters, with the opportunity to connect directly with senior leadership through formal channels to help shape our future.
* For our senior roles you will have a direct pathway towards ownership from day one.
  

**Health and wellbeing**


* Private medical insurance for all UK colleagues.
* Health cash plan to support you with every day health costs and treatments.
* Access to Peppy, providing free support from menopause experts for all UK colleagues.
* A variety of wellbeing support is available through our comprehensive wellbeing program, including access for you and your family.
* Ability to flex your salary to opt into a wide range of health benefits, many of which can be extended to your family too.
  

**Lifestyle**

* 33 days holiday each year, inclusive of public holidays and dependent on level, with the ability to buy or sell leave through our flexible benefits programme.
* 10 days additional paid leave for Armed Forces Reservists and Cadet Force Adult Volunteers.
* Holiday entitlement increased to a minimum of 35 days after 5 years’ service.
* Variety of employee saving schemes and discounts from high\-street retailers.
  

**Enhanced family and carers leave**


* Enhanced family leave policies, including 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave, and two weeks paid paternity/partner leave.
* Our shared parental leave matches maternity leave meaning we pay up to 24 weeks at full pay.
* Up to five additional days leave are provided for those with significant caring responsibilities, two of which are paid.
* We offer policies and dedicated support to help military families balance service life with career and wellbeing.
  

**Learning and development**


* Primary annual professional institution subscription.
* A broad range of opportunities to enhance both technical and soft skills through mentoring, formal training, and self\-development options.
  

**Networks, communities, and social outcomes**


* Join a wide range of groups including our Advanced Employee Networks which support our LGBTQ\+, gender, race and ethnicity, disability, and parents/carers communities.
* We are proud signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant and Gold Award holders in the MOD Employer Recognition Scheme, supported by our dedicated internal Armed Forces Network.
* Make a difference within our communities through our social outcomes.

You will act as a Senior Consultant to deliver .Net Development services to our clients. Build great relationships with your team and stakeholders, identifying and ensuring that challenges are overcome.

Additional company pension contributions  
Additional holidays (up to an extra 2 days)

Charity contributions

At Hippo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace that works for everyone. Only by building a community of diverse perspectives, cultures and socio\-economic backgrounds can we create an environment where all can contribute and thrive.  


We actively encourage applications from underrepresented groups including women, ethnic minorities, LGBTQ\+, neurodivergent and people with disabilities. We are a registered Disability Confident Employer, Mindful Employer, Endometriosis Friendly Employer and a member of the Armed Forces Covenant. Hi, we’re Hippo

Hippo Locations

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

  

**Department Overview:**

We leverage cutting\-edge technologies to develop and maintain robust systems and infrastructure, ensuring the security, reliability, and efficiency of our operations. Join our team and be part of a dynamic and collaborative environment that embraces technological advancements to deliver value and drive our digital transformation journey.

The team builds and runs platforms underpinning Nomura's global Prime Brokerage offering, spanning both Cash Prime Brokerage (CPB) and Synthetic Prime Brokerage (SPB). Nomura is making significant strategic investment in its Prime Brokerage franchise, with multi\-million dollar technology investment driving the expansion of CPB and SPB capabilities globally. jobs.description:
**Senior Main Plant Design Engineer**

**Location** \- Prenton office with regular travel across the SP Manweb licence area and to project, contractor and stakeholder locations as required


**Hybrid work pattern:** 3 days per week in office.


**Salary \+ benefits** \- Salary up to £68,750 plus comprehensive benefits package including double matched pension scheme (up to 10% company contribution).


**Permanent \| Full\-time** \- 37 hours per week


**Closing date** – 9th October 2026

  

***Help us create a better future, quicker!***

  

Join SP Energy Networks' MANWEB business as a Senior Main Plant Design Engineer and play a key role in delivering safe, compliant and cost\-effective engineering solutions across our 132kV and 33kV networks throughout North Wales, Merseyside, Cheshire and North Shropshire. Reporting to the Principal Main Plant Engineer within SPM 132kV Networks, you will be responsible for developing technical solutions throughout the full project lifecycle, from feasibility and scope definition through to commissioning and operational handover.

  

  

This is an exciting opportunity to work on complex, high\-value projects that support network resilience, customer growth and the transition to a low\-carbon energy future. You will coordinate the design and delivery of plant equipment packages including transformers, switchgear, instrument transformers, surge arresters, busbars and auxiliary systems, providing expert technical guidance to project teams while championing safety by design, whole\-life asset value and engineering excellence across the MANWEB network area.

  

***What you'll be doing***

  

* Deliver engineering designs and technical solutions for 132kV and 33kV substation main plant equipment, supporting projects from feasibility through to commissioning.
* Prepare and review design calculations, specifications, drawings, technical reports and procurement documentation.
* Ensure designs comply with relevant legislation, CDM requirements, SP Energy Networks standards and industry best practice.
* Apply safety by design principles, identifying and mitigating risks throughout the asset lifecycle.
* Assess supplier and contractor proposals, providing technical recommendations on compliance, risk and whole\-life value.
* Review and verify designs produced by contractors, consultants and manufacturers, ensuring technical quality and compliance.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams including protection \& control, cables, overhead lines, civil engineering, operations and commissioning.
* Provide technical support during manufacture, installation, testing and commissioning, resolving engineering issues as they arise.
* Contribute to technical innovation, continuous improvement and the development of engineering standards and specifications.
* Support the development of engineers, graduates and trainees through mentoring and technical guidance.
  

***What you'll bring***

  

* Degree, HNC or HND in Electrical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Significant experience in high\-voltage substation main plant design, ideally within 132kV and associated 33kV networks.
* Strong knowledge of transformers, AIS/GIS switchgear, instrument transformers, surge arresters, busbars, earthing systems and auxiliary plant.
* Experience preparing and reviewing engineering calculations, specifications, reports, drawings and design documentation.
* Good understanding of CDM regulations, health and safety requirements, and relevant industry standards.
* Experience assessing contractor, consultant and supplier designs and identifying technical risks and non\-compliances.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, engineering judgement and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience mentoring and supporting developing engineers is desirable.
* Professional registration, or progress towards Incorporated or Chartered Engineer status, is advantageous.
* Full UK driving licence, with willingness to travel across the SP Manweb licence area as required.
  

***What's in it for you***

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action \- our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world \- today and tomorrow.

  

  

That's why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase \- perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave
* Equity Plans
* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers \- save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes \- to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

  

SP Energy Networks is part of ScottishPower and of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We have 30,000 substations (1 for every 100 customers), 40,000km overhead lines (that's once around the globe!) and 65,000km underground cables. It’s a role that puts us right at the heart of ScottishPower’s ambition to be Net Zero by 2035\. And we’re taking it very seriously.

  

  

With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.


Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all kinds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you’ll fit right in.

  

  

We are committed to providing reasonable support or adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related support. If you need support, please reach out to careers@scottishpower.com .


**Mobility**

Please note that any applicant who is not a citizen of the country of the vacancy will be subject to compliance with the applicable immigration requirements to legally work in that country. If/when required, the Company will support the employee with the necessary Immigration requirements.

If you're ready to apply your Engineering knowledge to projects that power communities and enable renewable energy growth, this role offers genuine impact and career development.

  

**What you'll be doing**

Taking ownership of developing pre\-contract Design information and providing technical guidance for project delivery teams, you will focus on Overhead Line systems and associated equipment.

  

Your accountabilities include preparing detailed Engineering specifications and designs for high\-value Transmission projects, ensuring all work aligns with current legislation, policies and operational requirements.

  

Conducting technical assessments of submissions, providing clear recommendations to project teams, you will define equipment requirements for System Construction Authorisation and Project Technical Specifications, as well as prepare and review O verhead L ine drawings and technical specifications for construction, procurement, and stakeholders.

  

Assisting with the resolution of site and construction issues forms a key part of this position. Providing technical expertise to Pre\-Contract and Project Delivery teams on matters concerning D esign, C onstruction, O peration and M aintenance of O verhead L ine systems, you will also prepare project quality documentation, ensuring all deliverables meet SP Energy Networks quality processes and standards.

  

Driving innovation and industry best practice is essential. You will evaluate new technologies, equipment, materials and alternative working methods to deliver cost savings, improve efficiencies and enhance safety outcomes. Working across global multidisciplinary Engineering teams, you will contribute to integrated, end\-to\-end solutions that keep our T ransmission network operating reliably and efficiently.

  

**What you'll bring**

You will ideally hold a degree in Electrical/Mechanical/Civil Engineering or HND with equivalent practical experience and be working towards membership of a professional institution.

  

Significant experience in an Engineering position focused on Transmission network Overhead Lines and associated equipment is essential. You must demonstrate proven capability in delivering Engineering solutions and Designs for high\-value, complex Transmission Overhead Line projects.

  

Effective communication skills are required, along with the ability to build productive working relationships across departments and businesses. You will need the capability to implement and promote CDM and Health \& Safety best practice within a Design environment, representing departments or project teams on Overhead Line Engineering issues, evaluations, standards and industry best practice.

  

The ability to write clear, concise reports and technical documents is essential, as is the capability to communicate with and influence Senior Management. Experience using Overhead Line system Design software is preferable.

  

You must be flexible with working hours to meet project needs and willing to undertake short trips away from home as required.

  

**What's in it for you**

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.

  

At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action \- our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world \- today and tomorrow. That's why our benefits include:

  

* 36 days annual leave


* Holiday Purchase \- perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave


* Equity Plans


* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding


* Technology Vouchers \- save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases


* Electric Vehicle Schemes \- to help you transition to green/clean driving


* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans


* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments


* Life Assurance (4x salary)


* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing assistance


* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more

  

**Why SP Energy Networks**

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world energy provider in wind energy. We keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses through Central and Southern Scotland, North Wales and in the North West of England. We operate over 4000km of cables and lines that make\-up the transmission network \- connecting infrastructure like wind farms into the electricity system. It's a role that puts us right at the heart of Scotland's goal to be Net Zero by 2044\. And we're taking it very seriously. We're investing \>£5\.5 billion into our transmission network, directly enabling the rapid growth needed in renewable energy. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a focus on investing in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Combined with our values, they bring us into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. It takes all backgrounds of people to build a large\-scale business like ours, so whatever your background, you'll fit right in.

  

We are dedicated to providing reasonable adjustments in our recruiting processes for candidates with disabilities, long term conditions, mental health conditions, or who are neurodivergent or require pregnancy\-related assistance. jobs.title: Development Engineer
jobs.description:

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.


We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

  



**Job Description**

  



Teledyne Gas \& Flame Detection uses its global capability, manufacturing excellence and custom engineering to provide end\-to\-end gas and flame detection solutions for a wide range of hazards worldwide. With an industry\-leading, comprehensive portfolio of products and services, our commitment to cross\-platform integration provides protection for today and confidence for tomorrow. Our products are sold through a world class system of knowledgeable distributors, manufacturers' representatives and sales subsidiaries. Our customer commitment does not stop at product delivery but encompasses ongoing services. From custom\-designed solutions to unmatched technical support, our gas and flame detection solutions are backed by expert judgment and premier technology that you can trust.

  

We are looking for an experienced development engineer who has a strong understanding of software to join a motivated team of engineering staff in our product design and development group in Renfrew, UK.

  

As well as developing gas detector instruments, Teledyne GMI also develops a variety of calibration systems and software applications to complement our products. These software applications are used to manage the calibration process of our equipment, allow data to be extracted from our equipment locally or remotely via Ethernet or Wireless interfaces) and can push extracted data into networked SQL or Cloud based platforms for dashboard visualization, report generation, data analysis and record retention.

 **Main** **Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Full lifecycle software applications development
* Designing, coding and debugging applications in various software languages.
* Front end graphical user interface design (Windows desktop applications.)
* Verification and testing that software design output meets input requirements.
* Support, maintain and upgrade of software products/packages.
* Project Planning and Project Management.
* Preparation of software related documentation including design specifications, test plans and verification reports.

 **Skills/Experience:\-**

* C\# (.net ), Visual C\+\+ (MFC), VB, HTML, PHP, SQL
* Microsoft Visual Studio and .NET framework (for desktop and embedded applications)
* Data communication over Serial UARTs, Ethernet, Wireless, TCP/IP
* SQL Server management and authentication
* Knowledge and understanding of Debian Linux distribution running MONO for .net framework embedded applications advantageous
* Development of applications to run on iOS and Android advantageous.
* Software development methodologies
* Working in an agile/scrum based environment

 **Qualifications:**

* Honours Degree qualified in Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar experience in a similar role.

* Planning/Organizing – Manages time and priorities, able to work to deadlines

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. jobs.title: .NET Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Bromcom is a leading provider of cloud\-based software solutions for the education sector. We develop innovative Management Information Systems (MIS), Finance and Analytics solutions that support schools, Multi\-Academy Trusts (MATs) and Local Authorities across the UK.


Our mission is to transform the way educational organisations work by providing secure, intuitive and innovative technology that helps schools operate more efficiently and enables educators to focus on what matters most – delivering outstanding outcomes for children and young people.


As Bromcom continues to grow, we are investing in our people, products and technology to support our ambitious plans for the future. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing technology team and play a key role in developing and enhancing solutions used by education organisations across the UK.

**The Role**


The .NET Full\-Stack Developer is responsible for developing, maintaining and enhancing web applications across both backend and frontend technologies.


Working as part of a collaborative development team, the role will contribute to the design and delivery of reliable, scalable and maintainable software solutions. The successful candidate will have a solid foundation in full\-stack development, with particular experience in .NET and C\#, alongside the ability and enthusiasm to learn and work with new technologies as required.


The role will also involve using AI\-assisted development tools to support software development, including code generation, troubleshooting, testing and productivity. The successful candidate will be comfortable working alongside AI tools while applying their own technical knowledge and judgement to review, validate and refine AI\-generated outputs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain and enhance web applications across both backend and frontend components.
* Develop reliable and scalable backend services and APIs using .NET and C\#.
* Contribute to frontend development using modern web technologies and frameworks.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to support coding, debugging, testing, research and problem\-solving.
* Review, validate and refine AI\-generated code and recommendations, applying sound technical judgement and development standards.
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-tested code in line with agreed development standards.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, testing and debugging activities to maintain high standards of software quality.
* Work collaboratively with Business Analysts, Developers, QA and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, practices and technical solutions.
* Quickly learn and apply new technologies, tools, frameworks and AI\-assisted development approaches where required.
* Support the delivery of high\-quality software within agreed timescales.

**Skills \& Experience**

**Essential**

* Practical experience in full\-stack software development.
* Strong working knowledge of .NET and C\#.
* Experience developing web applications and backend services/APIs.
* Understanding of frontend development and modern web technologies.
* Good understanding of software development principles and practices.
* Experience troubleshooting, debugging and resolving technical issues.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable and well\-tested code.
* Experience or demonstrated ability to work effectively with AI\-assisted development tools, using them to support coding, debugging, testing and problem\-solving.
* Ability to critically review and validate AI\-generated code and suggestions, ensuring outputs are secure, accurate, maintainable and aligned with development standards.
* Strong underlying software development fundamentals, with the ability to understand, adapt and take ownership of AI\-assisted outputs.
* Experience working collaboratively within a software development team.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies and frameworks quickly.

**Desirable**

* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar tools.
* Working within an Agile software development environment.
* Experience with automated testing and/or test\-driven development.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks and technologies.
* Experience participating in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious and adaptable – keen to learn new technologies and develop their technical knowledge.
* AI\-aware and forward\-thinking – open to adopting AI\-assisted development tools while applying sound technical judgement to ensure they are used effectively and responsibly.
* A strong problem solver – able to investigate issues logically and identify practical solutions.
* Collaborative – comfortable working with developers, QA, Business Analysts and wider stakeholders.
* Quality focused – takes pride in producing reliable, maintainable and well\-tested code.
* Proactive – willing to contribute ideas and look for opportunities to improve processes and solutions.
* A strong communicator – able to explain technical issues and work effectively with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.

jobs.title: Overhead Line (OHL) Engineer – Ireland (Energy)
jobs.description:

**A little more about your role…**

Ireland is playing a critical role in delivering the future energy network.


Significant investment is being made in transmission infrastructure across the country, with major reinforcement programmes, new connections for renewable generation and strategic network upgrades helping to support Net Zero ambitions. Overhead line infrastructure will be central to this transformation, and WSP is supporting many of the projects that will shape the next generation of the UK's electricity network.


As a Senior Overhead Line Engineer, you will join a growing team delivering complex transmission projects across Ireland and the wider. Working from our Belfast, Nass or Dublin offices, you will provide technical leadership on projects ranging from network reinforcement schemes through to major new transmission connections supporting offshore wind, renewable energy and grid infrastructure developments.


You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, environmental, planning and project delivery disciplines, helping clients develop and deliver safe, efficient and sustainable overhead line solutions.


This is an opportunity to play a leading role in some of the most significant energy infrastructure projects currently being developed across Ireland, while helping to grow and strengthen WSP's overhead line capability in the region.


**Why join our Ireland Energy Networks team?**

* **Help Deliver Ireland's Energy Transition** : Play a key role in developing the transmission infrastructure required to connect renewable generation and support the UK's journey to Net Zero.
* **Work on Major Infrastructure Projects** : Contribute to high\-profile overhead line projects ranging from 11kV to 400kV, supporting network operators, developers and major energy clients.
* **Build Local Capability** : Be part of WSP's continued investment in Ireland, helping to grow a strong local overhead line engineering capability.
* **Technical Leadership Opportunities** : Share your expertise, mentor engineers and contribute to the development of best practice across a growing team.
* **Multidisciplinary Collaboration** : Work alongside specialists in substations, power systems, cables, environmental services, planning and asset management.
* **Professional Development** : Access structured development programmes, mentoring, Chartership support and opportunities to progress into technical, project or people leadership roles.
* **Flexible and Hybrid Working** : Balance local office collaboration with flexible working arrangements that support both project delivery and personal wellbeing.

**This is an excellent opportunity to…**

Join a growing overhead line engineering team delivering some of the most strategically important electricity transmission projects, with particular focus on Ireland's expanding transmission network.


* Lead and support the delivery of overhead line engineering and design activities across transmission and distribution projects ranging from 11kV to 400kV.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to engineers within multidisciplinary project teams.
* Prepare technical reports, design documentation, specifications and engineering proposals to support project development and delivery.
* Undertake overhead line design activities including route development, PLS\-CADD modelling, structure spotting, clearance assessments, structure loading, conductor and insulator selection and line optimisation studies.
* Carry out sag\-tension calculations, blowout assessments, swing angle studies and other technical analyses required for overhead line design.
* Support feasibility studies and option assessments to identify technically preferred solutions for clients and stakeholders.
* Provide technical input during stakeholder engagement, statutory planning processes and public consultation activities.
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure designs comply with industry standards, client requirements and applicable regulations.
* Support project delivery through design reviews, technical assurance processes and quality management activities.
* Contribute to the development of innovative engineering solutions that improve performance, reduce risk and enhance constructability.
Actively contribute to technical excellence initiatives and industry forums, helping to shape the future of overhead line engineering.  
* 

**What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…**

* Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Power Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in the design and delivery of overhead transmission line projects up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of overhead line design principles, including structure spotting, route optimisation, conductor selection, clearance assessments and line performance requirements.
* Experience supporting major transmission infrastructure projects, grid reinforcement schemes, renewable energy connections or wider energy network developments.
* Experience of conductor upgrade projects, including the application of High Temperature Low Sag (HTLS) conductor technologies and network optimisation solutions.
* Working knowledge of industry design standards, utility requirements and engineering best practice relating to overhead transmission systems.
* Experience using industry\-standard design tools such as PLS\-CADD, PLS\-TOWER and PLS\-POLE would be highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of advanced technical studies including conductor galloping assessments, EMF and field effects calculations, acoustic assessments, wake effects and AC interference studies would be beneficial.
* Ability to provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor to clients, project managers and engineering teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical discussions and build strong working relationships.
* Experience supporting or participating in technical committees, working groups and professional organisations such as CIGRE, IEEE or IET would be advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status (CEng), or a demonstrable commitment towards achieving professional registration.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites and client locations across Ireland, the UK and internationally where required.
A passion for helping shape Ireland's future energy network and contributing to the continued growth of WSP's overhead line engineering capability.  
* 

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?


**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**\#LI\-TD1**


  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.


**Inclusivity \& Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.


**Health \& Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.


Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.


**Flex your time**

To enhance work\-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.


We also provide part\-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.


**Your development**

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.*
