By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.


It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

**Kraken Generation Flex**
--------------------------


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean\-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.


Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market\-connected, controllable assets.

**Where you’ll fit in and role summary**
----------------------------------------


As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.


You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market\-participating asset.


Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering\-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Integration design contribution:** With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.
* **Technical judgement:** Develop your technical judgement, making well\-reasoned decisions and trade\-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.
* **Developing domain knowledge:** Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.
* **Gateway application \& configuration:** Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.
* **Hardware and Software Deployments:** Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.
* **Networking and cyber security:** Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.
* **Site testing \& commissioning:** Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.
* **Incidents \& compliance:** Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

**What you'll bring to the party**
----------------------------------

* **Understanding of the Regulations:** Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid\-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.
* **Understanding of the UK Energy Markets:** Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.
* **Technical judgement:** Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.
* **Power plant systems:** Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.
* **Asset integration:** Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid\-scale and/or C\&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.
* **Integration design:** Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.
* **Hardware and Networking:** Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.
* **Industrial Communication Protocols:** Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61400\-25, OPC\-UA or DNP3 is a plus.
* **CAD, Diagrams and Tools:** Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.
* **Communication:** A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.
* **Commissioning landscape:** Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.
* **Engineering background:** Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field \- or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.
* **A proactive and collaborative mindset:** You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

**️ Bonus points**
------------------

* Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.
* Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge\-deployment architectures.
* Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git\-based workflows.
* Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).
* Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO\-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

*Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!*

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Autonomy)
jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.  

  

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence\-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.  

  

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command\-and\-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter\-UAS systems.

**About the role**


The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Autonomy) will design, build, and operate software capabilities that improve the mission effectiveness and safety of uncrewed surface vehicles across the UFORCE C2/C4ISR stack.


This role spans **Perception Autonomy, Autonomy Behaviours**—including collision avoidance (COLAV), target\-based manoeuvring and engagement—and **Swarm Intelligence**. You will take cross\-system initiatives from design and implementation through scenario\-based verification, field trials, deployment, and iteration.


The role requires strong software engineering and mathematical foundations, with an emphasis on autonomy that remains safe, observable, and useful in real operating conditions—including degraded sensors, different sea states, and GNSS\- or RF\-challenged environments.

### **What you’ll do**

* Build production\-grade capabilities across perception, autonomous behaviours, COLAV, and multi\-USV coordination.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria for autonomy performance, safety, reliability, and operator trust.
* Validate perception and behaviours across day/night operations, different sea states, sensor degradation, and GNSS/RF\-challenged conditions.
* Develop swarm capabilities such as task allocation, role assignment, formation control, and distributed sensing.
* Build scenario libraries, replay tooling, automated metrics, and CI gates to prevent regressions.
* Introduce structured logging, playback, and failure classification to accelerate field diagnosis.
* Build operator controls and safeguards that enable crews to use autonomy without continuous engineering support.
* Collaborate with platform, C2, product, and field teams to define clear interfaces and deliver cross\-system capabilities.

### **What success looks like**

* Perception and COLAV meet agreed performance and safety criteria in representative trials.
* Swarm capabilities are used routinely in multi\-USV exercises and degrade safely under constraints.
* Operators can configure and use autonomy without day\-to\-day engineering intervention.
* Automated scenario testing prevents safety and reliability regressions.
* Field failures can be reproduced and diagnosed within an agreed timeframe.
* Capabilities have documented operating envelopes, limitations, and evidence of field readiness.

### **Required qualifications**

* 8\+ years of production software or backend engineering experience.
* Strong experience with **Java, Python, or .NET/C\#**.
* Strong mathematical foundations relevant to autonomy and robotics.
* Experience with distributed, real\-time, event\-driven, or mission\-critical systems.
* Understanding of sockets, UDP, latency, packet loss, and low\-level protocols.
* Strong testing, observability, debugging, and operational ownership.
* Clear communication and cross\-team collaboration skills.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with **C\+\+, Rust, or C**.
* Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, maritime autonomy, or UxV systems.
* Knowledge of perception, sensor fusion, navigation, planning, or control systems.
* Experience with COLAV, simulation, replay tooling, or multi\-agent systems.
* Experience in defence, C2/C4ISR, or constrained operating environments.


The nature of combat has changed.


Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.


And UFORCE is ready.


Are You?

jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Senior Test Automation Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of automated testing solutions to ensure the highest quality of software products. Your expertise will drive continuous improvement in testing processes, streamline release cycles, and support our commitment to delivering reliable, scalable, and user\-centric applications. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment and are passionate about quality assurance and innovative testing strategies, this is the perfect opportunity to make an impact.

**Duties**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, Cucumber, TestNG, and JUnit to validate software functionality across multiple platforms including web, mobile (Android and iOS), and APIs.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including developers, business analysts, and DevOps—to understand requirements and translate them into effective test cases and automation frameworks.
* Execute comprehensive system testing, functional testing, performance testing with LoadRunner or similar tools, and user acceptance testing to verify software meets specified requirements.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines utilizing Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub, or Azure DevOps to facilitate rapid feedback loops and continuous delivery.
* Perform root cause analysis on defects identified during testing phases; troubleshoot issues related to software bugs, network configurations, or environment inconsistencies using debugging tools and system analysis techniques.
* Support release management activities by validating new builds, coordinating regression tests, and ensuring smooth deployment processes across different environments.
* Contribute to SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) best practices by participating in requirements gathering, design reviews, and documentation of test plans and results.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in test automation development using Selenium WebDriver with programming languages such as Java or C\#.
* Strong understanding of continuous integration/delivery pipelines with tools like Jenkins or GitLab for automated build and test execution.
* Extensive knowledge of software testing methodologies including functional testing, system testing, performance testing (using LoadRunner or similar), API testing (REST/SOAP), and user acceptance testing.
* Familiarity with SDLC frameworks such as Waterfall or Scrum/Agile methodologies; experience working within Scrum teams preferred.
* Proficiency in scripting languages like Python or Bash for automation tasks; experience with SQL databases (MySQL, Oracle) for data validation is a plus.
* Ability to perform root cause analysis and troubleshooting on complex software issues; strong debugging skills are essential.
* Experience working with version control systems such as GitHub, GitLab or SVN; familiarity with TFS is advantageous.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS or Azure for environment setup and performance testing is desirable.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to gather requirements from business stakeholders and translate them into technical test cases.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively across teams and document testing procedures clearly.

Join us to be at the forefront of quality assurance innovation! Your expertise will help shape reliable software solutions that empower users worldwide while advancing your career in a vibrant tech environment committed to excellence.

Pay: £40,832\.27\-£74,880\.14 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**At Pluxee, we shape the world of employee benefits and engagement by bringing to life a personalized and sustainable employee experience, at work and beyond.**

Permanent Regular **Job Description:**


The Principal Engineer is the senior individual contributor responsible for technical leadership, solution architecture and engineering excellence across Pluxee UK’s .NET\-based digital products and platforms.  

  

s a Principle Engineer you will expected to:
  

  

Own and influence end\-to\-end technical direction across product discovery, design, delivery and operation. It combines hands\-on engineering with architectural leadership, ensuring that solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, maintainable and aligned with measurable business outcomes.
  

  

Support and enhance existing internally developed products while shaping new products and platform capabilities across Payments, Discounts, Benefits, Rewards, Salesforce, Business Central, Analytics, mobile applications and web portals.
  

  

Provide technical direction across squads, establishes engineering guardrails, manages technical debt and ensures adherence to internal governance, audit, security, privacy and accessibility requirements. A key objective is to align the UK technology landscape and product needs with global enterprise standards, strategies and reusable platform capabilities.**YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE**

* Deliver scalable, secure, resilient and cost\-effective end\-to\-end technical solutions that meet product, business, functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Provide visible technical leadership that improves engineering quality, delivery confidence, team capability and consistency across squads.
* Align product technology roadmaps with business strategy, Pluxee enterprise standards, security requirements and global platform direction.
* Ensure architecture decisions, system documentation and operational controls are current, traceable and suitable for governance and audit.

**Technical leadership for products and platforms**

* Own and evolve the end\-to\-end technical architecture for .NET digital products and shared platform capabilities. Act as the senior technical authority for product squads, resolving complex design decisions and providing clear, pragmatic technical direction.
* Remain hands\-on through prototypes, reference implementations, code reviews, troubleshooting and targeted delivery of high\-risk or high\-value components.
* Partner with Product Owners, Product Managers and Digital Asset Owners to translate product outcomes into coherent technical capabilities, features and user stories.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies and constraints early, with proportionate mitigation and decision records

**Engineering excellence and software quality**

* Establish and promote engineering standards covering clean architecture, SOLID principles, secure coding, automated testing, code quality and maintainability.
* Define guardrails for APIs, event\-driven integration, data access, error handling, logging, monitoring and operational readiness.
* Champion performance engineering, resilience testing, accessibility by design and production supportability.
* Coach engineers and technical lead through design reviews, pairing, code reviews and communities of practice
* Lead root\-cause analysis for complex technical issues and ensure systemic improvements are captured in product backlogs.

**Architecture governance and documentation**

* Maintain an accurate architecture repository and system inventory covering applications, integrations, infrastructure, data flows, technology standards and lifecycle status.
* Produce and maintain solution context, container, component, deployment, sequence, integration and data\-flow views at an appropriate level of detail.
* Document significant decisions using architecture decision records and ensure designs remain traceable to product and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead solution design reviews and assure country\-specific solutions against Pluxee global enterprise architecture and security standards.

**Modernisation, cloud and DevOps**

* Shape modernisation roadmaps for legacy .NET applications, including incremental decomposition, API enablement, cloud adoption and technical debt retirement.
* Guide the appropriate use of Azure services, containers, application services, messaging, API management, relational and NoSQL data platforms.
* Improve continuous integration, continuous delivery, automated quality controls, infrastructure management, observability and release safety.
* Promote cost\-effective architecture and operational practices, including capacity planning, service ownership and FinOps awareness.
* Lead the adoption of reusable global components and shared platforms where they meet UK product and regulatory needs

**Security, compliance and operational integrity**

* Ensure threat modelling, secure design, privacy by design, vulnerability management and data protection controls are integrated into engineering ways of working.
* Work with security, risk, architecture and operations stakeholders to address audit findings and maintain evidence of appropriate controls.
* Define non\-functional requirements and acceptance criteria for availability, recoverability, performance, security, accessibility and support.
* Ensure technical designs include suitable monitoring, alerting, backup, disaster recovery and incident response considerations.

**YOU ARE A MATCH IF...**  

  

**Education**:  

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Relevant Microsoft Azure or architecture certifications are advantageous.  

  

**Work Experience:**

* Extensive experience designing, building and operating enterprise\-grade .NET products, with demonstrable technical leadership across multiple delivery teams or complex platforms.
* Deep practical knowledge of C\#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, asynchronous messaging and SQL\-based data platforms.
* Experience modernising legacy .NET Framework applications, including MVC, Entity Framework, T\-SQL, stored procedures, Web API, SOAP and WCF integrations.
* Strong knowledge of software architecture and design patterns, domain\-driven design, modular architecture, microservices trade\-offs, integration patterns and API lifecycle management.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure services such as App Service, Functions, Service Bus or queues, API Management, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, containers and monitoring services.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, code quality controls, observability, incident diagnosis, reliability engineering and DevSecOps practices.
* Knowledge of application security, identity and access management, OWASP guidance, threat modelling, privacy by design and relevant compliance requirements.
* Experience producing high\-quality architecture artefacts, including context and container views, integration diagrams, data\-flow diagrams, deployment views, technology roadmaps and architecture decision records.
* Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, senior leaders, auditors and suppliers.

 **Desirable technical skills:**

* Experience in payments, prepaid cards, employee benefits, rewards, vouchers, cashback or regulated financial services.
* Experience with frontend or cross\-platform technologies such as Blazor, modern JavaScript frameworks or .NET MAUI.
* Experience operating in a multi\-country enterprise and integrating global platforms with country\-specific products.
* Understanding FinOps, cloud cost optimisation, accessibility standards and software supply\-chain security.

**Languages**:  

Fluent English; French is advantageous

**Location**


Hybrid \- Milton Keynes office.

 **Why join Pluxee?**

 **Join an inclusive team**


Work at the heart of the community alongside 5,000 experts across 29 countries \- we embrace diversity and value uniqueness, fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive.

**Turn inspiration into possibility**


Get space to try new ideas, experiment and move the world of work forward as you bring new digital experiences \- and moments of connection \- to millions of people.

**Make a positive impact**


Touch millions of lives and create meaningful change for people and the world we share, supporting our commitments to diversity, sustainability, and local economies.

**Grow with us**


Get support you need to take meaningful steps in your career, whether you're performing your work/life balance or learning new skills.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Customer & Claims
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HOMEPROTECT**

**Cover for Almost every Home**


We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle \- to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.


If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.

**What It's Like to Work Here**


Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions \- all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.


We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first\-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.


We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years \- most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

**ROLE PURPOSE**


Customer \& Claims brings together three connected parts of Homeprotect's business: the shared digital experience customers and partners use across every channel, the tools our operations teams use to support customers directly, and the end\-to\-end claims journey, from a customer first reporting a loss through to their claim being settled. It's the team most responsible for how Homeprotect actually feels to a customer, whichever door they come through.


Fairer Finance rates us as the UK's most transparent Home Insurer. This team plays a central part in that reputation: the systems you build directly shape how trustworthy and easy Homeprotect feels at the moments that matter most to customers.


We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead technical delivery within this team and raise the capability of the engineers around them. You'll take ownership of complex, customer\-facing systems and claims workflows, make sound architectural decisions with minimal guidance, and be a trusted technical voice for a domain that touches nearly every interaction a customer has with Homeprotect.


Success in this role means the systems you own are reliable, well understood and easy for others to build on, and the engineers around you are visibly better because you're on the team.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Ownership \& Delivery**

* Lead the design, delivery and operation of complex features and systems across the domain, whether that's customer\-facing journeys, operational tooling for our support teams, or the claims lifecycle, depending on where you're needed most.
* Make significant architectural and technical decisions independently, and document the reasoning behind them so others can build on the work without needing you present.
* Lead delivery of complex, often cross\-functional initiatives, balancing speed, quality and long\-term sustainability.
* Identify and address technical debt and risk in the domain before it becomes a business or customer problem.
**Product \& Business Partnership**

* Develop a deep understanding of how customers interact with Homeprotect across channels, and of what happens when something goes wrong and a claim is made, and use that understanding to help shape what the team builds.
* Partner with the domain's Product Manager and Engineering Manager to spot opportunities and risks early, before they turn into problems.
* Bring a domain perspective into technical decisions, and a technical perspective into product decisions, particularly where customer experience and claims handling intersect.
**Technical Leadership \& Mentoring**

* Coach and mentor other engineers, raising the technical standard of the team through code review, pairing and everyday guidance.
* Be a trusted voice on technical decisions, sought out by others in the team.
* Create an environment where less experienced engineers can grow and do their best work.
**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive improvements to engineering practices, testing, deployment and observability within the domain.
* Continuously grow your own capability and that of the engineers around you.
* Contribute to Homeprotect's wider engineering standards as they mature.


.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience as a senior software engineer, owning delivery of complex systems or cross\-functional technical initiatives, not just individual features.
* Strong track record of making sound architectural and design decisions with minimal guidance, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind them.
* Experience mentoring and raising the technical capability of other engineers, through code review, pairing and everyday coaching.
* Comfortable working across the stack relevant to customer\-facing systems: frontend and backend, or deep expertise in one with a working knowledge of the other.
* Strong hands\-on experience in at least one modern backend language, such as C\# or Java (or a comparable object\-oriented language), and familiarity with a modern frontend framework.
* Deep, hands\-on understanding of modern software engineering practices: continuous integration and deployment, automated testing, observability and cloud\-native development.
* Experience operating production systems, in a public cloud environment such as Azure or GCP, that need to be reliable, secure and performant.
* Strong communication skills, able to build trust with both engineers and non\-technical colleagues.
**Desirable**

* Experience in general insurance, financial services or another regulated industry.
* Experience building customer\-facing digital journeys at scale, or systems supporting operational or customer service teams.
* Experience with claims handling, case management, or similarly regulated end\-to\-end business processes.
* Exposure to event\-driven or distributed systems.
* Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve engineering productivity.
**BENEFITS**


We want you to feel rewarded, supported and set up to thrive throughout your career with us.

**Learning and Growth:** We invest in your development through structured learning, mentoring, buddying, on\-the\-job experience and cross\-functional projects. We support role\-relevant professional qualifications where they'll make the biggest difference, and our Lunch and Learn sessions to help you stay connected to what’s going on right across the business.

**Health and Wellbeing:** Your wellbeing matters here. We offer private healthcare through BUPA, an Employee Assistance Programme covering legal, financial and counselling support for you, a Wellbeing Centre with online tools and resources, regular wellbeing seminars and workshops, annual flu jabs and an annual eye care voucher.

**Financial Security and Reward:** We offer an annual discretionary bonus scheme upto 30% of your base pay, life insurance at four times your salary, and a pension with Aegon. You'll also receive a significant discount on Homeprotect home insurance \- with a friends and family discount too, and a staff referral bonus when someone you recommend joins the team.

**Time Off:** 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell up to five additional days each year.

**Genuine Flexible Working** We trust our people to work in a way that best suits them \- with flexible working to balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life. We ask that everyone comes into the office at least once a week, as we believe in\-person connection is important for collaboration, culture and building great relationships. You'll receive a homeworking starter kit from day one and can claim towards additional home office equipment within your first six months.

**Purpose and Community:** We care about more than just the work. Through our charity partnership with Refuge, the UK's largest specialist domestic abuse charity and regular social, wellbeing and charitable events throughout the year, there are plenty of ways to connect, give back and feel part of something bigger.

**UNIQUE AS STANDARD**


We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from all backgrounds. We believe in celebrating difference \- everything that makes both our customers and our people unique. We consider visa sponsorship on a case by case basis for the right candidate, so please don't let that stop you from applying.


We encourage you to let us know if you need any extra help with your application or have any requirements at any stage of the recruitment journey, we want the process to work for you.

*Your data will be maintained in line with our recruitment data privacy policy.*

***Regulatory Responsibilities***

*As an FCA regulated insurer, doing the right thing isn't a compliance requirement \- it's simply how we work. All colleagues are expected to uphold the FCA Individual Conduct Rules (1–6\) and act with integrity, due skill and care, openness with regulators and a genuine commitment to delivering good outcomes for our customers.*

*You'll work within approved processes and authority limits, keep accurate and auditable records, protect data under UK GDPR and our information security policies, escalate risks and exceptions promptly, report incidents, breaches and any financial crime or sanctions concerns (including via whistleblowing), support vulnerable customers with reasonable adjustments, and complete all mandatory training to maintain competence.*

*If the role falls within SM\&CR, a supplementary document outlining the key regulatory responsibilities will be provided.*

jobs.title: Front End Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

As a Front\-End Developer at Ultima Displays, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing user facing features and intuitive interfaces for both internal and customer\-facing web applications. Your primary focus will be to deliver engaging, visually appealing, and highly responsive user experiences by leveraging Blazor and a suite of modern web technologies.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the internal and external members of the technology team to help build web solutions for our customers and colleagues. You will gather requirements directly from stakeholders across departments, translating their needs into robust, accessible, and high\-performance web solutions.

You will take ownership of the front\-end architecture, from prototyping and interface design through to deployment and optimisation. This includes ensuring best practices in responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and web performance are adhered to at all stages of development.

A strong awareness of current trends and advancements in front\-end development is expected, as you will proactively recommend and champion the adoption of new tools, frameworks, or workflows to continually enhance the development process and end\-user experience.

Ultimately, your work will play a key role in shaping Ultima Displays’ digital presence and supporting business growth by building seamless, modern, and robust web interfaces tailored to the needs of both staff and customers

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain modern, responsive web interfaces using technologies like Blazor, React or Angular and HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional components.
* Work with the full\-stack developer to integrate front\-end components with APIs and backend services.
* Optimise web applications for speed, scalability, and accessibility across devices and browsers.
* Write clean, maintainable code and participate in code reviews. Follow version control and CI/CD practices.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve delivery speed, code quality, documentation, and testing, ensuring all generated or suggested code is reviewed, understood, secure, and aligned with internal development standards.
* Stay current with front\-end trends and technologies. Recommend improvements to tooling, frameworks, and workflows.

**Essential skills or qualifications:**

* Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Blazor and other frameworks Vue, React and Angular.
* Experience with responsive design and cross\-browser compatibility.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs and integration with backend services.
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG) and performance optimisation.
* Experience with Git, Visual Studio Code, and front\-end build tools (e.g. Webpack, Vite).
* Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot or similar, to support development productivity, code refactoring, documentation, test generation, and problem\-solving, while maintaining strong ownership of code quality, security, maintainability, and peer review.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with business stakeholders.
* Advantageous: Knowledge of backend coding system and practices using C\#.

**Desirable Qualifications**

* Degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or related field.
* Experience in B2B or manufacturing environments.
* Exposure to .NET Core or Microsoft stack is a plus.

**Behaviours**

* **Collaboration and Communication**: The candidate should demonstrate strong communication and collaboration skills, as they will need to work closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into functional components. This involves gathering requirements directly from stakeholders across departments and ensuring that their needs are met through robust, accessible, and high\-performance web solutions.
* **Proactive Learning and Adaptability:** The ideal candidate should have a strong awareness of current trends and advancements in front\-end development. They should proactively recommend and champion the adoption of new tools, frameworks, or workflows to continually enhance the development process and end\-user experience. This behaviour shows their commitment to staying updated and improving their skills.
* **Ownership and Responsibility:** The candidate should take ownership of the front\-end architecture, from prototyping and interface design through to deployment and optimisation. This includes ensuring best practices in responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and web performance are adhered to at all stages of development. This behaviour indicates their ability to take responsibility for their work and ensure high\-quality outcomes.
* **Responsible AI Adoption:** The candidate should be curious and confident in using AI coding tools as part of a modern development workflow, while applying sound judgement, critical review, and accountability for the final solution.

Pay: £36,000\.00\-£40,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Company pension
* On\-site parking

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are Printed.com, one of the largest and fastest growing on\-line print shops in the UK. We are filled to the brim with a passionate team who are mad about printing, designing, building and growing the business. In the office you’ll find that we are forward\-thinking, with a mission to be creative, innovative and to help our customers.


We are constantly investing in new products and using technology to improve how we increase our market share and take advantage of new opportunities. Catch us in our production space and you will find a fast\-paced, dedicated team who endeavour to reach perfection for our customers.

  

We’re a growing company with offices in London and Newcastle, looking for employees that are equal parts dynamic and enthusiastic. People brimming over with new, original ideas that they just can’t wait to share with their team and bring to life.


We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team as we scale our platform across UK and US markets. Reporting our Technical Engineering Manager, you'll work across a mix of PHP (Symfony/Laravel) applications running on AWS (EC2 and EKS), contributing hands\-on to feature development and platform improvements. This role suits someone building their confidence owning well\-scoped problems, who's comfortable asking the right questions when something's unclear, and who's keen to develop their skills with support from senior engineers. You'll be trusted to make sound technical decisions within your area, execute reliably against a spec, and start contributing to the team's engineering practices as you grow into a more senior role.


This is a hybrid role with a minimum of 2 days required in our Cramlington office.

 **Requirements**  

Ownership \& Initiative


Take ownership of well\-defined problems and features, escalating ambiguity or unclear requirements to a Senior Engineer or Manager rather than resolving it unsupported. Comfortable digging into a bug beyond the surface symptom, with support available when the root cause isn't obvious.

  

Multi\-Project Delivery


Work across a small number of concurrent workstreams — typically feature development alongside platform or infrastructure tasks — managing your own time and flagging early when priorities conflict, rather than resolving trade\-offs independently.

  

Engineering Best Practices


Follow and reinforce engineering best practices (code review standards, testing, CI/CD, documentation) consistently in your own work and give constructive code review feedback to peers and junior engineers.

  

Process \& Ways\-of\-Working Adoption


Adopt new tools, processes, and ways of working as the engineering function matures, and help surface friction or confusion you hit along the way so it can be fed back to the team leads driving the change.

  

Mentoring \& Technical Guidance


Support junior engineers through pairing and code review and be receptive to mentoring and technical guidance from senior engineers as you build toward more autonomous ownership.

**Key Skills**

* Our stack is PHP (Symfony/Laravel) with Vue.js front ends \- but we're open to engineers from other frameworks (e.g. Rails, Django, .NET) or other JS frameworks (React, Angular) who can demonstrate solid fundamentals and pick things up quickly
* Comfortable working across JavaScript, SCSS, and Twig as part of day\-to\-day full\-stack delivery, or building toward that across a similar front\-to\-back stack
* Working knowledge of AWS (EC2, EKS/containers, RDS, or similar services), or strong general cloud fundamentals with willingness to build AWS\-specific depth
* Good exposure to DevOps, platform, or infrastructure work
* Comfortable managing your own priorities across a small number of concurrent tasks
* Clear, confident communicator, comfortable asking questions and flagging blockers rather than guessing
* Open to pairing with and learning from other engineers; some experience supporting junior engineers or interns is a plus
* Familiarity with observability tooling (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus/Mimir) is a plus
* Developing a pragmatic sense of trade\-offs between speed, technical debt, and long\-term maintainability
* A proactive problem\-solver \- comfortable taking a well\-defined problem and running with it, and knowing when to ask for direction on the ambiguous parts
* Approaches technical disagreement collaboratively \- pushes back on ideas, not people, and is open to being persuaded by a stronger argument
* Beginning to factor cost into technical decisions, with guidance from senior engineers on the bigger architectural calls
* Some exposure to legacy or end\-of\-life systems is useful, though not expected to lead modernisation efforts independently
* Security\-conscious in day\-to\-day development (access control, dependency hygiene, data handling), with senior engineers available for the trickier calls

 **Benefits**  

* 25 days holiday Plus 8 days bank holidays
* Staff discounts \& Friends and Family discounts
* Cycle to work scheme, Tech Scheme and EV Scheme (subject to conditions)
* Breakfast and drinks provided on days you work in the office
* 1 Charity Day per year
* Summer and Christmas Parties
* Street food days
* Perkbox membership
* Enhanced parental leave
* Staff discount on print

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

AECOM is seeking an experienced **Data Engineer** to play a key role in designing, delivering, and optimising data platforms and solutions across a wide range of projects.


As a **Data Engineer**, you will be responsible for delivering components of the data solution lifecycle, ensure solutions adhere to standard quality metrics (scalability, secure, resilient etc) and design data\-driven data architecture that serves value and delivers insight. Your work will directly support AECOM’s mission to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions to our clients.


You will work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and cross\-functional digital teams, supporting analytics use cases and occasionally contributing to light data\-science activities such as feature engineering, exploratory analysis, or model operationalisation.

**Key Responsibilities**:

* Develop concepts through the solution lifecycle, ensuring scalability and optimisation whilst considering cost.
* Oversee end\-to\-end data processes such as ingestion, transformation, modelling, and integration across multiple external, facing projects.
* Demonstrate that solutions have met client performance, quality, security, and governance expectations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional data teams to gather client requirements.

**Quality, Governance \& Operational Excellence**

* Work closely with Data Analysts and Data Scientists to support analytical projects providing support for work such as feature engineering, and big data\-analysis activities.
* Collaborate with project managers, architects, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of data solutions within wider digital ecosystems.
* Uphold data engineering best practices including code quality, testing, CI/CD, and documentation standards.
* Adhere to project data governance controls, including metadata management, access controls, data lineage, PII protection, and compliance with organisational and regulatory requirements.
* Develop monitoring and alerting strategies for data solutions, maintaining high availability, performance, and reliability.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across infrastructure, data solutions, and custom analytical products.

**Innovation, Prototyping \& Continuous Improvement**

* Continuously explore new cloud capabilities, data platforms, and modern data stack tools to drive innovation within the team.
* Foster a culture of knowledge\-sharing, standardisation, and collaborative team practices.

  

**Qualifications** *Here’s what we’re looking for:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
* Advanced proficiency in at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (Python preferred; Scala, Java, or C\# also beneficial).
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of relational databases, non\-relational stores, and data warehouse principles.
* Solid experience with data modelling methodologies (dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, data vault, etc.).
* Experience designing and operating ETL/ELT pipelines and modern workflow orchestration tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions).
* Professional experience in delivering cloud\-based data engineering solutions at scale, with strong client\-facing, stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills..

**Security Clearance**


Please note that our offer of employment is conditional upon your ability to meet UK security clearance requirements. This is necessary for you to work on the full range of projects requiring security clearance at AECOM Infrastructure and Environment UK Limited.


We celebrate diversity, including neurodiversity, and believe it enriches our team. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and abilities. If you are an applicant with a disability that requires reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please contact us at ReasonableAccommodations@aecom.com. At AECOM, we value everyone's unique contributions and perspectives.


If you meet some of the requirements above or have transferable skills you believe would benefit us, we would be delighted to hear from you!

 **Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

 **About AECOM**


AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public\- and private\-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm and its Professional Services business had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. See how we are delivering sustainable legacies for generations to come at aecom.com and @AECOM.

**Freedom to Grow in a World of Opportunity**


You will have the flexibility you need to do your best work with hybrid work options. Whether you’re working from an AECOM office, remote location or at a client site, you will be working in a dynamic environment where your integrity, entrepreneurial spirit and pioneering mindset are championed.


You will help us foster a safe and respectful workplace, where we invite everyone to bring their whole selves to work using their unique talents, backgrounds and expertise to create transformational outcomes for our clients.


AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well\-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.


Join us, and you’ll get all the benefits of being a part of a global, publicly traded firm – access to industry\-leading technology and thinking and transformational work with big impact and work flexibility. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in each person’s potential, and we’ll help you reach yours.


We are a Disability Confident Employer and will offer an interview to applicants who have a disability or long\-term condition, who meet the minimum/essential criteria for the role. Please let us know using this email address ReasonableAccommodationsUKI@aecom.com if you would like to apply through the Disability Confident Interview Scheme.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

**Permanent \| Full\-time:** 37 hours per week


**Closing date** : 9th October 2026

  

***Help us create a better future, quicker!***

  

Join SP Energy Networks as a Senior Cable Design Engineer and play a key role in powering the future of our MANWEB area. This position offers the opportunity to shape the development of high\-voltage cable systems across our 33kV to 132kV networks, delivering engineering solutions that keep electricity flowing to homes and businesses across North Wales and North West England.

  

  

Working closely with the Lead Design Engineer – Circuits, you'll take ownership of high\-value, complex projects while providing technical expertise and guidance that drives innovation and excellence. This is more than engineering — it's about building the infrastructure that enables our Net Zero goals and ensures reliable, sustainable energy for communities we serve.

  

***What you'll be doing***

* Develop and deliver cable engineering solutions from initial feasibility through to detailed design, managing the technical aspects of cable systems and associated equipment for projects of significant value and complexity
* Prepare comprehensive engineering specifications and designs, assess submissions, and ensure all work complies with current legislation, policies, and operational requirements
* Drive the resolution of statutory, land, and consent matters for underground cable routes, while recommending construction and outage programmes
* Prepare and review cable drawings and technical specifications for construction and procurement, maintaining control of all documentation issued to Project Delivery and Pre\-Contract Teams

* Contribute to training needs assessments and help develop technical, operational, and safety packages for new products and innovations
  

***What you'll bring***

* Significant proven experience in an accountable position working with high\-voltage power cables and associated equipment
* Proficiency in using Cymcap software for cable design and evaluation
* Ability to implement, apply, and promote CDM and Health \& Safety best practice within a design environment
* Capability to represent departments or project teams on cable engineering matters, making informed judgments and advocating for industry standards and best practice
* Experience in assessing engineering documentation for feasibility and compliance with client requirements, preparing accurate project budgets, and delivering quality documentation
* Experience preparing Project Quality Plans (PQPs) and ensuring all deliverables are met to the required standard
* Effective communication and coordination skills, enabling you to work across multi\-disciplinary teams and provide clear technical guidance to stakeholders at all levels

***What's in it for you***

  

As well as an attractive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we'll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.


At ScottishPower, we believe it's the little things we do in life that make a big difference. From helping you look after your family's wellbeing, save for your future and take personal steps for climate action \- our benefits are designed to help you do just that \- so that you have everything you need to take care of your world \- today and tomorrow.

  

  

That's why our benefits include:

SP Energy Networks is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world's largest integrated utility companies and a world presence in wind energy. Across our MANWEB area, covering North Wales, Merseyside, Cheshire, and North Shropshire, we keep the lights on for over 2\.4 million people. Our network of underground cables and overhead lines delivers reliable electricity to homes, businesses, and communities every single day. **PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**

  

Our Building Services teams at Cundall play a key role in making buildings more energy efficient, cost effective to run and, ultimately, more sustainable. To do this, we’re looking for graduates who have a desire and enthusiasm to make a difference: in our homes, offices, projects, industry and community.

  

Working across a variety of sectors, our building services engineers are a source of world leading expertise, producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project.

  

With 29 locations globally, we offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, professional excellence and knowledge sharing.

  

Our Building Services teams have worked on a range of amazing projects, from data centres for large tech companies to headquarters of companies such as Deutsche Bank and Diageo. As a graduate in the team, you could play a key part in our next big project.


The Role You'll Play:

As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you’ll join a team who specialise in the design of some of the most exciting construction projects in the UK and worldwide.  

Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors including education, healthcare, workplace, retail and critical systems (data centres).  

Under the guidance of our team of experienced engineers, we’ll equip you to undertake detailed mechanical building services engineering design and analysis, define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, facilities and services (ventilation, cooling and air conditioning, heating systems and more) \- all with sustainability at the forefront of the design.  

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop and with accredited professional development programmes from CIBSE and IMechE you’ll be fully supported towards achieving chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Mechanical or Building Services Engineering.
* Have a passion about innovative and sustainable mechanical engineering for the built environment.
* Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

 **What’s in it for you?**
We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.  

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:* A one\-off joining bonus of £1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A £2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.


Graduate Brochure
Job Description *Must have right to work in the UK, we do not provide sponsorship for this role.* **We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

**Salary Up to £50,000**

**Building the future of technology starts with great developers.**


At MAB, we're investing heavily in technology as we transform our digital landscape. We're moving from a traditional monolithic platform to a modern cloud\-based microservices architecture, creating innovative products and services that support our advisers, business partners and customers across the UK.


As a Mid\-Level Software Developer, you'll join a growing Technology team at an exciting stage of our journey. You'll work on meaningful projects, contribute to the development of modern applications and help deliver solutions that support the future of mortgage and financial services.


Whether your background is front\-end, back\-end or full stack development, this is a fantastic opportunity to work with modern technologies, collaborate with talented engineers and continue developing your technical expertise in a supportive Agile environment.

**About the Role**


Working as part of a collaborative Agile delivery team, you'll be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining software solutions that are scalable, reliable and aligned to business needs.


You'll contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from reviewing requirements and technical designs through to development, testing and deployment. Alongside delivering quality code, you'll help identify opportunities for improvement, share ideas with the wider team and contribute to the continued evolution of our technology platforms.


We are passionate about innovation and continuously explore emerging technologies, including AI, to improve the way we build and deliver solutions.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Designing, building and maintaining high\-quality software solutions.
* Developing clean, efficient and reusable code aligned to engineering best practice.
* Reviewing technical specifications and solution designs before development begins.
* Working within a modern microservices architecture to deliver scalable services and applications.
* Collaborating with Product Owners, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers and fellow Developers throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Identifying opportunities to improve existing applications, services and development processes.
* Participating in Agile ceremonies including daily stand\-ups, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.
* Carrying out peer code reviews and providing constructive feedback to colleagues.
* Supporting troubleshooting, defect resolution and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Producing and maintaining technical documentation where required.
* Contributing to a culture of learning, innovation and knowledge sharing across the Technology team.

**What We're Looking For**


We're looking for developers who are passionate about technology, enjoy solving problems and thrive in a collaborative environment. You'll be someone who takes ownership of your work, embraces new ideas and enjoys contributing to the success of both your team and the wider business.

**You'll Bring**

* Commercial experience developing applications using C\#.
* Experience working with modern software development practices and principles.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based technologies such as AWS or Azure.
* For Front\-End and Full Stack Developers, strong experience with Angular.
* Understanding of APIs and microservices architecture.
* Experience working in an Agile development environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills.
* The ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
* A proactive mindset with a willingness to learn and adapt.
* Experience creating clear technical documentation.
* Financial services experience would be advantageous but is not essential.

**Our Technology Stack**


We continuously invest in modern technologies and platforms to support innovation and help us deliver great solutions.


Current technologies include:

* C\# .NET 6\+
* Angular
* AWS Cloud
* RabbitMQ
* PostgreSQL
* Entity Framework (Code First)
* Domain Driven Design (DDD)
* NUnit and Fluent Assertions
* Git, Bitbucket and Jenkins

Success at MAB is not only about what we do, but how we do it.
