Benifex’s mission is to **build remarkable experiences that employees love.** Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. Our Engineering department is looking for Senior .Net developers to help shape the future of our platform and engineering department! We are going through a key period of growth across the business and have roles within existing teams delivering key functionality, as well as brand new teams set up to achieve our goals as a business.


Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship and require to people to be based in the UK or Ireland for this position

**Great benefits:**


£75,000\-90,000


Tech setup of your choice (MacBook Pro or equivalent, monitors, etc.)


£/€800 annual learning budget, plus two hours per week as ‘Focus Fridays’.


Flexible work – choose a working setup that works for you, our only ask is to see you once a month in the office and you must be based in the UK or Ireland.


Full access to our comprehensive benefits package, including discounts from hundreds of high street brands, salary sacrifice schemes across Finance, Health, Tech, and more


️ 25 days holiday plus your local bank holidays


Your birthday off


️ Two half day wellbeing days


Healthcare cash plan to cover the costs of day\-to\-day healthcare


Employee Assistance Plan 24/7 365 support


Income Protection (75%) and life assurance (4x salary)


Referral bonuses


Enhanced parental leave package \- 26 weeks fully paid maternity leave and 4 weeks fully paid paternity leave


️ Work from Anywhere policy for 90 days


️ Buy and Sell scheme for holidays


£50 monthly allowance to spend on whatever takes your fancy, your very own Benifex card will be topped up at the start of each month!

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the design and development of modern, scalable backend solutions for our Benefits product using C\#.NET and .NET Core.
* Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering teams to define technical requirements, ensure high\-quality delivery, and drive architectural decisions.
* Modernise existing systems by introducing microservices, containerisation (Kubernetes), and cloud\-native practices.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless deployment and delivery processes.
* Advocate for and implement best practices in coding, architecture, and process, ensuring a high standard of technical excellence.
* Work effectively with remote teams to deliver cohesive and robust solutions.
* Collaborate with engineers from Java Spring Boot backgrounds to ensure seamless integration and knowledge sharing.

**Tech stack**: .NET, SQL, GCP, MSMQ (moving to Google Pub/Sub), Kubernetes.

 **What are we looking for?**

* Extensive experience in backend development with **C\#.NET and .NET Core**, with a focus on scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Proven knowledge of **Kubernetes** and **containerisation** to support modern infrastructure practices.
* Experience with **modern architectural patterns**, including microservices, CQRS and event\-driven systems. Bonus points for experience with circuit breaker, transient fault handling, outbox patterns, dead letter handling
* Hands\-on experience with messaging systems like **Pub/Sub, distributed transaction coordination (MSDTC)**, and caching solutions like Redis.

* Experience with cloud technologies, particularly in deploying and scaling .NET applications.

* Previous experience modernising legacy systems or transitioning monolithic architectures to microservices.

Initial informal call with the Talent team


Interview with our Engineering Manager 30 min


Technical Task

* Bardzo dobra znajomość Azure

jobs.title: Frontend platform engineer
jobs.description:
You will join our Digital Bank Foundation which is Digital Bank Foundation is in charge of Net and mobile bank and ensures stable and secure operations for both the banks and their customers on these applications. We see this as one of BEC’ s diamonds and deliver to more than 1 mill. end users.


The Platform engineer is a crucial part of an agile team, maintaining and delivering new functionality to the end users. This position will give you the opportunity to provide a substantial change to the Danish banking Industry and end users satisfaction. The open position will have to focus on maintaining \& developing front\-end core on our OpenUI Platform, monitoring, incidents handling, developing API’s and off course general maintenance. You will work together with other colleagues who present their applications on Net and mobile bank, around in our organization.


At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, but we also keep the opportunity to work remotely **up to 8 days per month for now,** but we will expect that this will be changed to 80 % in office. Your direct manager will be Head of Digital Bank Foundation Heidi Bjarnø Hagman.


**Primary tasks and responsibilities include:**


* Processing of bank requirements together with business analysts to transform customer requirements into feasible development tasks.
* The whole development lifecycle: from technical analysis of stories and bugs, technical design, to development, dev testing and release
* Maintain and develop data integrations \- **80% maintenance, 20% development**
* Ad hoc handling of any incidents reported by customers, to ensure that operational issues on the Netbank application are resolved.

**To succeed you will have:**

* 5\+ experience in Front end development (3\+ in Angular preferably latest versions)
* Experience working with micro frontends or hybrid apps architecture (at least one is a must)
* Experience with complex Angular applications, components, modules, services, rxjs, observables, signals
* Experience working with NginX and state management
* Experience setting and managing nx/nrwl, npm, Node.js
* Technical experience with Spring or Spring Boot
* Passion for building stable and secure applications
* Excellent problem\-solving skills
* Experience with working in an agile team and being an active part in agile events
* Fluent English (written and spoken).

**It’s nice\-to\-have:**


* Experience with OpenShift (Paas)
* DevOps experience, Scrum/Agile mindset
* Pro\-active and a good team\-player with focus on helping each other to deliver as promised

**Be your best self with BEC’s benefits!**


We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.


* Flexible working hours
* Mental health support
* Free lunch at the office
* Professional development
* Referral bonus up to PLN 10,000
* PLN 600 on a benefit platform a month
* Passion clubs and social events (Tennis, salsa dancing, board games, family picnics and more!)

**What does the recruitment process look like?**


* Send us your CV: We want to get to know you


* Screening call: Let’s chat and see if we’re a match

jobs.title: Staff InfoSec Engineer
jobs.description:
Krakow, Poland Category Engineering, Product, \& UX Design
  
Job description
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high\-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close\-knit, high\-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  

  

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
**Staff InfoSec Engineer**
**Why We Have This Role**


Qualtrics is looking for a Senior Lead of CDU Operations to lead the (Kraków) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll own the day\-to\-day operations of your team, build and mentor a high\-performing team of analysts, and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on leadership role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.
**How You’ll Find Success**


* Strategic Visionary: You possess an in\-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
* Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting\-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Lead and manage the Security Operations Center, including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Hire, coach, and develop a team of CDU analysts and incident responders; build career paths and a strong on\-call/rotation culture
* Senior Lead needs hands\-on credibility. Conduct 1\-on\-1 technical coaching, run mock incident drills, and build skill matrices for junior analysts.
* Own CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required:
	+ 7\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 4\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience running or scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have:
	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
* Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.
**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**


* Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5\).
* Private Medical Insurance\- Luxmed health \& dental cover for you and your dependants.
* Commuter Assistance\- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
* Savings Plan\- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) \& Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
* QED PROGRAM\- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
* Wellness\- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
* A choice of Multispot cards available.
* Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
* Experience bonus\- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
* Group Life \& Income Protection Insurance
* Glasses/Contact lenses Reimbursement
* Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office
* Tax\-deductible expenses (up to 50% depending on role)

**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model**: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in\-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. \#hybrid
*Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.*
*Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:**Family \& Medical Leave Act**,* *Equal Opportunity Employment**,* *Employee Polygraph Protection Act*
*Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.*
*Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one\-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics \- upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam \- we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info \- so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.*

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric/Collibra)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.


Manage Fabric\-native catalog and discovery functionalities.


Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.


Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.


Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.


Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.


Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.


Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.


Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.


Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.


Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.


Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.


Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Python,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP\-600/DP\-700 certifications),


experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated,


PowerShell.


##### **Other**


Languages


English: B2 Upper Intermediate


Seniority


Senior

jobs.title: Senior System Developer

Vi söker en Senior System Developer till vårt team inom Commercial Technology på Nobina. Är du en driven fullstackutvecklare med gedigen erfarenhet inom .NET och ett starkt intresse för att utveckla stabila och användarvänliga lösningar? Då kan du vara den vi söker!


Nobina är Nordens ledande aktör inom kollektivtrafik, med cirka 15 000 medarbetare som dagligen bidrar till att en miljon resenärer når sina destinationer på ett hållbart sätt. Vår verksamhet sträcker sig över Sverige, Norge, Danmark och Finland.

Som Senior System Developer får du en central roll i utvecklingen och förbättringen av vårt Tågersättningssystem (TRIP), som hanterar ersättningstrafik vid trafikavbrott och extratrafik vid större evenemang. * Utveckla, förbättra och underhålla våra system och appar
* Bidra i tekniska och arkitekturella frågor samt ta fram lösningar för tekniska och affärsmässiga behov
* Delta i kravhantering och tekniska tester.
* Bidra till kunskapsdelning och gott samarbete i teamet

Du är en erfaren och lösningsorienterad utvecklare med god kunskap inom backend och gärna även frontend. Du trivs i komplexa systemlandskap, arbetar självständigt med felsökning och problemlösning och samarbetar väl i agila team. Du har ett starkt intresse för teknik, systemutveckling och kontinuerliga förbättringar.


För att lyckas i rollen har du:

* Minst 8 års erfarenhet som utvecklare och relevant utbildning inom IT
* Erfarenhet av systemarkitektur och utveckling av händelsebaserade distribuerade system
* Erfarenhet av monitorering och felsökning i affärskritiska system
* Gedigen erfarenhet av .NET, C\#, Azure och mikrotjänster

##### **Meriterande erfarenhet**

* Azure DevOps
* Frontendutveckling, framför allt Angular eller liknande ramverk
* Mobilutveckling i .NET MAUI, Blazor eller Xamarin
* Arkitektur och arbete i större IT\-projekt

##### **Varför Nobina**


På Nobina är vi engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare gör skillnad. Våra ledare tar ansvar, fattar modiga beslut och strävar alltid efter att möta våra resenärers och samhällets behov. Genom att vara affärsdrivna och fokusera på helheten strävar vi efter att utveckla vår verksamhet och skapa hållbara lösningar, för idag och för framtiden. På ett coachande sätt är vi engagerande. Vår kultur bygger på respekt, vi bryr oss och tar ansvar, och vi söker ständigt nya perspektiv för att driva innovation.


Låter det intressant?Vänta inte med din ansökan, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Välkommen att bli en del av Nobina!

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Vi söker en AI Engineer som vill bygga lösningar som faktiskt används i verksamheten. För dig är AI inte en demo vid sidan av, utan ett verktyg för att lösa riktiga problem, automatisera arbete och skapa bättre sätt att jobba.
  
  

Du gillar att bygga, testa och få saker i produktion. Hos oss arbetar du nära både kunden och tekniken och behöver därför vara lika nyfiken på problemet som på modellen, arkitekturen eller verktyget som kan lösa det.
  
  

Vad du kommer att göra
  
  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**  

designa, bygga och vidareutveckla lösningar med generativ AI, LLM: er, agents och automation
  
**koppla AI till affärssystem, dataplattformar, API:** er och andra verksamhetskritiska system
  
välja rätt angreppssätt för exempelvis retrieval, tool use och agentbaserade flöden
  
ta lösningar från idé och proof of concept till robust implementation och produktion
  
arbeta med utvärdering, testning, säkerhet, behörigheter och spårbarhet
  
samarbeta nära kunder för att förstå processer, data och behov och omsätta dem till fungerande lösningar
  
  

Vem vi tror att du är
  
  

Du har minst fyra års relevant erfarenhet inom systemutveckling, data, AI eller liknande och har byggt moderna AI\-lösningar i praktiken.
  
  

Du behöver inte komma från klassisk machine learning eller forskning. Det viktiga är att du kan bygga fungerande produkter, integrationer och automationer och förstår vad som krävs för att få dem att fungera utanför en demo.
  
  

**Vi tror också att du:**  

är en stark utvecklare och känner dig hemma i exempelvis Python, TypeScript, C\# eller liknande
  
har erfarenhet av LLM\-baserade lösningar och hur de kopplas till data, verktyg och externa system
  
**är van vid API:** er, integrationer och moderna moln\- och utvecklingsmiljöer
  
förstår hur AI kan kopplas till ERP\-miljöer som SAP, datalager och andra affärssystem
  
kan resonera kring säkerhet, behörigheter och dataskydd
  
är pragmatisk, självgående och bekväm med att välja teknik utifrån problemet snarare än leverantören
  
kan prata med både verksamheten och tekniska team
  
kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska
  
  

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av AI\-agenter, moderna integrationsmönster för AI eller plattformar och modeller från exempelvis OpenAI, Anthropic eller Microsoft.
  
  

Du behöver inte kunna allt. Det viktiga är att du har en stabil teknisk grund, är nyfiken och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
  
  

Varför Norrminds?
  
  

Du börjar inte på Norrminds bara för att få ett nytt jobb.
  
  

Vi bygger ett bolag där människor med olika styrkor får stort ansvar, kan påverka hur vi arbetar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre. Vi tror på modet att testa gränser, på att göra saker tillsammans och på att teknik ska skapa nytta, inte bara mer teknik.
  
  

Vi arbetar i gränslandet mellan AI, affärssystem, integration och automation. Här får du arbeta nära de processer och system där AI faktiskt kan göra skillnad och samtidigt vara med och forma hur vi bygger vårt AI\-erbjudande framåt.
  
  

Rollen kan utgå från Malmö, Linköping eller Stockholm. I dessa städer vill vi bygga något långsiktigt, så du ska tycka om tanken på att vara nära både kunder och framtida kollegor och vara med och forma Norrminds lokalt.
  
  

Känner du igen dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

### **Om uppdraget**


Vi söker en erfaren Backend\- och DevOps\-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24\.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.


Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

### **Vad uppdraget innebär**


Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

* Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure\-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
* Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
* Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD\-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
* Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
* Rådgivning i design\- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
* Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

### **Vem vi söker**


Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure\-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C\# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.


Du kan drifta Azure\-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure\-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.


Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

### **Varför uppdraget är intressant**


Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

### **Uppdragsvillkor**

**Uppdragsform:** Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F\-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

**Uppdragslängd:** Enligt överenskommelse.

**Omfattning:** 40 timmar per vecka.

**Start:** Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

**Arbetsplats:** Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18\) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

**Ersättning:** Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

**Övrigt:** Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

### **Var med och gör skillnad i vården!**


Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID\-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.

You will receive a competitive salary where you are rewarded for both your individual performance and company performance. jobs.title: Software Engineer III
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Here at Rakuten Kobo Inc. we offer a casual working start\-up environment and a group of friendly and talented individuals. Our employees rank us highly in terms of commitment to work/life balance. We realize that for our people to be innovative, creative and passionate they need to feel valued and supported. We believe in rewarding all our employees with competitive salaries, performance based annual bonuses, stock options and training opportunities.  



  

If you’re looking for a company that inspires passion, personal, and professional growth – join Kobo and come help us on our mission of making reading lives better.  



  

**The Role:**

Rakuten Kobo Ireland is looking for a **Software Engineer III** to join our amazing Web team! This is a remote position based in Dublin, Ireland.


You will be joining one of our development strike teams to deliver awesome new features for our many users to enjoy.


Our engineers are enthusiastic and operate across the development spectrum, from front\-end to back\-end to CI/CD and infrastructure. We take full responsibility for our work, from requirements gathering and solutioning, to implementation and testing, to deploying and monitoring how our code behaves in front of real customers. Kobo is looking for an engineer who shares these passions and is proud of the work they do.


Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, the Full Stack Software Engineer III plays a vital role in all aspects of delivery from design, planning and implementation through to releasing and monitoring.  



  

**Responsibilities:**


* Building quality software using the full Microsoft stack including MVC Web Applications, Web API services, .Net 8 microservices and much more.
* Propose designs and Proof of Concepts to Architecture team and work with the team to deliver the implementation to Production.
* Participate in code reviews; happy to give and receive constructive feedback.
* Communicate clearly and effectively with teammates, Business stakeholders and other development teams in Kobo.
Mentoring more junior team members of the team and conducting code reviews.  
* 

**The Skillset:**


Required


* Computer Science or Computer Engineering Degree (or equivalent experience)
* Highly technical and able to communicate well with engineers and cross\-functional team members
* Experience with C\#, ASP.NET MVC, WebAPI, RESTful Services, .Net 8 Microservices
* Experience with SOLID Principles and Practices, IoC \& TDD.
* Some experience with service bus technology e.g. NServiceBus, RabbitMQ.
* Strong experience with React and modern JavaScript/CSS frameworks.
* Experience with Git.
* Experience with designing, implementing, and optimizing observability solutions (metrics, logs, traces).
* Experienced and knowledgeable in CI/CD and different testing strategies and techniques (Unit, Integration, UI tests), including experience with ArgoCD.
Comfortable with and enthusiastic about learning new technologies.  
* 

Nice to Haves


* Working in an Agile environment and teamDocker, Solr, Kubernetes
* Test automation using Selenium Webdriver or Playwright
* Working with GitHub or Azure DevOps
* Knowledge of Ruby or other scripting languages
Experience with MS SQL, RavenDb, EntityFramework.  
* 

  

**The Perks**

* Flexible hours and remote working environment
* 4 extra long weekends around bank holiday weekends
* Full benefits starting from your first day
* Paid volunteer days, unlimited sick days
* 4% employer pension contribution
* Flexible spending account
* Talent and development training budget
* Free Kobo device \+ free weekly eBook or audiobook
* Weekly Kobo Spark sessions
Maternity/paternity leave top\-up  
* 

  

**About Rakuten Kobo Inc.**  

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is the world’s digital bookseller created by and for booklovers. Owned by Tokyo\-based Rakuten Group, Inc. and headquartered in Toronto, Rakuten Kobo’s millions of worldwide users can read anytime, anywhere, and on any device. With a mission to make reading lives better for all, Rakuten Kobo connects readers to stories using thoughtful and personalized curation of eBooks and audiobooks, and the best dedicated eReaders and apps for reading. With the singular focus of making reading lives the best they can be, Kobo’s open platform allows people to fit reading into more moments in their busy lives. To learn more about Rakuten Kobo, visit www.kobo.com.  



  

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accessibility accommodations for candidates with disabilities participating in the selection process are available on request. Any information received related to accommodation needs of applicants will be addressed confidentially.  



  

Rakuten Kobo would like to thank all applicants for their interest in this role however only qualified candidates will be shortlisted.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer II
jobs.description:
Now
  
As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high\-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.
**We are the people who give possibilities purpose**
----------------------------------------------------


BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.


**Job Description**
===================


As a Software Test Engineer, you will play a critical role in advancing our vision of streamlining and innovating diagnostic technologies with a strong focus on customer experience and product quality. You will join a dynamic Agile team focused on developing an informatics software platform that connects clinical laboratory instruments, data, and workflows to help labs streamline testing.

  

  

**Responsibilities**


* Collaborate with project teams (local and remote) to understand requirements, estimate, plan, design and deliver the product under test.
* Understand design and implementation level details of the product under test.
* Create, execute and review test cases and other test documents as per Design and Change controls
* Conduct complex black box, system\-level, functional testing, applying comprehensive knowledge of software quality concepts within the software development lifecycle, verify end\-to\-end customer flows, Capture Issue/Bugs in line with Business Unit policy/Standard and track to closure.
* Perform sprint and V\&V test execution tasks.
* Support software and systems engineering teams with troubleshooting, characterization and validation activities for prototypes, sub\-systems, and finished products.
* Engage in continuous improvement, innovation and optimization of test processes.
* Apply comprehensive knowledge of software quality concepts within the software development lifecycle.

**Preferred Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline, plus a minimum of 2 years of software testing experience.
* Minimum of 1 year of professional experience using C\# for automation testing.
* Familiarity with automated test frameworks (e.g. Playwright, Robot Framework).
* Experience with Defect Tracking Tools, Requirement Management and Test Management Tools such as ADO, Cognition Cockpit, and JAMA software.
* Generate and analyze test related metrics using the data from the defect management systems.
* Experience with Agile and Scrum methodologies in software development.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to learn, introduce and improve new and existing test practices and processes.
* Experience with complete software product development life cycle from concept to final release is expected.
* Familiarity with FDA regulations for medical instruments, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 standards and Quality Management systems.
* Effective written and verbal communications skills, ability to clearly and precisely communicate with management and remote team members.

**Nice to have:**


* Experience working in the regulated medical industry.
* ISTQB or equivalent certificate in Software Testing or Software Automation Testing.
* Fluency in a programming language \- preferably C\#.
* Experience testing web applications or product testing with knowledge on API and DB testing, API validations and be able to create SQL scripts.

**Salary range for the role:** €48\.000 to €50\.000 per annum


Click on apply if this sounds like you!


**Why Join Us?**
================


To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.


We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face\-to\-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

**Engineering \& Quantity Surveying Graduate Development Programme 2027**
=========================================================================


Are you ready to apply your engineering or quantity surveying skills to one of the most ambitious and impactful infrastructure transformations in Ireland?


Do you have, or are you about to get, a degree in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/ Structural, Mechanical / Energy Engineering or as a Quantity Surveyor?


If so, the ESB Technical Graduate Programme is your opportunity to work at the forefront of Ireland’s clean energy transition, designing, building, and maintaining the electricity network that connects homes, businesses, and communities across the country.


With over 1000 engineers, quantity surveyors and related technical professionals, ESB is dedicated to investing in engineering related expertise and developing critical skills to support Ireland’s future growth and development.


ESB’s Technical Graduate Programme is designed for STEM graduates with less than two years’ experience, offering structured development, real responsibility, and the opportunity to contribute to our Net Zero by 2040 strategy. At ESB, we believe our people are the driving force behind everything we do \- today and into the future. That’s why investing in your growth, development and potential isn’t just part of our strategy, it’s at the very heart of it.

  

**The programme has a wide variety of opportunities:**

  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, quantity surveyors and technical professionals on projects that matter.

  

**What You’ll Work On:**

  

* Delivering energy infrastructure projects for Ireland, with opportunities to be involved at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Designing, planning and building the electricity network of the future
* Helping to shape ESB's generation fleet on site, ensuring the safety, reliability and resilience of our thermal and renewable energy facilities
* Supporting Ireland's largest private telecoms network, helping keep ESB's infrastructure connected and operating safely
* Supporting ESB’s customers to optimise their energy use \& develop sustainable energy solutions
  

**Our bespoke Early Career Technical Talent Programme includes:**

  

* Structured, timely learning and development through formal as well as on\-the\-job opportunities
* Work assignments giving appropriate breath of learning to facilitate career progression
* Performance targets set to challenge \& develop you while you contribute to ESB’s strategy
* Mentoring \& career support to enable you to find the right career in the company
* Social networking to develop peer supports \& relationships across ESB
  

In addition:

  

As an employee on our Technical Graduate Programme, you will enjoy our many benefits including a competitive salary and bonus, performance related promotions and a comprehensive benefits package built on the four pillars of reward, career, community, and wellbeing.

  

**Location**

  

Nationwide

  

**What We Look For:**

  

* A Masters, Honours or Ordinary degree (or near completion in 2027\) in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/Structural, Mechanical/Energy Engineering or Quantity Surveying, with aminimum Second Class Honours Grade 1 (2\.1\) result
* Excellent analytical skills combined with the ability to learn quickly
* Proven ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced team environment
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Flexibility regarding work location (for your development you may need to change work location during the programme)
  

**Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following:**


* Details of ALL your qualifications including titles, institutions, years of commencement and (projected) completion with your results to date
* Your relevant modules and academic projects
* All your work experience
* Any relevant external interests / pursuits
* A contact telephone number (with voicemail enabled)
* A valid email address to reach you on

ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.


Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.

Join us in our mission to achieve a net\-zero electricity system by 2040\. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero\-carbon electricity.

jobs.description:

**IT Graduate Development Programme 2027 \- Software**

  

At ESB, technology plays a leading role in enabling and realising our purpose to deliver a brighter future for the customers and communities we serve. Today that means we are driven to make a difference – net zero by 2040 – and it’s our people who ensure we succeed.


With almost 500 people working across our IT Delivery and CIO functions, together we design, build and support a broad range of technologies and services to deliver on our strategic objectives – decarbonised electricity, resilient infrastructure and empowered customers.


To further enhance our capabilities and to transform ESB to a data driven and digital utility, we are looking for Graduates to join our highly motivated and skilled team of IT professionals where you will have the opportunity to deliver results in a fast\-paced, innovative team environment.

  

Our IT Graduate Development Programme is structured into five distinct career paths where you will be able to grow your experience, as well as develop the necessary skills to help you on your way to career success.


As part of the Software graduate programme, you will work within multidisciplinary product teams alongside developers, designers, data engineers, architects, analysts and business stakeholders to deliver innovative, secure and customer\-centred digital and data solutions. Our teams combine technology, design and business expertise to solve complex challenges and create value for customers, colleagues and the wider organisation.


Our graduate programme provides graduates with the opportunity to build capabilities across the full product and software delivery lifecycle. You will gain hands\-on experience in the discovery, design, development, testing, deployment and support of digital and data products and services, working with a wide range of technologies, platforms and delivery approaches.


You will develop the technical, analytical, problem\-solving and collaborative skills required to succeed in a modern digital organisation while contributing to projects that support ESB's transition to a net zero future.

jobs.title: Senior Energy Engineer
jobs.description:
Arden Energy is an electricity supply and professional energy management services company established in 2007\.

The company’s founding ethos is the belief that organisations proactively addressing energy efficiency will gain a competitive advantage as energy costs rise and environmental challenges become greater. Our key selling points are transparency, empowerment and competitive electricity tariffs. .

Arden Energy provides services to Government Agencies and industrial clients. We are at are at the forefront of the development and deployment of ICT technologies for energy management and grid flexibility and we engage in research into sustainable energy technologies and techniques.

**Job Description**

As a senior energy engineer you will:

* Lead research projects related to energy management and ICT (e.g. smart metering, BMS)
* Deliver energy management services to clients, facilitating and driving energy use and cost reductions.
* Collate, analyse and report on complex sets of energy data using excel and other software tools.
* Visit clients and prospective clients to carry out energy audits for commercial and industrial markets and provide a business case for investment in energy efficiency.
* Initiate and develop strong business relationships with clients.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of our energy management platform; Analysing and reporting on energy related data.
* Implement AI and machine learning to streamline business and data management processes.
* Manage integration of external data sources into the Arden platform using APIs and other appropriate tools.

This role offers an ambitious professional the opportunity to deploy advanced energy solutions with a market leader, directly accelerating Ireland’s transition to a smart, net\-zero power grid.

**Qualification and Skills**

**Essential Criteria:**

* Hons Degree in Engineering or related discipline.
* Background in an energy engineering/consultancy role preferably with experience of energy auditing and energy management.
* Comprehensive knowledge and understanding of energy efficiency, energy management and renewable energy sources.
* Excellent project management/organisational skills with ability to concurrently manage diverse workloads and competing demands.
* Strong ICT, data management and data analysis skills with hands on technical experience
* Strong report writing skills .
* Candidates must be currently eligible to work in Ireland without restriction and must hold valid work permit/visa if required.

**Desirable Criteria:**

* Specialist professional qualification desirable (eg Masters, Chartered, SEAI Registered Energy Auditor etc.)
* Experience of energy research.
* Ability to work autonomously and proactively contribute to business development.

Pay: €60,000\.00\-€80,000\.00 per year

* Profit sharing

Education:

* Bachelor's (required)

* Fluent English (required)

jobs.title: Graduate Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.

  

Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day\-to\-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.  

The Structural engineering teams provide industry\-leading expertise – and offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state\-of\-the\-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon \- new music school.
The Role You'll Play:

In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.  

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem\-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.  

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.  

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering.
* You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially \- have a passion for creative and intuitive design.
* Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

**What’s in it for you?**

  

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

* A one\-off joining bonus of €1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A €2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.
