jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Hyvä arkkitehtuuri on kuin hyvä perustus: sitä ei huomaa, ennen kuin se puuttuu. Nyt etsimme kokenutta Technical Architectia, joka voi varmistaa softakehityksen vankan perustan.

Jos tunnistat itsesi tästä, saatat olla etsimämme asiantuntija:

Olet kokenut Technical Architect, jolla on vähintään kahdeksan vuoden kokemus softa\-arkkitehtuurista. Toimit asiakasprojekteissa itsenäisesti ja luotat omaan asiantuntijuuteesi. Suunnittelet järjestelmiä, jotka kestävät kuormaa, muutoksia ja aikaa. Huomioit valinnoissasi skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja ylläpidettävyyden, ja osaat perustella ne kehitystiimille yhtä selkeästi kuin asiakkaalle.

Taustasi on ohjelmistokehityksessä, joten tiedät, miltä arkkitehtuuri näyttää koodin tasolla. Osaat analysoida olemassa olevia ratkaisuja, tunnistaa teknisen velan ja viedä järjestelmiä hallitusti kohti modernimpaa arkkitehtuuria. Osaat myös jakaa osaamistasi ja parhaita käytäntöjä ymmärrettävällä ja käytännönläheisellä tavalla.

Saatat etsiä seuraavaa työpaikkaasi tai seuraavaa projektiasi yrittäjänä.

**Millaista osaamista etsimme**

* Vähintään 8 vuoden kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista
* Kokemusta teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnittelusta ja dokumentoinnista
* Vahvaa osaamista pilviarkkitehtuureista ja \-palveluista
* Kokemusta mikropalvelu\-, tapahtumapohjaisista ja/tai hajautetuista arkkitehtuureista
* Hyvää ymmärrystä integraatioista, rajapinnoista ja data\-arkkitehtuurista
* Ymmärrystä tietoturvasta, identiteetinhallinnasta ja ei\-toiminnallisista vaatimuksista
* Kokemusta DevOps\-käytännöistä, CI/CD\-putkista ja infrastruktuurista koodina
* Kykyä toimia itsenäisesti asiakasprojekteissa ja ohjata kehitystiimejä teknisissä ratkaisuissa
* Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen legacy\-järjestelmien modernisointi\- ja migraatioprojekteista, tuntemuksen julkisen sektorin tietoturvavaatimuksista (esim. Julkri) sekä arkkitehtuuriin liittyvät sertifikaatit (esim. Azure Solutions Architect Expert tai AWS Certified Solutions Architect)

Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista teknologioista: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, Terraform, Kafka, REST, GraphQL, API Management, Java, .NET, Node.js, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, C4\-malli, ArchiMate

Emme oleta, että osaat kaikkia listattuja teknologioita. Jos sinulla on vahva kokemus järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista ja teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Kerrothan meille hakemuksessasi tarkemmin juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi.

**Mahdollisia työtehtäviäsi**

* Järjestelmien ja ohjelmistojen teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
* Pilvi\- ja hybridiympäristöjen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen ja kehittäminen
* Teknologiavalintojen tekeminen ja perusteleminen
* Integraatio\- ja data\-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
* Skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen
* Olemassa olevien järjestelmien arvioiminen ja modernisoinnin suunnitteleminen
* Arkkitehtuurikatselmointien tekeminen ja kehitystiimien tekninen ohjaaminen
* Yhteistyö asiakkaiden, kehittäjien, ratkaisuarkkitehtien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
* Oman osaamisen jakaminen ja muiden asiantuntijoiden sparraaminen

**Prosessi ja palkkaus**

Käymme kaikki hakemukset läpi ja vastaamme jokaiselle. Tutustumme sinuun CV:n tai LinkedIn\-profiilisi kautta ja käymme myös nykyiset projektimme läpi. Mikäli projekteistamme saattaisi nyt tai lähitulevaisuudessa löytyä sinulle sopiva toimeksianto, kutsumme sinut tutustumistapaamiseen. Kun sinulle mahdollisesti sopiva asiakasprojekti löytyy, ja asiakas kiinnostuu osaamisestasi, haluaa hän useimmiten haastatella sinut kerran tai pari ennen lopullisen päätöksensä tekemistä. Mikäli asiakas haluaa sinut konsultikseen, pääsemme tekemään tarvittavat sopimukset: joko työsopimuksen tai alihankintasopimuksen, mikäli toimit mieluummin yrittäjänä.

Palkka määräytyy kokemuksen ja projektin perusteella välille 5000\-8000\+ €/kk. Halutessasi voit valita kiinteän tai laskutettuihin tunteihin perustuvan palkkamallin. Jos toimit alihankkijana, on tuntilaskutus useimmiten 60\-100\+ €/h.

**Lisätietoa meistä**

Marvel Consulting on noin 30 hengen asiantuntijatiimi, ja me kasvamme jatkuvasti! Etsimme IT\-alan osaajille mielenkiintoisia konsultointiprojekteja erilaisten asiakkaidemme parista. Työskentelemme pääosin vaativissa IT\-projekteissa tukemalla asiakkaitamme heidän hankkeissaan, joihin liittyvät toimeksiannot kestävät usein kuukausia tai jopa vuosia. Asiakkaamme vaihtelevat pienyrityksistä startupeihin ja suuryrityksiin sekä julkisiin toimijoihin.

Tarjoamme asiantuntijoillemme:

* Kilpailukykyisen palkan
* Erittäin osaavat (ja mukavat!) kollegat
* Mielenkiintoisia ja merkityksellisiä projekteja
* Hyvät työsuhde\-edut sekä laajan työterveyden
* Toiveiden mukaiset ja projektin tarpeisiin vastaavat työvälineet

**Huomioithan: Tällä hetkellä suurin osa projekteistamme edellyttää, että asiantuntija asuu Suomessa ja puhuu suomea. Projektista riippuen asiakas saattaa tarvita läsnäoloa toimistollaan, mutta usein projekteissa on mahdollisuus myös hybridi\- tai etätyölle.**

Työn tyyppi: Kokopäivätyö

Palkka: 5 000,00€ \- 8 000,00€ per kuukausi

Työpaikan sijainti: Henkilökohtainen

jobs.title: Software Developer - Praktikant
jobs.description:
**Praktik forår 2027**
----------------------


Brænder du for at lære mere om softwareteknologi i god kombi med lysten til at udvikle webapplikationer, databaseløsninger, mobilapplikationer eller lignende? Og er du motiveret for at hjælpe kunder med at forbedre deres arbejdsgange og \-processer? Så er IT Minds måske det helt rette sted for dig?

### **Dit praktikophold**


Som praktikant hos IT Minds kommer du ikke til at sidde i et hjørne og lave bugfixing eller drift af legacy systemer. Tværtimod kommer du til at arbejde med nye projekter og de nyeste teknologier på markedet.


Som udgangspunkt vil du blive en del af et projekt, hvor du hjælper med at udvikle en skræddersyet, softwareteknologisk løsning til internt brug eller til en af vores kunder. Uanset hvad sørger vi for, at du hele tiden er i tæt dialog og sparring med vores dygtige senior udviklere. Om du ender på et kundeprojekt eller en intern løsning afhænger af de potentielle muligheder, som vi har i forretningen på det givne tidspunkt, men du kommer i hvert fald ikke til at blive alene!


... Men én ting er sikkert: Du kommer til at udvikle dine tekniske skills og dygtiggøre dig med hjælp fra nogle af Danmarks skarpeste Software Developers.


I mere grove træk vil du i et praktikforløb hos IT Minds få:

* 20 ugers lønnet praktik normeret til 37 timer/uge
* 14 dages onboardingforløb med en grundig introduktion til vores forretning og koncept, introduktion til professionel softwareudvikling, et kursus i "Mindster Consulting Class" og meget mere...
* Et stærkt fællesskab og en særdeles uformel omgangstone, hvor det er helt legalt at spille et slag bordfodbold eller prøve vores crockinole board, når dit hoved trænger til et break
* Gratis frokostordning, kaffe, Cola og Nutella ad libitum


Vi har en historik for at ansætte vores dygtige praktikanter, sådan så du kan tage næste skridt i dit \#Mindsterlife og potentielt overgå fra praktikant til studieprogrammør aka Software Developer på deltid. Muligheden for det kan vi vende, når dit praktikophold lakker mod enden


... Og så er der jo alt det løse \- men vigtige, for vi hepper også på, at du har lyst til at spise fredagsrundstykker med dine kollegaer og skåle i en fredagsøl, serveret fra vores Tiki\-Bar. Måske melder du dig ind i brætspilsklubben eller strikkeklubben? Eller er med til fællestræning hver tirsdag i den lokale fitnesskæde?


Mulighederne er mange, og det er helt fair, hvis du mister pusten ved at deltage i det hele. Så joiner du bare det, du synes, er fedest \- eller opfinder dit eget Mindster\-event!

#### **Din faglige og personlige profil**

* Du er sandsynligvis i gang med din bachelor i Softwareteknologi, Sundhedsteknologi eller en af de andre lignende uddannelser på Institut for Elektro\- og Computerteknologi i Aarhus
* Du er passioneret for software og brænder for at lære mere
* Du har kendskab til .NET\-platformen (C\#) eller Java og/eller JavaScript, og måske har du endda lidt erfaring med frameworks som eksempelvis ASP.NET, .NET core, Angular, React eller Vue.js samt SQL og NoSQL databaser, fx MongoDB
* Du er flydende på dansk i både skrift og tale

#### **IT Minds**


Samler unge IT\-talenter ét sted, og vi omgås hinanden i et miljø, der bærer præg af en høj grad af fleksibilitet, tillid og en særdeles uformel omgangstone.


På IT Minds kontor i Aarhus er vi ca. 50 medarbejdere i en god blanding af erfarne kræfter krydret med studerende og nyuddannede, der befinder sig i begyndelsen af deres karriere.


Som forretning har vi fokus på høj faglighed og kvalitet kombineret med de nyeste teknologier på markedet. Vigtigst er det at levere et stærkt produkt, der skaber værdi og mening, for vores kunder står højest på dagsordenen, og derfor arbejder vi også både agilt og gennemsigtigt. Vores tilgang til arbejdet er derfor ret simpel \- vores softwareløsninger optimerer forretningsprocesser og minimerer omkostningerne. Det er fremtidens softwareløsninger udviklet af nutidens unge talenter.

#### **Vil du være praktikant hos os?**


Søg stillingen på formularen i bunden af siden. Husk at vedhæfte dit karakterudskrift.


Har du spørgsmål så kontakt Rune Østergaard, Team Lead, på rune.ostergaard@it\-minds.dk

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer (Agentic AI Platform)
jobs.description:
Banksektoren står midt i et markant skifte. Stigende kundekrav og kompleks drift udfordrer den klassiske måde at levere rådgivning og service på. Samtidig bygger meget af rådgivningen på mønstre og data – og her kan kunstig intelligens bidrage til at reducere omkostninger, forbedre relationerne til kunderne og gøre bankerne mere konkurrencedygtige.


I Bankdata har vi de seneste år opbygget erfaring med både klassisk Machine Learning, LLM\-baseret søgning i forretningsgange og AI\-agenter til mere komplekse opgaver og hyper\-personaliserede løsninger. Det har lagt et solidt fundament for vores videre arbejde.


Nu er vi klar til næste skridt. Ambitionen er klar: Kunstig intelligens er en central del af Bankdatas tilbud til vores kunder. Derfor bygger vi Bankdatas Agent Platform \- den fælles platform til at udvikle, deploye, drifte og governere AI\-agenter på tværs af Bankdata og pengeinstitutterne.


Ligesom vores containerplatform giver et standardiseret eksekveringsmiljø for applikationer, skal Agent Platform give et standardiseret eksekveringsmiljø for AI\-agenter. Og vi starter ikke fra bar bund: i platformen Horizon har Bankdata allerede et stærkt koncept for containerafvikling, som store dele af forretningen kører på. Det fundament – og de platformkompetencer, der er bygget op omkring det – er det, vi tager med videre. Opgaven nu er at løfte det til workloads, der opfører sig anderledes end klassiske applikationer, og som kræver deres egne guardrails.

**Centralisér kompleksiteten, decentralisér værdiskabelsen.** Sikkerhed, kvalitet, compliance, IAM, forklarlighed, sporbarhed og input/output\-kontrol hører til platformen. Intelligens, integration og forretningslogik hører til den, der bygger agenten.

**Rollen: Fra golden path til selvbetjent produktion**
------------------------------------------------------


Du bliver en nøgleprofil i at gøre det nemt, sikkert og skalerbart at bygge og drive agenter.


Det betyder, at du ikke kun arbejder med LLM'er og agentframeworks, men i høj grad med det, der gør løsningerne holdbare: infrastruktur, automatisering, identitet, observability og developer experience.


Agent\-workloads er ikke stateless services: de er ikke\-deterministiske, de koster penge per kald, de har brug for deres egen identitet, de holder state på tværs af genstarter, og de stopper op og venter på et menneske. Platformen skal bygges til det.

**Du kommer til at:**

* Bygge golden paths frem for skræddersyede løsninger per team, og automatisere provisionering, onboarding, compliance\-checks og telemetri
* Bygge sikkerhed og compliance ind i platformen, så hver agent arver dem frem for at hvert team implementerer sit eget
* Sikre hård isolation mellem institutter, så én tenant aldrig kan påvirke en andens agenter eller data – og designe blast radius, så en fejl ét sted bliver ét sted
* Udvikle platformens agent\-primitiver: et hosted tool\-server\-lag med authentication, authorisation, rate limiting og audit, policy as code, tracing og struktureret logging, sandboxed eksekvering samt kontroller for prompt injection, PII og content filtering
* Bygge godkendelsesmekanismen, en agent venter på, når et menneske skal beslutte – så human\-in\-the\-loop er en platformkapabilitet frem for noget, hver agent opfinder
* Etablere cost attribution per team, agent og use case \- inklusive token\- og inferensomkostninger
* Arbejde med agent\-identitet og delegeret autorisation samt session\- og state\-persistens, så en agents arbejde overlever en genstart


Du vil arbejde på tværs af stacken men med en tydelig tyngde i platform, infrastruktur og developer experience.

**Hvad succes ser ud som efter 6–12 måneder**
---------------------------------------------

* Du har været med til at bygge og lancere den første golden path, som andre teams reelt bygger deres agenter på
* Mindst én agent er i produktion hos reelle brugere, uden at teamet bag skulle bygge sikkerhed, IAM, audit og sporbarhed selv
* Deployment af agenter er blevet selvbetjening \- de fleste deployments kræver ikke hjælp fra platformteamet
* Observability, resiliens og compliance kommer by default frem for som eftertanke
* Der er etableret cost attribution per team, agent og use case, så forbruget kan forklares og styres

**Teamet: Nyt platformteam til at sætte standarden**
----------------------------------------------------


Du bliver en del af et nyt platformteam, der bygger Bankdatas Agent Platform. Teamet er under opbygning og etableres løbende, mens vi implementerer platformen. Vi bygger den i tæt samarbejde med vores pengeinstitutter \- og platformen er ikke kun til Bankdatas egne udviklere. Et pengeinstitut skal kunne bygge og sætte agenter i produktion på lige vilkår med en Bankdata\-udvikler, uden at have os i loopet.


Det er et platformteam \- ikke et applikationsteam. Vi bygger kapabiliteter, der gør mange andre teams i stand til at bygge AI\-drevne produkter.


Fordi teknologilandskabet flytter sig hurtigt, leder vi ikke efter nogen, der "har gjort det her før". Vi leder efter erfarne ingeniører, der har lyst til at være med til at definere, hvordan det bør gøres.


Der er stort ansvar for eget arbejde og fokus på fremdrift. Sparring foregår gennem pair work, workshops og løbende tekniske drøftelser.

**Profilen vi søger: Platform engineer, der tænker platform som produkt**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------


Vi leder efter dig, der ved, at en agent i produktion er langt mere end en model – platformen rundt om modellen er det, der skal bygges én gang og virke hver gang.

**Du har erfaring med:**

* Cloudplatforme, microservices og distribuerede systemer
* Kubernetes, containerplatforme, multi\-tenancy og moderne platform engineering
* CI/CD, infrastructure as code og automatisering
* Observability, skalerbarhed, resiliens, netværk og identitet
* Softwareudvikling og API\-design i Java, Python eller .NET
* GenAI\-komponenter som LLMs, RAG eller agentsystemer – eller et stærkt drive for at lære dem hurtigt


Du tænker i genbrugelige platformkapabiliteter frem for enkeltløsninger, og du reducerer den kognitive belastning for de teams, der bygger ovenpå. Du laver shift\-left på krav fra lovgivning og compliance, så de er indbygget i paved path frem for kontrolleret bagefter.


Vi er åbne for både erfarne profiler og lovende udviklere, som er tidligt i karrieren. Det vigtigste er, at du kan bygge – og tage ansvar.

**Du trives, når du:**

* Tager ejerskab frem for at vente på retning
* Finder løsninger i kompleksitet og usikkerhed
* Prioriterer fremdrift uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet
* Hellere løser problemet end analyserer, hvorfor det er svært

**Udviklingsmuligheder: Sæt retning for agenter i produktion**
--------------------------------------------------------------

**Du får mulighed for at:**

* Tage større teknisk ansvar i teamet
* Drive løsninger i tæt samarbejde med pengeinstitutterne og forretningsdomænerne
* Være med til at definere arkitektur og standarder for agenter i produktion på tværs af communityet

**Klar til at bygge AI, der bliver brugt?**
-------------------------------------------


Hvis du vil arbejde med GenAI i en kontekst, hvor det skal fungere i virkeligheden \- ikke kun i en demo \- så lad os tage en dialog.

**Velkommen til Bankdata**
--------------------------

*Bankdata bygger software til finanssektoren. Vi er næsten 1100 kolleger på holdet, og vi udvikler digitale produkter, platforme og infrastruktur, som ca. hver tredje dansker, 200\.000 virksomheder og flere tusinde bankansatte bruger hver dag.*

*Vi tror på struktureret personlig udvikling, et solidt kollegialt fællesskab og at ambitiøse medarbejdere med fleksible og bæredygtige arbejdsliv præsterer bedre. Bliv klogere på arbejdslivet i Bankdata* ***her****.*

*Hos Bankdata arbejder vi målrettet med at fremme mangfoldighed og diversitet blandt vores medarbejdere, og vi opfordrer derfor alle uanset kønsidentitet, alder og kulturel baggrund til at søge job hos os.*

jobs.title: System Architect, Software
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about software architecture and motivated by shaping the technology foundation behind innovative energy solutions? Do you enjoy defining architecture strategies, influencing technology direction, and solving complex technical challenges across embedded, cloud, and connectivity platforms?


*At DEIF A/S, we develop advanced control solutions that keep power stable and efficient – whether from wind, solar, or traditional sources. With more than* ***700 employees worldwide****, we set new standards in energy efficiency and power conversion, working every day to become the market leader in intelligent energy control. Together, we create solutions that* ***Improve******Tomorrow****.*


**About the job**  

As **System Architect, Software**, you will play a key role in defining and driving the software architecture that supports DEIF's controllers, connectivity, and cloud solutions – and as part of this you will also spearhead our Cyber Security efforts.


You will help shape the future technological direction of DEIF by establishing architecture principles, defining reference architectures, and guiding development teams in creating secure, scalable, and maintainable software solutions.


Working closely with software architects, hardware architects, product architects, development teams, and other key stakeholders, you will ensure that technology decisions support both current product development and DEIF's long\-term ambitions.


This is a unique opportunity to influence the architecture behind innovative energy solutions used by customers worldwide and contribute to technologies that support a more sustainable future.


*Read more about DEIF’s performance and strategic initiatives and goals* *here**.*


**Your responsibilities**


* Define and drive the software architecture strategy across Controllers, Connectivity, and Cloud platforms
* Develop and maintain DEIF's software reference architecture
* Ensure architecture decisions support business objectives, scalability, security, and maintainability
* Collaborate with software, hardware, and product architects to create a unified technology roadmap
* Guide and support development teams on architecture and design decisions
* Guide and support the entire organization on Cyber Security (IEC62443, NIS2, CRA etc.)
* Evaluate technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns to support future product development
* Drive architectural consistency across products and platforms
* Contribute to the integration of emerging technologies such as AI, Machine Learning, advanced connectivity, and cloud\-native solutions
* Promote best practices within software quality, cyber security, lifecycle management, and governance
* Participate in strategic development projects and help solve complex technical challenges


**Your profile**  

You are an experienced Software Architect who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to influence and set direction across a large engineering organisation. You communicate complex technical concepts clearly, build alignment among stakeholders, and are comfortable challenging existing approaches when better solutions exist.


You possess the credibility, assertiveness, and collaborative mindset needed to drive architectural decisions across Controllers, Connectivity, and Cloud platforms while ensuring long\-term scalability, security, and business value.


Furthermore, you:


* Have 5\-7 years experience with software architecture and modern software development
* Bring expertise in cloud technologies, cyber security, and scalable software design
* Have experience with embedded systems, connectivity solutions, and/or AI technologies
* Possess strong programming skills in technologies such as C\+\+, C\#, or Java
* Enjoy influencing technical direction and collaborating across disciplines
* Communicate fluently in English


**Why join DEIF?**  

At DEIF A/S, you’ll be part of a family\-owned company with strong values and a culture built on trust, openness, and collaboration. You’ll experience a professional and highly engaged working environment, where we’re curious on each other’s perspectives and encourage respectful, honest dialogue that drives growth. Our strength lies in responsibility, teamwork, and the courage to innovate – that’s what drives us forward.


In addition to a role filled with exciting challenges, **we offer you**:


* **A key architectural role** with significant influence on DEIF's future technology direction
* The opportunity to **shape software platforms** and **products** used globally
* **Close collaboration with highly skilled specialists** across software, hardware, and product development
* **Flexible work arrangements**, including home office days
* **A modern work environment** with state\-of\-the\-art facilities
* **In\-house** **canteen** and **physiotherapist** at our headquarters
* Fitness activities, social events, and a strong focus on wellbeing


*Want to know more about working at DEIF? Visit our* *career page* *today!*

*“**At DEIF, we want all candidates to have the best possible opportunity to present their experience, skills, and motivation. Therefore, we offer free access to an online applicant training course with practical advice on CVs, applications and job searching in general. The training takes approximately 30 minutes to complete, and you are free to choose the topics most relevant to you. The course is provided by an external partner, and DEIF does not receive information about who participates. Participation is entirely voluntary, and candidates are not assessed based on whether they complete the training.*


***Sign up for the applicant training here:*** https://hrcaseforum.simplero.com/page/192181\-deif\-applicant”

jobs.title: Developer
jobs.description:
Du bliver en del af Professional Services (PS) – vores forretningsenhed, der arbejder med digitalisering og teknologiske løsninger inden for ERP, CRM, Microsoft 365, Business Intelligence, Cyber Consultancy, Custom Built Solutions og AI.


I forretningsområdet Custom Built Solutions vil du indgå i vores Products\-team, der udvikler og driver Danmarks førende elektroniske patientjournalsystem til den kommunale tandpleje. Vi søger en full\-stack Developer med særligt fokus på frontend\-udvikling. Samtidig skal du blive motiveret af at arbejde med videreudvikling og forbedring af et veletableret system, som hver dag understøtter arbejdet i den kommunale tandpleje i samarbejde med dygtige kollegaer.


Du bliver tilknyttet vores kontor i Viby eller Nordhavn med mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Du kan dog forvente periodisk mødeaktivitet på begge lokationer.


**Din rolle**  

Som Developer kommer du til at arbejde med videreudvikling og vedligeholdelse af vores system til den kommunale tandpleje. Rollen har primært fokus på frontend\-udvikling og integrationer til øvrige systemer, men du kommer også til at være involveret i prioritering af produktudvikling, test, fejlsøgning og dokumentation sammen med resten af det stærke team omkring produktet. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med resten af teamet bl.a. bestående af produktkonsulenter, supportere og andre udviklere, hvor alle har et stærkt ønske om at forbedre og styrke systemets funktionaliteter og sikre glade kunder. Vi løfter i fællesskab, og derfor er det væsentligt, at du er en holdspiller.


Derudover kan rollen også indebære dialog og sparring med kunder – både over for tekniske og ikke\-tekniske interessenter. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du trives i rollen som sparringspartner og kan omsætte og formidle tekniske løsninger i et sprog, der giver mening for brugerne og for dine kollegaer i teamet.


Dine primære ansvarsområder dækker over følgende:

* Afdække kundernes forretningsbehov og omsætte dem til tekniske løsninger og systemfunktioner.
* Fejlsøge og forbedre eksisterende integrationer for at sikre stabil dataudveksling.
* Udvikle nye frontend\-funktioner til systemet.
* Vedligeholde og optimere eksisterende kodebase for at sikre stabil drift og høj performance.
* Bidrage til teknisk sparring i forbindelse med design af nye funktioner.
* Udarbejde og gennemføre tests af nye funktioner og integrationer.
* Udarbejde teknisk dokumentation af nye funktioner, integrationer og systemændringer.

**Vi søger en teamm8 der**
  

Ønsker en rolle med fokus på både nyudvikling og vedligeholdelse af et anerkendt system inden for et nicheområde. Derudover ser vi gerne at følgende er opfyldt:

* 3\-5 års erfaring fra en rolle som udvikler særligt med fokus på frontend\-udvikling, hvor du eventuelt har arbejdet med Middleware, Unit\-testing og/eller CI/CD.
* Gerne viden om WinForms, .Net Framework/.Net Core, SQL Server, Git og/eller Azure DevOps.
* Evner at forklare kompleks kode i et sprog som kollegaer og kunder forstår.
* Motiveres i kundedialoger og behovsafdækning, som herefter omsættes til konkrete løsninger.
* Behersker dansk og engelsk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

**Det du får**

* En unik mulighed for at arbejde med softwareudvikling i et nichesystem, der er anerkendt i markedet.
* Mulighed for tage ansvar i en udviklingsrolle af teknisk karakter, hvor du formår at spille systemets brugere gode med rette rådgivning.
* At blive en del af en hybrid arbejdsplads med mulighed for hjemmearbejde.
* Indgå i en kultur med ambitioner, ærlighed og plads til personlig udvikling
* At blive en del af en ambitiøs IT\-koncern med 1600 teamm8s, der hepper på dig.

**Skal du med på holdet?**  

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.


Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Stefanie Kerstin Krüger Holtum, Manager \- Custom Built Solutions på skkru@itm8\.com. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.


Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter straffeattest forud for ansættelse.


Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

 **Om itm8**


Vi er itm8 – vores kunders IT\-mate.


Bag os står 1\.600\+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Med specialister inden for alt fra IT\-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.

jobs.title: Automation Software Engineer, Central Maintenance
jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 122 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 49,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**Your role**

As an **Automation Software Engineer** , you will develop and **support software solutions** that enable automation, data acquisition, process control, and equipment integration in a high\-volume **semiconductor manufacturing** environment. You will work closely with equipment engineering, process engineering, production, quality, and DTIT teams to improve tool uptime (e.g. ALTS, SAM Machines, DAP/DAS, CPS etc), process stability, traceability, yield, and overall tool performance.


**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize automation and equipment control software for (DAP/DAS, ALTS, SAM Machines etc) semiconductor manufacturing systems.
* Support integration of production tools, test equipment, sensors, databases, MES, and factory host systems.
* Monitor, debug, and troubleshoot automation software, interfaces, and manufacturing applications to ensure stable operation.
* Analyze process and equipment data to identify abnormalities, improve performance, and support root\-cause analysis.
* Contribute to equipment qualification (User Acceptance Testing), software validation, and deployment of new automation solutions or upgrades.
* Document software logic, interface specifications, change records, and operating procedures.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on yield, cycle time, quality, reliability, cost, and safety.

**Your skills and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of experience in software development, automation, industrial control systems, or semiconductor manufacturing support.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as **Python, C\#, C\+\+** , **Java** , or similar.
* Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing systems such as **PLCs, MES, SECS/GEM** , databases, and equipment interfaces is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and perform root\-cause analysis **CAPA** .
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering and production functions.
* Ability to work in a structured, fast\-paced cleanroom environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and eager to grow technically in a semiconductor manufacturing setting.
* Internship, project, or hands\-on experience in semiconductor automation or test software is an advantage.
* Build and maintain customized dashboards and reports to monitor system health, throughput, and utilization
* Extensive knowledge of Microsoft office suite

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2026 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.  



  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


Forward Deployed Engineers take a defined use case from nothing to a working, production\-grade system inside the customer's environment. That starts with knowing our platform deeply enough to combine its capabilities into solutions more complex than any single feature was designed for \- and where a customer's specific needs call for something beyond the standard functionality, building that missing piece themselves. This is the role that builds the use case: not a prototype handed to someone else to production, but the system that goes live.


This is a customer\-facing role. Understanding the customer's needs and the realistic possibilities of their technical environment \- and working in close, daily collaboration with them \- is what makes a deployment succeed. We're in daily working contact with the customer's engineers and executives, mostly online, with our team and theirs operating as one delivery unit with shared planning. Success is measured on the customer's numbers \- resolution rate, containment, response latency, CSAT, cost per contact \- and accountability continues past go\-live.


Forward Deployed Engineering brings together two disciplines that used to sit apart: conversation design and integration engineering. An engineer who can build the technical logic behind a scenario; a conversation designer who can design the flow of the conversation itself \- that is what an FDE is. We hire people who are genuinely strong in one of the two and want to grow the other \- expert in both is a direction of travel, not an entry bar. The role is based in Prague and is part of a global function with teams in EMEA and North America.


Please note this is a hybrid role with significant customer on\-site availability required.


**Responsibilities**

* Own the solution design: translate a stated business problem into a technical architecture that fits the customer’s actual processes, constraints and systems.
* Build the agent 01: design, build and iterate the first working version end to end \- the system that goes into production, not a hand\-off.
* Close product gaps: build the custom extensions, integrations, services and tooling the deployment requires, without waiting for core roadmap prioritization.
* Own the integration surface: systems of record, contact channels and data flows \- and, for voice deployments, the telephony path from carrier to agent.
* Evaluate, iterate, improve: define the workflow\-specific tests that determine whether this deployment actually works, and iterate against real traffic until the numbers move.
* Work as the customer’s technical counterpart: deploy alongside their engineers, monitor against the agreed KPIs, tune, and stay accountable past go\-live.
* Feed the platform: capture what you built as a reusable pattern and push recurring patterns toward the core product \- the field is our sensing arm.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2\+ years building and shipping software in a customer\-facing role \- solutions or forward\-deployed engineering, professional services delivery, integration engineering, or product engineering with direct customer exposure.
* Genuine depth in at least one of our two disciplines, and the appetite to grow the other: conversation and agent design (dialogue logic, prompting, flows, evaluation) or integration engineering (APIs, services, systems of record, data flows).
* Strong hands\-on coding in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and/or C\#/.NET \- comfortable writing and maintaining production services, not only scripts.
* Solid working experience of SQL, Linux and Docker \- just as important as the languages above.
* Solid grasp of software architecture and API integration: authentication, webhooks, queues, error handling and failure modes.
* Experience distributing data across critically loaded infrastructure, and the ability to account for race conditions, deadlocks and thread safety when designing systems.
* Ability to work directly with customer engineers and executives \- distil a complex system into a clear explanation, present a design, and defend a trade\-off.
* A track record of owning a complex project end to end, against real deliverables and real dates.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with non\-deterministic systems: forming a hypothesis, building the evaluation that tests it, and iterating to a number.
* Willingness to travel.
* Professional English, used daily with colleagues in EMEA and North America; Czech strongly preferred for work with regional customers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Conversational AI or voice agents in production \- flow and prompt design, retrieval, tool calling, and evaluation harnesses against real traffic.
* Contact centre and CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Avaya, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect) plus telephony fundamentals \- SIP, DTMF, transfer, failover.
* Integration with enterprise systems of record: CRM, ERP, data warehouses, custom internal APIs.
* Cloud and container deployment (Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
* GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and data residency handled as architectural constraints, not paperwork.
* Using AI tooling as a core part of how you build, not a side tab you open occasionally.
* Additional Central European languages, particularly Slovak, Polish or German.

  

**Benefits**  

  

**About CallMiner**
Does the possibility of using artificial intelligence to improve human connection excite you? We agree!


CallMiner is the global leader in AI\-powered conversation intelligence and customer experience (CX) automation. Our industry\-recognized platform captures and analyzes 100% of omnichannel customer interactions delivering the insights organizations need to improve CX, enhance agent performance, and drive automation at scale. By combining advanced AI, industry\-leading analytics, and real\-time conversation intelligence, we empower organizations to uncover customer needs, optimize processes, and automate workflows and interactions. The result: higher customer satisfaction, reduced operational costs, and faster, data\-driven decisions. Trusted by leading brands in technology, media \& telecom, retail, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, and travel \& hospitality, we help organizations transform customer insights into action.


CallMiner's core set of values – from maniacal customer focus and radical candor to team mentality and transparency – serve as a touchstone for what we strive to create in a workplace culture and weave through everything we do as a company. We believe that by building a team of brilliant, inspired people, we can truly accomplish amazing things together. We are committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels accepted, valued, and understood.


Our strong commitment to a positive environment continually earns us recognition as a top workplace, including Boston Globe Top Place to Work.

 **Benefits \+ Perks**
At CallMiner, we believe having a work\-life balance is key to being able to deliver your best every day. Our perks are designed to enhance your daily work experience, promote your personal growth, and help you achieve a better work\-life balance. From Maternity and Paternity Leave, ample Holidays, Fitness and Health Reimbursement, Tuition Reimbursement and more, we aim to provide an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, ancestry, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Applied AI Architect
jobs.description:
**About Kairostek**
===================


At Kairostek, we believe great technology starts with great people.


We foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, empowering our team to make a meaningful impact while building solutions that shape the future. Our teams work across software engineering, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital products, payments technology, and technology operations to deliver scalable and innovative solutions for global organizations.


If you are passionate about technology, problem\-solving, and continuous learning, we would love to hear from you.

**About the Role**
==================


As an Applied AI Architect, you will be the trusted technical advisor for how AI gets built and used across Kairostek. Your customers are our own product development squads and business teams. You will help them see where large language models can create real value, and then guide them from first idea to a reliable service running in production.


This is a hands\-on role. You will work closely with our Agentics squad, building prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, writing near\-production reference code, and designing the evaluation frameworks that tell us whether an AI feature is ready to ship. Alongside that, you will turn what works into reusable blueprints, patterns, and training that every squad can pick up.


Working with Engineering, you will set the architecture, standards, and guardrails for AI, so that teams can move quickly without taking on unmanaged risk.


You will report directly to, and work closely with, our VP of Development \& AI. Together you will shape the department's AI strategy and roadmap, decide where to invest, and turn that direction into architecture and delivery across the squads.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Partner with squad leads and stakeholders to understand their problems and translate them into practical AI solutions, keeping business outcomes and technical design aligned
* Act as the primary technical advisor for AI adoption across the department, coordinating across teams to get use cases delivered
* Ship working code: build prototypes and proofs of concept, develop evaluation frameworks, and write reference implementations that squads can take to production
* Design and own the reference architecture for LLM applications and agentic workflows, covering model selection, orchestration, retrieval, tool integration, and deployment
* Guide squads on integrating AI into our existing Java, .NET, Node.js, and React platforms, including APIs, event streams, and tool protocols such as MCP
* Help teams build evaluation frameworks that measure quality, latency, and cost for their specific use cases, and keep them from regressing over time
* Define security, privacy, and governance standards for AI use, including data handling, access control, prompt injection defence, and auditability
* Develop reusable blueprints, demos, and enablement material that scale across squads, and run workshops for engineers and non\-technical stakeholders
* Identify common patterns and gaps across use cases and feed them back into our platform, tooling, and vendor decisions
* Stay current with developments in models, agent frameworks, and implementation practice, and bring the useful parts into how we work

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* 5\+ years of highly technical experience as a software engineer, solutions architect, or equivalent, with hands\-on experience shipping LLM\-based applications
* A builder mentality: you have shipped real software, you care about craftsmanship, and you have good technical judgement
* Systems thinking: you would rather build one solution that serves ten teams than ten solutions that each serve one
* Strong coding ability in Python, with regular prototype delivery and experience working in real production codebases
* Practical experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, agent orchestration, and common LLM frameworks and tools
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and integrating with existing enterprise systems
* The ability to build trust with engineers and explain complicated topics clearly to leaders and non\-technical teams
* Comfort working in ambiguous, early\-stage areas and building structure as you go
* Skill at working across teams, navigating trade\-offs and competing priorities
* A teaching and mentoring mindset, and a genuine interest in helping others succeed with AI
* A passion for using AI in ways that are safe, responsible, and beneficial

**Strong Candidates May Also Have:**

* Background in iGaming, fintech, payments, or cryptocurrency platforms
* Experience applying AI in regulated environments, with awareness of AML, KYC, GDPR, or PCI\-DSS requirements
* Hands\-on experience with the Model Context Protocol, coding agents, and AI\-assisted software delivery
* Experience with LLMOps tooling, observability for non\-deterministic systems, and cost optimisation at scale
* A background in data engineering, ML engineering, or data science

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive compensation package.
* Flexible and remote\-friendly work environment.
* Professional growth and development opportunities.
* Exposure to international projects and teams.
* Collaborative and inclusive company culture.
* Opportunity to work with modern technologies and innovative solutions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
==============================


Kairostek is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from qualified candidates regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or background.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
**The Role**

  

 The Evolve programme is accelerating Euroclear’s adoption of public cloud by establishing secure, resilient and scalable foundations, architecture standards and reusable implementation patterns. It brings together architecture, engineering, security, operations and migration stakeholders to enable workloads to move to and operate effectively on Azure in line with Euroclear’s business, risk and regulatory requirements.

  

 As Principal Cloud Architect, you will act as a senior architecture leader for cloud adoption. You will set architecture direction across a broad, cross\-organisational scope; help mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority into an effective and sustainable decision\-making body; steer cloud foundation priorities; govern architecture artefacts and reference implementations; and provide pragmatic guidance to workload teams.

  

 The role combines strategic architecture leadership, hands\-on delivery support and cross\-functional decision\-making. A key outcome is to expand Euroclear’s cloud presence responsibly by turning cloud strategy and principles into actionable standards, deployable patterns and sound workload decisions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Cloud Solution Design Authority**

* Mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority by clarifying its mandate, decision rights, intake process, governance, cadence, quality criteria and follow\-up of architecture decisions.
* Establish a sustainable operating rhythm that enables timely, traceable and risk\-informed decisions.
* Facilitate complex architecture discussions, document outcomes and ensure that decisions, conditions and actions have clear owners.
* Improve the quality and consistency of architecture submissions by providing guidance, templates and early engagement.
  

 Cloud Foundations and Roadmap

* Refine, prioritise and maintain the cloud foundation roadmap across identity, connectivity, security, governance, management, operations and automation.
* Balance migration demand, risk reduction, platform scalability, technical debt and delivery capacity when setting priorities.
* Identify cross\-platform dependencies and sequence foundation capabilities so that workload teams can adopt cloud safely and efficiently.
* Advise programme and technology leadership on architecture choices, investment priorities and delivery trade\-offs.
  

 Architecture Direction and Artefacts

* Develop, maintain and govern cloud architecture principles, standards, target\-state designs, roadmaps and architecture decision records.
* Translate enterprise strategy, regulatory expectations and delivery needs into clear architecture direction.
  

* Ensure cloud architecture remains aligned with enterprise, security, data, resilience and technology standards.
* Maintain traceability between strategic objectives, architecture decisions, implementation guidance and delivery outcomes.
  

 Reference Implementations and Reusable Patterns

* Prioritise reusable cloud patterns and reference implementations based on workload demand, risk reduction and strategic value.
* Guide their delivery so that approved patterns are deployable, testable, automated and consumable by workload teams.
* Translate architecture into infrastructure\-as\-code accelerators, policy\-driven guardrails and reusable platform services.
* Promote standardisation and governed self\-service while limiting manual fulfilment and one\-off solutions to justified exceptions.
  

 Workload Assessment and Migration Guidance

* Support migration teams and workload owners in assessing application architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability, compatibility and migration readiness.
* Recommend appropriate migration or modernisation strategies based on business value, criticality, compliance, lifecycle impact and technical feasibility.
* Help teams select the most appropriate service model, considering SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS without assuming that one model is universally optimal.
* Identify architecture gaps and convert assessment findings into actionable remediation, sequencing and decision points.
  

 Cloud Footprint and Regional Architecture

* Shape the expansion of Euroclear’s cloud footprint, including new\-region adoption, regional operating models and multi\-region approaches.
* Assess implications for foundations, connectivity, identity, security, data residency, resilience, operations, support and cost.
* Define architecture guidance for workload placement and regional deployment.
* Ensure exceptions to approved regions or patterns have documented rationale, risk assessment, ownership and approval.
  

 Sustainability and Net\-Zero Assessment

* Assess the cloud implications of sustainability and Net\-Zero\-related decisions.
* Evaluate architecture trade\-offs involving region selection, service choices, resource efficiency, carbon considerations, cost, resilience and performance.
  

* Promote efficient use of managed and cloud\-native services where they provide measurable value and acceptable risk.
* Ensure sustainability considerations are incorporated into architecture decisions and roadmaps without compromising security, regulation or service quality.
  

 Architecture Assurance

* Review solution designs and assess alignment with approved principles, standards, target architectures and reference patterns.
* Identify material risks, gaps and deviations, and provide clear recommendations to delivery teams and decision\-makers.
* Ensure exceptions have an explicit rationale, accountable owner, remediation action and expiry or review date.
* Track recurring deviations and use them to improve standards, patterns, platform capabilities and governance.
  

 Stakeholder Alignment and Leadership

* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Engineering, CISO, Production, Business Resilience, migration teams, programme leadership and workload owners.
* Resolve architectural dependencies and accelerate decisions across organisational boundaries.
* Influence senior business and IT stakeholders by making complex trade\-offs clear and decision\-ready.
* Challenge constructively and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.
  

 Architecture Community and Knowledge Transfer

* Coach and mentor architects and engineers working on cloud initiatives.
* Strengthen the architecture community through knowledge sharing, reviews, reusable guidance and lessons learned.
* Ensure cloud standards, patterns and decision processes are understood and applied consistently.
* Promote pragmatic, collaborative and outcome\-focused ways of working across architecture and delivery teams.
  

**Candidate Profile**

  

**Required Experience**

* Extensive experience as a cloud architect, enterprise architect or principal solution architect in large\-scale technology transformation.
  

* Demonstrated experience leading architecture across complex, cross\-organisational business and IT scopes.
* Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including landing zones, identity and access management, network topology, security, governance, policy, management, observability and platform automation.
* Experience establishing or maturing design authorities, architecture review boards, decision processes and architecture assurance practices.
* Proven ability to develop and govern principles, standards, target architectures, roadmaps, architecture decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance.
* Experience translating architecture into infrastructure\-as\-code accelerators, reference implementations, guardrails and consumable platform services.
* Practical experience assessing workload architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability and compatibility, and recommending migration or modernisation strategies.
* Experience designing or governing multi\-region cloud environments, including region selection, connectivity, data residency, resilience, operational support and cost trade\-offs.
* Strong understanding of security by design, policy\-driven governance, shared responsibility and risk\-proportionate control models.
* Experience in financial services, financial market infrastructure or another regulated environment.
* Good understanding of ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection and third\-party requirements relevant to regulated financial institutions.
* Proven ability to align senior stakeholders, facilitate complex decisions and communicate architecture recommendations clearly.
* Ability to balance strategic direction, portfolio prioritisation and detailed technical implementation challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex architecture topics clear, actionable and decision\-ready.
* Experience working in Agile, DevOps or hybrid delivery environments.
* Proficiency in English.
  

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience applying Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and enterprise\-scale Azure landing\-zone principles.
* Experience with cloud\-native and managed service adoption across SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS.
* Knowledge of application modernisation, integration architecture, APIs, event\-driven design, data platforms or container platforms.
* Experience with FinOps, cloud cost transparency and continuous optimisation.
  

* Experience assessing cloud sustainability and resource\-efficiency implications.
* Knowledge of post\-trade market infrastructure or comparable critical financial\-market environments.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as Open Agile Architecture or TOGAF.
* Working proficiency in French or Dutch.
  

**Certifications**

  

 The following certifications are valued. Candidates are not expected to hold all of them, but should demonstrate relevant depth across Azure architecture, security and enterprise architecture:

* Azure Architecture: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Azure Security: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent.
* DevOps and Automation: Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Terraform certification or equivalent infrastructure\-as\-code accreditation.
* Enterprise Architecture: TOGAF, Open Agile Architecture or an equivalent architecture certification.
* Security and Risk: CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC or equivalent.
* FinOps and Sustainability: FinOps Certified Practitioner or relevant cloud sustainability training.

  

**Please note that this is a permanent position, and we do not offer freelance/contract arrangement for the role**
 .

  

**In order to cultivate relationships and promote team spirit, we require your presence in the office for a minimum of 8 days per month.**

### **Onderneming**

### **Functie**


Om de verdere groei van het bedrijf te ondersteunen zijn we op zoek naar een **Backend Developer .NET**. In deze functie werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling, modernisering en verdere uitbouw van onze interne softwareoplossingen en het achterliggende servicelandschap.


Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:


* Het zelfstandig meewerken aan verschillende softwareprojecten, in nauwe samenwerking met andere developers, functionele analisten en de application architect.

* Het ontwikkelen van nieuwe toepassingen en services, maar ook het moderniseren en verder uitbouwen van bestaande oplossingen.
* Het werken met zowel synchrone als asynchrone communicatie tussen services, onder andere via REST API's en messaging.
* Het schrijven van onderhoudbare, testbare en consistente code volgens de afgesproken development\- en architectuurconventies.
* Het actief deelnemen aan code reviews en mee bewaken van de kwaliteit van de codebase.
* Het helpen verbeteren van onze development lifecycle, technische standaarden en development guidelines.
* Het actief opvolgen van relevante evoluties binnen het .NET\-ecosysteem en samen met het team beoordelen waar nieuwe technologie een meerwaarde kan bieden.

### **Profiel**


In deze functie verwachten we dat je zelfstandig kan werken, initiatief neemt en actief meedenkt over technische keuzes. Je werkt binnen een team van developers en analisten en kan technische beslissingen duidelijk onderbouwen en bespreken.


* Opleiding en ervaring – Je hebt een bachelor\- of masterdiploma Informatica of bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als backend developer en een sterke interesse in softwareontwikkeling en softwarekwaliteit.
* **Analyse** – Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je kan complexe problemen structureren, pragmatische oplossingen uitwerken en technische keuzes onderbouwen.

* **Kwaliteitsgericht werken** – Je hecht belang aan leesbare en onderhoudbare code, geautomatiseerde tests, consistente ontwikkelstandaarden en degelijke code reviews.
* **Talenkennis** – Je beheerst vlot de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Kennis van Frans is een pluspunt.

**Technische kennis**
---------------------


Je hebt hands\-on ervaring met:


* **C\# en modern .NET**, bij voorkeur .NET 8 of recenter
* Het ontwikkelen van **REST API's** met ASP.NET Core
* **Entity Framework Core** en relationele databases, bij voorkeur SQL Server
* Asynchroon programmeren
* Dependency injection en gangbare .NET\-ontwikkelpatronen
* Git en een professionele development workflow met branches, pull requests en code reviews.


Ervaring met één of meerdere van onderstaande technologieën of concepten is een sterke meerwaarde:


* Microservice architectuur
* **CQRS** en event\-driven architectuur
* Asynchronous messaging, bijvoorbeeld met **MassTransit en RabbitMQ**
* **NoSQL** databases
* **Minimal APIs** en API\-versioning
* EF Core
* JWT\-gebaseerde authenticatie en autorisatie
* Automated testing met bijvoorbeeld **xUnit** en **Moq**
* CI/CD en work management via **Azure DevOps**
* Domeinmodellering en principes uit **Domain\-Driven Design** en **SOLID**, toegepast op een pragmatische manier
* Logging, monitoring en observability, bijvoorbeeld via Application Insights

### **Aanbod**


Wat bieden wij?

* Functie – Je maakt deel uit van het IT team en rapporteert aan Head of IT Architechture \& BI.
* Salaris – we bieden een competitief salarispakket bestaande uit een vast loon, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering, groepsverzekering, firmawagen en 30% personeelskorting bij ZEB, The Fashion Store en PointCarré.

jobs.title: Design Engineer Infraworks
jobs.description:
**Design Engineer Infraworks**



Antwerpen, Gent, Hasselt of Brussel

Als **Design Engineer Infraworks** in onze **afdeling Infrastructures** draag je elke dag bij aan onze missie door een cruciale rol te spelen in het ontwerpen, modelleren en optimaliseren van complexe infrastructuurprojecten. Met behulp van geavanceerde softwaretools zoals Autodesk InfraWorks en Civil 3D creëer je innovatieve oplossingen voor wegen, rioleringssystemen en andere infrastructuren. Je **rapporteert aan** de **Competence Centre Manager BIM /CAD**.

  



Als Design Engineer is het mogelijk om vanuit onze kantoren in Antwerpen, Gent, Hasselt of Brussel te werken.

  



Klaar om het verschil te maken? Dan kijken we ernaar uit je te ontmoeten!

  


**Wat wij bieden**


* Tractebel is meer dan een werkplek. Dit is jouw kans om te groeien aan de zijde van **topexperts** in **impactvolle projecten** wereldwijd. Deze omgeving is gebouwd op **teamgeest** waarin je je hoogste potentieel kunt bereiken. Het management steunt actief de ontwikkeling van zijn mensen en er zijn talloze mogelijkheden tot **groei** binnen de ENGIE Groep.
* Wij bieden een **competitief salarispakket**, inclusief representatievergoedingen, dubbel betaalde vakantiedagen, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, bonussen, hospitalisatieverzekering, pc\-privéplan, ENGIE\-aandelenopties en meer.
* Onze **mobiliteitsplannen** kunnen aangepast worden aan jouw behoeften: een bedrijfswagen, treinabonnement, leasefiets of combinaties hiervan ... Je kan je bedrijfswagen ook inruilen voor het flexibele en fiscaal gunstige **Belgische mobiliteitsbudget**!\*\*
* **Flexibele** hybride regelingen maken **telewerken** (2\-3 dagen per week), werken op locatie of onderweg mogelijk. Via voordelige aankoopprogramma's en genereuze bijdragen aan je mobiele en internetabonnementen deelt Tractebel in de kosten van je thuiskantoor.
* Vakantie: 32 dagen. Je kunt ook 5 extra dagen kopen voor extra ontspanning.
* Om onze successen te vieren en plezier te maken komen we samen voor teamsporten, afterworks, teambuildingactiviteiten, ons jaarlijkse feest en veel meer.

  


**Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden**

  

* Ontwerpen en modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten:
	+ Gebruik maken van InfraWorks en Civil 3D om ontwerpconcepten voor infrastructuur te visualiseren, simuleren en optimaliseren (wegen, spoorwegen, rioleringssystemen, etc.).
	+ Analyseren van topografische, geospatiale en geotechnische gegevens voor het creëren van realistische en betrouwbare modellen.
	+ Uitvoeren van dimensionering en berekeningen voor wegontwerpen, waterbeheer en andere infrastructuurnetwerken.
* Samenwerking met projectteams:
	+ Nauw samenwerken met interne teams en externe stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat ontwerpen voldoen aan specificaties en lokale normen.
	+ Coördineren met de ontwerp\-, engineering\- en constructieteams om de technische haalbaarheid van projecten te waarborgen.
* Analyseren van projectgegevens en simulaties uitvoeren:
	+ Integreren van geografische gegevens en andere informatie uit terreinmetingen in BIM\-modellen voor een efficiënter ontwerp\- en bouwproces.
	+ Gebruik maken van simulaties om de impact van het ontwerp te evalueren op milieu, kosten en tijd.
* Ondersteuning bij documentatie en rapporten:
	+ Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van projectdocumentatie, rapporten en presentaties voor klanten en belanghebbenden.

  





**We horen graag van mensen met**

  


* Minimaal een bachelor in Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
* Uitgebreide ervaring met **Autodesk InfraWorks** en **Civil 3D.**
	+ Autodesk InfraWorks: Gedetailleerd 3D\-modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten en het uitvoeren van simulaties van realistische scenario’s.
	+ Autodesk Civil 3D: Ontwerpen van wegen, analyse van rioleringssystemen en het beheren van topografische en geotechnische data.
	+ BIM (Building Information Modeling): Bekwaamheid in het werken met BIM voor het optimaliseren van ontwerpprocessen en de samenwerking tussen verschillende teams.
* Grondige kennis van infrastructuurontwerp en \-modellering.
	+ Grondige kennis van **ontwerpprincipes voor hoofdwegen, primaire wegen en andere infrastructuurelementen.**
	+ Ervaring in het ontwerpen en modelleren van rioleringssystemen, wegen en andere civiele infrastructuur.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het werken in teamverband.
* Probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.

  



**Ons rekruteringsproces**


* Pre\-screeningsgesprek / diepgaand HR\-interview (op locatie of via Teams) met de Talent Acquisition Partner
* 1 of 2 inhoudelijke interviews (bij voorkeur op locatie) met uw toekomstige manager

  



Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen solliciteren wanneer ze aan 60% van de vereisten voldoen, terwijl vrouwen pas solliciteren wanneer ze ervan overtuigd zijn dat ze aan 100% voldoen. Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden – we horen graag van je!

  


**Wie je bent**

* **Communicatievaardigheden**: Het vermogen om effectief en duidelijk te communiceren in het Nederlands met projectteams, klanten en andere belanghebbenden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* **Samenwerken in teamverband**: Ervaring met het werken in een multidisciplinair team en het succesvol bereiken van gezamenlijke ontwerpdoelen.
* **Probleemoplossend vermogen**: Sterk analytisch denkvermogen en het vermogen om technische problemen snel te identificeren en op te lossen.
* **Oog voor detail:** Zorgvuldigheid en precisie in ontwerpwerkzaamheden, waarbij geen enkel detail over het hoofd wordt gezien.
* **Tijdbeheer en organisatie:** Het vermogen om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren en prioriteiten te stellen om deadlines te halen

  


**Wie we zijn**

Klaar om je positieve impact vorm te geven? Sluit je dan aan bij Tractebel, onderdeel van de **ENGIE Groep**, en onze 5600 gepassioneerde **experts** wereldwijd die zich iedere dag inzetten om te bouwen aan een **duurzamere wereld**. Draag bij aan koolstofneutraliteit in verschillende sectoren**, zoals kernenergie, hernieuwbare energie, gas en elektriciteit, elektriciteitsnetten, waterkrachtcentrales en stuwdammen, waterbeheer en \-voorziening, ontzilting, complexe en hoogtechnologische gebouwen, transportinfrastructuren en havens en waterwegen.**

  


**Mensen, ethiek, veiligheid en duurzaamheid zijn onze topprioriteiten.** Met Tractebel verkeer je in een unieke positie om een positieve impact te maken op de wereldwijde net zero\-doelstellingen. Als drijvende kracht achter deze doelstellingen zien we jou als onze grootste troef. **Onze mensen komen op de eerste plaats en diversiteit is onze kracht.** Diversiteit biedt immers nieuwe perspectieven die de drijvende kracht zijn achter prestaties en innovatie. Daarom verwelkomen we alle sollicitanten en blijven we ons inzetten voor een inclusieve werkplek.

  



Bij ENGIE, heeft elk talent een rol te spelen in het versnellen van de energietransitie. Maak het verschil en geniet van een verrijkende professionele ervaring. Ga interessante uitdagingen aan en bouw aan een carrièrepad dat weerspiegelt wie je bent.**Sluit je aan bij ons en maak deel uit van het avontuur van de eeuw!**

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (BE-CEM-MRO-2026-156-GRAP)
jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Help shape the future of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) machine protection systems. We are looking for a motivated Engineer to contribute to the renovation of the LHC Collimator Control System, a critical component ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the world's most powerful particle accelerator. Working in a highly collaborative environment you will help to increase the reliability, usability, and long\-term maintainability of systems at the heart of LHC operations. This is a unique opportunity to combine software development, controls engineering, and accelerator technology while making a tangible impact on CERN's flagship facility.

**Your responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain control applications for the LHC Collimator system using the FESA framework, ensuring integration within CERN's accelerator control environment.
* Coordinate and support control system commissioning, performing functional testing, validation, and verification of interlocks and fail\-safes prior to operational deployment.
* Integrate control systems with the alarm server and develop high\-level tools to enhance usability and real\-time monitoring.
* Contribute to the design and validation of system\-level tests, including functional, integration, and regression testing.
* Support expert and operational interfaces, providing diagnostic capabilities and improving intervention workflows.

**Your profile**

* Demonstrated experience in real\-time or distributed control systems, preferably within accelerator, industrial automation, or scientific environments.
* Experience in interventions in complex industrial or technical environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining expert interfaces (GUIs, web tools) for control and diagnostics.
* Experience with software version control (e.g. Git) and CI/CD workflows.


Skills

* Proficiency in C\+\+.
* Knowledge of Python.
* Skilled in system integration, commissioning, and validation of control applications for hardware\-software systems.
* Strong ability to troubleshoot, analyse, and document complex technical issues in operational environments.
* Proactive, organised, and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicate technical progress clearly.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* You have a professional background in Controls Engineering, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
	+ a **Master's degree with 2 to 6 years** of post\-graduation professional experience;
	+ or a **PhD with no more than 3 years** of post\-graduation professional experience.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

  

**Additional Information**  

Job closing date: **18\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**


Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-January\-2027


Job reference: BE\-CEM\-MRO\-2026\-156\-GRAP


Field of work: Information Technologies


Benchmark job: 200020 \- Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

**More information about us, here:** **careers.cern**

jobs.title: Splunk Solutions Engineer - Switzerland
jobs.description:
Meet the team
  
  

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a resilient digital world with an end\-to\-end platform designed for hybrid, multi\-cloud environments. We approach our work with kindness, valuing the unique talents, passion, and joy that each team member brings to our collaborative culture. Our team is dedicated to helping organizations reach their best by solving complex business challenges at scale. We foster an environment of inclusiveness, disruption, and fun, ensuring that every member feels supported as they reach new heights.
  
  

Your impact
  
  

As a Splunk Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our enterprise customers and partners. You will design and deliver innovative technical solutions that directly address business needs, ensuring long\-term customer success in the region.
  
  

What you will do
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical sales engineer and trusted advisor for customers and partners in Switzerland to drive technology adoption. The focus is on global accounts in the financial services and insurance sectors.
* Design and present relevant Splunk and Cisco technical solutions based on identified business requirements to solve enterprise challenges.
* Lead engagements with IT professionals and business decision\-makers to translate strategic business needs into actionable technical requirements.
* Guide a virtual support team of sales resources to efficiently move deals through the technical sales process.
* Collaborate with account and connected sales teams on comprehensive customer plans to ensure joint customer success and satisfaction.
* Working with Global Splunk and CIsco diverse teams.
* Maintain knowledge of the Splunk and Cisco portfolio to drive cross\-selling and up\-selling opportunities to create use\-cases, and its alignment to customer challenges and objectives
* Develop and maintain deep expertise of Splunk’s portfolio, use\-cases, and its alignment to customer challenges and objectives
* Provide active feedback to Sales teams regarding strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive tactics to inform product strategy.
* Dedicate the majority of your selling time to landing new opportunities and growing our footprint within existing accounts.
* Lead the technical relationship with customers and partners, maintaining deep knowledge of their environments and competitor plays to position our solutions effectively.
* Leverage relevant tools and resources to support deals and achieve key success metrics, including increased revenue and net new customer acquisition. and developing and executing Technical Account Plans, acting as the Splunk CTO for your customers
* Working with Global Splunk and CIsco diverse teams.


Minimum qualifications
  
  

* 5\+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, or a related technical sales role within the enterprise software industry.
* 5\+ years relevant experience in cyber security and/or observability is highly desired.
* Demonstrated experience configuring, deploying, or selling Splunk software and platforms in a technical, engineering, or sales capacity.
* Experience leading technical sales cycles, including designing and presenting technical architectures to enterprise customers.
* Experience collaborating with account teams and virtual support teams in a B2B enterprise software environment.


Preferred qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or commensurate experience
* Outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively lead others in a highly\-collaborative team environment
* Relevant industry or vendor certifications, such as Splunk Core Certified Power User, Splunk Enterprise Certified Architect, or Cisco certifications are a plus.
* Practical experience with the Splunk platform or competing solutions is a plus.
* Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers and partners within the Swiss market.
* Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong problem\-solving abilities and a strategic mindset to navigate competitive sales environments.
* Available to travel up to 50% to visit prospects and customers across Switzerland and internationally if needed.
* Fluent German (both written\& spoken)


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
