jobs.description:
Youtube Video

 **Together with our customers, we combine the real and digital worlds**


With technology, software and services for smart buildings, we transform the everyday for everyone. By combining the real and digital worlds, we empower our customers to reach their decarbonization goals, lower their operating costs and create world\-class occupant experiences for their people. It’s not just about improving buildings – it’s about creating efficient, safe, adaptable and sustainable environments, which improve the way the world lives and works.



The digital transformation of buildings is a fast\-changing, dynamic sector, and it needs more than just great technology \- it needs great people, too. We know a business only thrives if its people are thriving, so at Siemens we put our people first.



Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways, as we transform the world’s infrastructure.



Our shared journey could take you anywhere…where would you like to go?


As a student trainee, intern or trainee, you are an important part of \#TeamSiemens. Would you also like to play an active role in influencing current trends and developments and make a positive impact on the lives of millions of people in Switzerland? Then you’ve come to the right place! Apply today for the position of **Working Student** **Software Development** **40\-60%** – your team is looking forward to meeting you!

  

**About the team**


Tools, Services and Infrastructure (TSI) develops and supports the tools, applications and infrastructure for the global SI B PRO R\&D organization, owning the full lifecycle of the PLM/ALM toolchain used by 5,000\+ end users, with 3,000\+ tickets resolved per year and 100\+ tools managed. Within TSI, Applications \& Data Insights develops applications, integrations and data products, extending the ALM ecosystem with automation and AI. Our landscape includes:


* IBM Jazz ALM for agile project management, requirements, test and system design — plus Report Builder and a large in\-house extension portfolio (50\+ Jazz plugins and custom tools)
* Source code, build and quality tooling: Git, Artifactory, SonarQube, UrbanCode Deploy, build and test environments
* R\&D financial and business processes (Jedox\-based budgeting and cost tracking)
* Reporting and analytics: IBM Report Builder today, moving progressively to Power BI and Snowflake for Management Events , alongside KPI dashboards and data products


We use SAFe agile approach with local developers, remote team members and external suppliers in close cooperation. Beyond support, maintenance and continuous delivery, we train our users and maintain the documentation and knowledge base that keeps our services self\-serviceable.

  

**Your role**


You will join our development team to further develop the tools above into user\-centric, future\-proof solutions, and you will contribute directly to extend and create plugins and tools, and infusing AI capabilities into the tool landscape (Jazz / WISPR / MCP integrations, Jazz Copilot).

  

  

**Your new responsibilities**

* You support the development of new features across the TI tool landscape, collaborating closely with experienced software engineers and participating in projects, change management and training for new technology implementations
* Building on this, you contribute to the entire engineering cycle by assisting in requirements analysis, architecture and design, coding, deployment and ongoing support
* In this context, you produce clean, efficient code to specification, integrate software components and REST\-based interfaces, and help verify and deploy programs and systems
* Additionally, you maintain and upgrade existing software, troubleshoot coding issues efficiently, and help fix defects to ensure application and plugin reliability
* Complementing these tasks, you help create technical documentation for various audiences and contribute to the team wiki and knowledge base
 **Your talents and experience**

* You are currently enrolled in a Swiss university degree program in computer science, software engineering or a related field and have initial practical experience in software development
* You have hands\-on experience with object\-oriented programming languages such as Java, C\# or .NET Core
* You are familiar with web technologies and frameworks, including basic frontend development with JavaScript, HTML and CSS
* You have knowledge of REST APIs and integration patterns, and are confident in using version control systems such as Git
* You demonstrate a high level of analytical ability, learn new technologies quickly and work in a structured, thorough and independent manner
* You have very good English and or German skills
 **Employee benefits**


* Mobile working from anywhere within Switzerland
* Opportunity to develop an international professional network
* Gain experience at one of the largest tech employers in Switzerland
* Membership in the Siemens Students Association comprising 200 members
 **Our corporate culture – your new working environment**



The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our day\-to\-day interactions and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future\-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, to which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and remote working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a good work\-life balance. Learn more and find out if you are a good match with Siemens by taking our culture quiz!

**Frequently asked questions and contact information**


Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions and a way to contact us directly.

  

I look forward to receiving your application.


Nathalie  

Talent Acquisition Partner


Your way to Siemens \- How we hire

  


Information for recruitment agencies: Siemens is not accepting applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Thank you for your understanding.

jobs.description:
Innovative solutions on the pulse of time, a dynamic and progressive working environment, versatile opportunities \- this is the world of SKIDATA. Become part of our strong, international team now and shape the future of modern access systems with your ideas and know\-how.
  
Worldwide careers
  
Flexible working hours
  
Training and development
  
Backend Developer (C\# / .NET)
  
  

Backend Developer – Global Customized Solutions
  
  

Build the integrations that make complex access solutions work.
  
  

What happens when a customer needs SKIDATA products to work with a system they already rely on? That’s where you come in.
  
  

As a Backend Developer, you’ll design and build tailored software integrations that connect third\-party systems with SKIDATA products. You’ll solve varied technical challenges, work with integration partners and turn specific customer requirements into working solutions.
  
  

Why this role matters
  
  

Access solutions need to work seamlessly with the wider systems customers depend on. Your work will help turn specific customer requirements into reliable solutions, extending the flexibility and reach of SKIDATA products across different markets and real\-world environments.
  
  

The role
  
  

You’ll independently own integration projects, from technical design through implementation, testing and documentation, while working as part of the global GCS team. Alongside your development work, you’ll support colleagues across regions and contribute to shared coding, architecture and engineering practices.
  
  

What you’ll work on
  
  

Build custom integrations — design, develop, test and document backend solutions connecting third\-party systems with SKIDATA products.
  
Develop in C\#/.NET — build reliable solutions primarily using .NET.
  
Work with APIs and interfaces — develop and integrate solutions using technologies such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ and sockets.
  
Support integration partners — provide integration support for public interfaces and help third\-party companies connect with SKIDATA systems.
  
Contribute to engineering practices — support the implementation of coding standards, architecture guidelines and reusable frameworks, and contribute to practices such as CI/CD and AI\-assisted development.
  
Support colleagues across regions — assist regional developers and contribute to code reviews, technical mentoring and consistent quality.
  
  

What will help you succeed
  
  

Professional backend experience — at least 3\-5 years of professional experience developing and maintaining backend applications in C\# / .NET, with the ability to work independently after onboarding.
  
Integration delivery experience — hand\-on experience building, deploying and supporting production integrations between multiple systems using technologies such as REST, SOAP, gRPC, RMQ or sockets.
  
Software development experience — with databases and software design, with exposure to Java or web technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript being a plus.
  
Modern development practices — familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps, an understanding of secure coding, and familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools.
  
Collaborative approach — self\-organised, analytical and comfortable working with colleagues across different regions and cultures.
  
Business\-fluent English and Spanish are required, as both languages are used regularly in day\-to\-day collaboration.
  
  

Why SKIDATA
  
  

At SKIDATA, you’ll work on technology that connects access solutions with the wider systems customers rely on, while having the autonomy to own your work and collaborate with colleagues across borders.
  
  

Meaningful impact — Build integrations that help SKIDATA access solutions work seamlessly with the systems customers and partners depend on.
  
Innovation \& scale — Work with modern backend technologies, APIs and integration solutions as part of a global organisation.
  
Autonomy \& trust — Take ownership of your projects from design through delivery, with the freedom to shape solutions and solve problems in your own way.
  
Growth \& development — Broaden your technical experience through varied projects, different technologies and collaboration with colleagues across regions.
  
Work–life balance — Benefit from a flexible hybrid working model in Madrid that supports a sustainable way of working.
  
  

Ready to build what connects it all?
  
  

If you’re a backend developer who enjoys solving integration challenges and turning customer requirements into working solutions, we’d like to hear from you.
  
  

Apply today (with a CV in english) and help build the connections that make SKIDATA’s access solutions work in the real world.
  
  

We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner.
  
  

Innovative solutions at the cutting edge, a dynamic and forward\-thinking work environment, and diverse opportunities – welcome to the world of SKIDATA. Join our strong, international team now and help shape the future of modern access solutions with your creativity and expertise. When you join our SKIDATA team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 62,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect, Scientific Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Agilent instruments produce the measurements behind pharmaceutical quality control, food and environmental testing, and research labs worldwide. That data sits in dozens of software products, and we are building a platform that lets our products, our customers' workflows, and AI agents find and use it wherever it lives.

  

We are hiring a data architect to own the discovery and access side of that platform: how scientific data is registered and found, and how it is composed and served. The platform architecture is established; the target state for discovery and access, and the path to it, are yours to define.

  

You work under the Lead Data Architect, who owns cross\-service standards and governance. Within your areas, the architecture decisions are yours; cross\-service decisions go to the Lead with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

  

This is an architecture role with hands\-on evidence: you decide the architecture for your areas, stay with engineering through implementation, and read the code, run the queries, and build the proof of concept when an argument needs one.

 **Your areas:**

* Data access. Your part of the federated GraphQL gateway, which the platform team owns how connected systems are represented on it, directly or through data services; the read layer that composes results across systems; and the application data services that expose access\-controlled views of scientific data to products, workflows, and AI consumers.
* Catalog and search. The catalog record model, how connected systems register their data and how that metadata is represented, search over it, and the path to richer indexes like vector and graph.

  

Access is the first\-year priority; catalog work runs alongside as the first connectors land. File management, metadata extraction, and semantic standards are owned by other architects on the team. The data is scientific data created by software products: results, methods, samples, files. ERP, CRM, and other enterprise business systems are out of scope.

 **What you will do:**

* Establish how the catalog and access paths behave today and define the target state: service boundaries, contracts, integration patterns, and the path between the two.
* Own the schemas and contracts your areas depend on: catalog records, subgraph boundaries, data service views, and versioned event schemas. Design them and make explicit which system is authoritative for each piece of information under the program's data governance rules, and version them so existing consumers keep working.
* Design the access paths AI agents use to read what they can, under what controls, and with what provenance.
* Review proposed integrations against your contracts and the program's participation requirements. Change your contracts when the evidence warrants and propose changes to the requirements.
* Design modernization paths for legacy sources that keep customers running through the transition, including moves from on\-premises to hybrid or cloud.
* Set query and index performance targets for catalog and access paths.
* Design the pipelines that keep the catalog, the search index, and the access views current as data arrives, from extractor output through backfill and recovery.
* Work directly with engineering: clarify designs, evaluate implementation plans, review delivered work against the decisions.
* Write the decision records and diagrams for your areas, and explain the tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

 **What we work with:**

* .NET (C\#) services, Angular front ends, and a federated GraphQL gateway
* PostgreSQL by default, with Oracle and SQL Server across the installed base
* RabbitMQ for messaging and event\-driven change discovery
* Kubernetes and Helm alongside Windows installers for on\-premises and hybrid customers, with S3\-compatible object storage
* Scientific data in proprietary instrument formats as well as vendor\-neutral formats like Allotrope
* AI assistants in daily use

**Qualifications**
------------------

 **Required qualifications:**

* Has 8\+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture with distributed systems: service boundaries, APIs, and event\-driven integration.
* Has defined architecture ahead of finalized standards and governance and can show which decisions held up and which had to change.
* Has owned the architecture of a production system in at least one of these areas: data catalogs and metadata management (DataHub, OpenMetadata, or similar); search and indexing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar); API or federated\-query data access layers (Apollo Federation, or similar); or the data layer of a scientific, laboratory, or regulated application.
* Writes SQL and reads execution plans in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Has built and run data pipelines, including recovery and backfill.
* Reads production code in a typed language (C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar) and can build a proof of concept.
* Uses AI tools in daily architecture and data work (profiling and cleaning data, reading and generating code, drafting decision records) and can show the process: what you delegate, what you verify, and how.
* Works across product, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.

 **Preferred qualifications:**

* Has delivered data products consumed by applications: APIs, views, or datasets that other software depends on.
* Working knowledge of catalog, search, and data access beyond the area you have owned.
* Laboratory informatics or regulated life sciences, including data integrity and audit trail expectations.
* Architecture decision records, C4 or similar diagrams, and interface contracts.
* Cloud integration patterns (identity, storage, messaging, managed data services) alongside on\-premises deployment.

 **Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.

Na LUZA Group, a paixão, a perseverança e a vontade de superar limites definem o nosso caminho para o sucesso.



Fundada em 2006, somos uma multinacional portuguesa com mais de 1\.200 profissionais talentosos e um volume de negócios. Com presença em mercados estratégicos como Portugal, Espanha, Marrocos, Brasil, México, Estados Unidos e China, oferecemos soluções inovadoras em engenharia, TI, design, consultoria, Indústria 4\.0, treinamento e recrutamento. Tudo o que fazemos é movido pelo talento de nosso povo.


**Este é um momento de crescimento e oportunidade. O futuro pertence a mentes visionárias. Junte\-se a nós!**


**Requisitos:**  

**Atuar como referência técnica na definição da arquitetura corporativa de identidade digital, suportando decisões de autenticação, autorização, governança de identidades e integração entre plataformas.**  

**Analisar, desenhar e implementar soluções de IAM e CIAM.**  

**Desenhar fluxos de autenticação, autorização e gestão do ciclo de vida de identidades.**  

**Desenvolver e evoluir APIs, microserviços e componentes de segurança.**  

**Definir padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (SSDLC).**  

**Realizar integrações síncronas e assíncronas com plataformas internas e externas via APIs, eventos e mensageria.**  

**Participar de refinamentos técnicos, requisitos não funcionais e revisões de arquitetura.**  

**Contribuir para a esteira DevSecOps e para a qualidade de software.**  

**Apoiar a resolução de incidentes complexos e análises de causa raiz.**  

**Atuar como referência em identidade digital, autenticação e segurança de aplicações.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura**  

**Experiência como Analista de Sistemas, Desenvolvedor Sênior ou funções correlatas.**  

**Domínio de C\# e ecossistema .NET.**  

**Desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microserviços.**  

**Padrões de integração corporativa (Enterprise Integration Patterns).**  

**Integrações síncronas e assíncronas; gRPC e Message Brokers.**  

**Arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event\-Driven) e Kafka (produção e consumo).**  

**Ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (SDLC).**  

**Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, CQRS, Mediator Pattern, Event Sourcing (desejável) e arquiteturas distribuídas.**  

**Modelagem de dados / Entidade\-Relacionamento; bancos Oracle e Redis.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Identidade Digital (núcleo da vaga)**  

**Experiência comprovada em implementação, customização ou sustentação de ao menos uma plataforma IAM/CIAM corporativa (ex.: ForgeRock, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0 ou Okta).**  

**Domínio avançado de protocolos e padrões: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2\.0, JWT, SCIM, Federation e Single Sign\-On (SSO).**  

**Gestão de ciclo de vida de identidades; provisionamento e desprovisionamento; RBAC; ABAC; gestão de privilégios; Segregação de Funções (SoD); governança de acessos; MFA.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Segurança da Informação**  

**Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) e OWASP Top 10\.**  

**Criptografia simétrica e assimétrica, hash, password hash, assinatura digital e certificados digitais.**  

**Conceitos de autenticação multifator (MFA).**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Identidade Moderna**  

**FIDO2, Passkeys, WebAuthn, Device Binding.**  

**Adaptive Authentication e Risk\-Based Authentication.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Governança (IGA)**  

**Access Review e recertificação de acessos.**  

**Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver, Birthright Access, Role Mining e Entitlement Management.**  

**Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — PAM**  

**Privileged Access Management, gestão de contas privilegiadas e segregação de acessos administrativos.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Nuvem**  

**IAM cloud\-native em Azure, AWS ou GCP; Secrets Management, Managed Identities e federação entre ambientes.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Observabilidade**  

**OpenTelemetry, Distributed Tracing, observabilidade aplicada a autenticação, SIEM e monitoramento de fraudes de autenticação.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Contexto regulatório**  

**Experiência em ambientes regulados: instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito, seguradoras, fintechs ou meios de pagamento.**

  


Soft Skills \- Descreva detalhadamente as habilidades interpessoais necessárias:Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos: aptidão para compreender cenários de integração complexos, identificar causas raiz e propor soluções escaláveis e seguras.



Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural: capacidade de entender impactos entre múltiplos sistemas, aplicações, processos de negócio e requisitos de segurança.



Comunicação eficaz: habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos para públicos não técnicos e atuar como ponte entre equipes de tecnologia, segurança, arquitetura, fornecedores e áreas de negócio.



Autonomia e senso de propriedade (ownership): capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta, assumindo responsabilidade pelos resultados e atuando com baixa necessidade de supervisão.



Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: facilidade para atuar em ambientes multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança e produtos digitais.



Orientação a resultados: foco na entrega de valor para o negócio, priorizando atividades críticas e mantendo o equilíbrio entre agilidade, qualidade e segurança.



Adaptabilidade e aprendizado contínuo: disposição para acompanhar a rápida evolução das tecnologias de identidade, autenticação, APIs, nuvem e segurança.



Capacidade de influência e negociação: habilidade para conduzir discussões técnicas, alinhar interesses entre diferentes áreas e promover a adoção de boas práticas de identidade e acesso.



Mentalidade de segurança (Security by Design): preocupação constante em incorporar requisitos de segurança desde a concepção das integrações e soluções.

jobs.description:
#### **Sobre o trabalho Desenvolvedor de Sistemas – Full Stack \- SR \- 1**


**Venha fazer parte de um ecossistema vivo onde o futuro dos negócios é criado e vivido todos os dias. Faça parte desta transformação!**



Na LUZA Group, a paixão, a perseverança e a vontade de superar limites definem o nosso caminho para o sucesso.



Fundada em 2006, somos uma multinacional portuguesa com mais de 1\.200 profissionais talentosos e um volume de negócios. Com presença em mercados estratégicos como Portugal, Espanha, Marrocos, Brasil, México, Estados Unidos e China, oferecemos soluções inovadoras em engenharia, TI, design, consultoria, Indústria 4\.0, treinamento e recrutamento. Tudo o que fazemos é movido pelo talento de nosso povo.


**Este é um momento de crescimento e oportunidade. O futuro pertence a mentes visionárias. Junte\-se a nós!**


**Requisitos:**  

**Atuar como referência técnica na definição da arquitetura corporativa de identidade digital, suportando decisões de autenticação, autorização, governança de identidades e integração entre plataformas.**  

**Analisar, desenhar e implementar soluções de IAM e CIAM.**  

**Desenhar fluxos de autenticação, autorização e gestão do ciclo de vida de identidades.**  

**Desenvolver e evoluir APIs, microserviços e componentes de segurança.**  

**Definir padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (SSDLC).**  

**Realizar integrações síncronas e assíncronas com plataformas internas e externas via APIs, eventos e mensageria.**  

**Participar de refinamentos técnicos, requisitos não funcionais e revisões de arquitetura.**  

**Contribuir para a esteira DevSecOps e para a qualidade de software.**  

**Apoiar a resolução de incidentes complexos e análises de causa raiz.**  

**Atuar como referência em identidade digital, autenticação e segurança de aplicações.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura**  

**Experiência como Analista de Sistemas, Desenvolvedor Sênior ou funções correlatas.**  

**Domínio de C\# e ecossistema .NET.**  

**Desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microserviços.**  

**Padrões de integração corporativa (Enterprise Integration Patterns).**  

**Integrações síncronas e assíncronas; gRPC e Message Brokers.**  

**Arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event\-Driven) e Kafka (produção e consumo).**  

**Ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (SDLC).**  

**Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, DDD, CQRS, Mediator Pattern, Event Sourcing (desejável) e arquiteturas distribuídas.**  

**Modelagem de dados / Entidade\-Relacionamento; bancos Oracle e Redis.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Identidade Digital (núcleo da vaga)**  

**Experiência comprovada em implementação, customização ou sustentação de ao menos uma plataforma IAM/CIAM corporativa (ex.: ForgeRock, Ping Identity, SailPoint, Saviynt, Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, Auth0 ou Okta).**  

**Domínio avançado de protocolos e padrões: OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2\.0, JWT, SCIM, Federation e Single Sign\-On (SSO).**  

**Gestão de ciclo de vida de identidades; provisionamento e desprovisionamento; RBAC; ABAC; gestão de privilégios; Segregação de Funções (SoD); governança de acessos; MFA.**  

  

**Requisitos obrigatórios — Segurança da Informação**  

**Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) e OWASP Top 10\.**  

**Criptografia simétrica e assimétrica, hash, password hash, assinatura digital e certificados digitais.**  

**Conceitos de autenticação multifator (MFA).**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Identidade Moderna**  

**FIDO2, Passkeys, WebAuthn, Device Binding.**  

**Adaptive Authentication e Risk\-Based Authentication.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Governança (IGA)**  

**Access Review e recertificação de acessos.**  

**Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver, Birthright Access, Role Mining e Entitlement Management.**  

**Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — PAM**  

**Privileged Access Management, gestão de contas privilegiadas e segregação de acessos administrativos.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Nuvem**  

**IAM cloud\-native em Azure, AWS ou GCP; Secrets Management, Managed Identities e federação entre ambientes.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Observabilidade**  

**OpenTelemetry, Distributed Tracing, observabilidade aplicada a autenticação, SIEM e monitoramento de fraudes de autenticação.**  

  

**Diferenciais desejáveis — Contexto regulatório**  

**Experiência em ambientes regulados: instituições financeiras, cooperativas de crédito, seguradoras, fintechs ou meios de pagamento.**

  


Soft Skills \- Descreva detalhadamente as habilidades interpessoais necessárias:Capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas complexos: aptidão para compreender cenários de integração complexos, identificar causas raiz e propor soluções escaláveis e seguras.



Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural: capacidade de entender impactos entre múltiplos sistemas, aplicações, processos de negócio e requisitos de segurança.



Comunicação eficaz: habilidade para traduzir conceitos técnicos para públicos não técnicos e atuar como ponte entre equipes de tecnologia, segurança, arquitetura, fornecedores e áreas de negócio.



Autonomia e senso de propriedade (ownership): capacidade de conduzir iniciativas de ponta a ponta, assumindo responsabilidade pelos resultados e atuando com baixa necessidade de supervisão.



Colaboração e trabalho em equipe: facilidade para atuar em ambientes multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento, arquitetura, infraestrutura, segurança e produtos digitais.



Orientação a resultados: foco na entrega de valor para o negócio, priorizando atividades críticas e mantendo o equilíbrio entre agilidade, qualidade e segurança.



Adaptabilidade e aprendizado contínuo: disposição para acompanhar a rápida evolução das tecnologias de identidade, autenticação, APIs, nuvem e segurança.



Capacidade de influência e negociação: habilidade para conduzir discussões técnicas, alinhar interesses entre diferentes áreas e promover a adoção de boas práticas de identidade e acesso.



Mentalidade de segurança (Security by Design): preocupação constante em incorporar requisitos de segurança desde a concepção das integrações e soluções.

**Description:**
----------------


**Hey, we’re BRAINR.**


Our mission is to build the intelligent brain for every food factory, with the only AI\-powered factory management software for the food industry, bringing together machines, sensors, software, and people.


We’ve recently secured a record\-breaking €11M Seed Round, the largest in Portugal’s history, to take our mission global. And we’re getting there, because today over 25% of all meat production in Portugal is already managed by BRAINR.


Along the way, we’ve been recognized as the Best Factory Digitization Solution at Food 4 Future in Spain, selected for EUROPA’s 100 most promising startups, and named a Top Cloud\-Based MES Solution by Manufacturing Tech Insights.


What sets us apart isn’t just the tech. It’s the people. Our leadership team combines deep industry know\-how with world\-class tech expertise, giving you the chance to learn and grow faster than anywhere else.


The mission is massive. The ambition is real. And we need talent like you to bring our vision to every food factory on earth.

 **The challenge**


We’re looking for a **Senior Backend Developer** to join our team. You’ll work on features that directly impact our customers, designing and evolving backend services that ensure reliability, performance, and scalability.


In this role, you won’t just be building APIs or optimizing systems, you’ll be collaborating closely with product managers, frontend developers, and designers to deliver end\-to\-end solutions that bring measurable value to food manufacturers using our platform. This is a chance to have real ownership, influence technical decisions, and shape how our MES product grows at scale.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services in **C\# (.NET Core)**.
* Implement and consume **REST APIs** to ensure seamless integration across systems.
* Optimize performance, scalability, and security of cloud\-based solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (product, frontend, design, QA) to deliver features end\-to\-end.
* Apply software design principles (**SOLID, DRY**) and modern architectures (Domain\-Driven, Event\-Driven).
* Contribute to improving our engineering practices, code quality, and technical documentation.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and bring innovative ideas to the team.

  






**Requirements:**
-----------------

  

  

**What we’re looking for**

* 5\+ years of professional experience as a Backend Developer.
* Strong expertise in **C\# (10 or higher)** and **.NET Core (8 or higher)**.
* Experience building and maintaining **RESTful APIs** with **ASP.NET Core**.
* Knowledge of cloud environments (Azure or AWS) and monitoring tools.
* Solid understanding of **OOP, software design principles**, and distributed systems.
* Familiarity with **event\-driven architectures** and messaging systems is a plus.

The Programmer/Analyst reports to the Operations Manager but takes direction from the Programmer Analyst III. * Work with Technical Leads to gather user requirements and interpret into design specifications.

Qualifications:
* **Qualifications**

	+ Requires an active Secret Clearance.
* E**ducation/Certifications:** One\-year related experience may be substituted for one year of education if a degree is required.
	+ Bachelor’s degree preferred, Master’s degree a plus.
	+ This position requires candidates to adhere to DoD 8570\.01M. All candidates are required to maintain at least one (1\) baseline certification and one (1\) computing environment (CE) certification. Baseline Environment (BE) certifications cannot also be used as a Computing Environment (CE).
	+ The authorized certifications for this job title are listed as follows:
* **BASELINE:**
	+ Cisco: CCNP: Certified Network Professional \- Security
	+ CompTIA: CASP\+ ce: Advanced Security Practitioner
	+ CompTIA: Security\+ ce
	+ GIAC: GCIH: Certified Incident Handler
	+ GIAC: GSEC: Security Essentials
	+ ISACA: CISA: Certified Information Systems Auditor
	+ ISC2: CISSP (**or Associate**): Certified Information Systems Security Professional
	+ ISC2: SSCP: Systems Security Certified Practitioner

	+ Strong troubleshooting skills.
	+ Experience with a customer service\-oriented company.

 **Working Environment*** The work environment will be 95% indoors and 5% outdoors.
* The outdoor work environment may exceed temperatures 100 degrees F. Candidate must be able to physically withstand extreme heat.

**Physical Requirements*** Must be capable of lifting, pushing, and pulling items weighing up to 50 lbs.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack, AI-Native), Senior-Level
jobs.description:
At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 30 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation.  

  

  



We are seeking a **Forward Deployed Engineer (Full\-Stack, AI\-Native)** who shares our passion for innovation and high\-velocity engineering . Operating embedded alongside product teams in an AI\-agentic delivery workflow, you will bridge technical decision\-making with hands\-on full\-stack development making key architectural choices, validating AI\-generated code, and shipping resilient .NET, React, and integrated solutions directly to production .


**1\. Role Summary**

This role owns end\-to\-end delivery on a highly transactional booking platform serving 8 markets in 2 languages. You take features from technical solutioning to production across the full stack: React/TypeScript frontends, the .NET services and BFF, and the booking, payments and loyalty integrations underneath.


You work embedded with the Product team inside an agentic delivery workflow. By the time a feature reaches you, requirements and designs have already been analysed against the current codebase by AI agents, and you get a mapped impact and a set of implementation options with pros and cons. Your job is to challenge that analysis, make the final technical decision, and implement it across the stack yourself.


The role is hands\-on and autonomous. You're expected to get productive quickly in an existing codebase, decide within your scope without waiting to be unblocked, and escalate only the decisions that really need it. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) are the default way of working. What we value most is judgement about when to trust, verify or rewrite what they produce.


**2\. Core Responsibilities**

*End\-to\-end technical solutioning*

* Review agent\-generated impact analysis and solution options for each feature, validate them against the real codebase, and make the final technical decision with clear reasoning.
* Own the solution design across frontend, BFF, backend services and integrations, including the trade\-offs on performance, risk and delivery time.
* Work directly with Product, Design and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, flag technical constraints early, and shape scope.

*Full\-stack development*

* Build and ship features across React/TypeScript frontends and .NET services and BFF.
* Own integration contracts for booking, payments and loyalty, including failure handling, idempotency and retry behaviour on transactions.
* Work with CMS\-driven content (Strapi) and across web and mobile client surfaces.

*AI\-native delivery*

* Use agentic coding tools as the default mode for implementation, refactoring, test generation and codebase exploration.
* Keep context artifacts current (repo conventions, agent instruction files, prompts and scripts) so the whole team and the agents work from the same foundation.
* Help define the team's rules for AI\-assisted work: what agents do, what they don't, and what must be human\-verified before merge.

*Quality and production ownership*

* Review PRs, human\- and AI\-authored, watching for hallucinated APIs, deprecated calls, hidden complexity on hot paths, and tests that assert nothing.
* Take part in RCA on production failures and turn findings into fixes, logging and guardrails.
* Act as a technical counterpart to the Technical Director, Product and QA, making decisions within your scope rather than escalating by default.

**3\. Tooling \& Stack**

* **Frontend:** React · TypeScript · Flutter (mobile surface)
* **Backend:** C\# / .NET 8\+ · ASP.NET Core · REST APIs / BFF pattern · Redis
* **AI \& agentic workflow:** Claude Code · OpenAI Codex · GitHub Copilot · MCP servers · agent instruction files
* **Platform:** Azure · Docker · GitHub Actions · ArgoCD · New Relic
* **Integrations:** Checkout.com (payments, 3DS) · Strapi CMS

**4\. Experience \& Skills**

*Must have*

* 7\+ years in software engineering, with strong production experience in both C\#/.NET backend and React/TypeScript frontend, and still writing production code daily.
* A track record of taking features end to end, from technical design to production, in an existing codebase.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools on production code, with concrete examples of what changed in your delivery: scope, cycle time, test coverage, or refactors you wouldn't otherwise have attempted.
* The ability to evaluate AI\-proposed solutions critically and make sound technical decisions autonomously, knowing when to decide and when to escalate.
* A strong code review practice, including a clear personal method for catching AI\-generated defects.
* Experience integrating third\-party transactional APIs (payments, PSPs, booking or ticketing engines) where partial failure has commercial consequences.
* Experience in fast\-paced delivery with short cycles, feature flags and frequent releases.
* Comfort working directly with client\-side product and business stakeholders, in English.

*Strongly preferred*

* Set or documented AI\-assisted development standards for a team (review policy, agent instructions, prompt or context libraries).
* High\-volume transactional or booking platforms, and multi\-market or multi\-currency systems.
* Azure, distributed tracing, and production debugging with New Relic or similar.
* Flutter or mobile experience, and CMS\-driven content.

This job can be filled in **Dubai, United Arab Emirates \#LI\- Onsite**

Create with us digital products that people love. We will bring businesses and consumers together through AI technology and creativity, driving digital transformation to impact the world positively.  

  

  

  

We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process. Compensation is determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and location. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package.

Clean\-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net\-zero emissions.

Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy\-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting\-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

The survey/design visit is a key aspect of the customer journey to ensure an installation goes ahead as planned, and as the customer expects. You will find solutions to problems, ensure the project works in the interests of both the customer and Aira, and provide excellent customer service along the way. You will have the technical expertise to offer additional products and services we may offer in the interests of the customer.

##### **What you’ll be doing as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* Have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.

##### **What you'll need to have as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

**Apprentice Technical Support Engineer**

**Location: Truro, with UK\-wide travel and overnight stays during busier seasonal periods**

**Contract: Apprenticeship Contract**

**Salary: £10\.85 per hour**

**Start your engineering career while helping make heating better for everyone**


At Kensa, we’re making heating better \- for people, for the planet and for the future. Since 1999, we’ve been leading the way in ground source heat pump technology, delivering affordable, low\-carbon heating solutions that support the UK’s transition to net zero.


We’re now looking for an Apprentice Technical Support Engineer to join our Technical Support team. This is a practical, varied opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, build valuable engineering skills and begin a career in the growing low\-carbon heating sector.


If you’re curious about how things work, enjoy solving problems and are keen to learn, this could be a great first step. You’ll combine hands\-on experience with a Low Carbon Heating Technician apprenticeship at Cornwall College, attending the Camborne campus one day each week.

**The role**


You’ll join our friendly Technical Support team and learn how to help engineers, installers and customers get the best from ground source heat pump systems. With training and mentoring from experienced colleagues, you’ll build confidence in fault\-finding and diagnostics, provide clear support by phone, and gain practical experience both remotely and on site.


As your skills and experience grow, you’ll have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and explore a future career within Kensa’s technical team.

**What you’ll be doing**

* Support engineers, installers and customers by telephone, listening carefully and communicating clearly and professionally.
* Learn how to diagnose technical faults remotely and help identify practical solutions.
* Assist senior engineers and follow technical guidance, processes and instructions.
* Build knowledge of heat pumps, plumbing, electrical systems and renewable heating technologies.
* Gain experience of zero\-carbon central heating and hot water systems, including installation, commissioning, servicing, maintenance and repair.
* Support site\-based activities when required. The role may involve significant travel during seasonal peaks, potentially across the UK, including overnight stays and time away from home.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues while developing the confidence to complete tasks independently.

**Your apprenticeship**


You’ll complete the Low Carbon Heating Technician apprenticeship with Cornwall College, attending the Camborne campus one day each week. Your off\-the\-job training will take place during your contracted working hours, so you’ll have dedicated time to learn and develop. We’re ideally looking for someone to start the apprenticeship in October.


The programme will help you develop the knowledge and practical skills to work with low\-carbon heating and hot water systems, including ground and air source heat pumps, associated pipework, components, and mechanical and electrical controls.

**What we’re looking for**

* Enthusiasm for engineering, renewable energy or learning how things work.
* A positive attitude and willingness to learn, ask questions and develop new skills.
* Clear communication and the ability to listen carefully and work well with others.
* A thoughtful, customer\-focused approach and an interest in solving problems.
* Reliability, attention to detail and a willingness to take responsibility for your work.
* Willingness and availability to undertake significant travel during seasonal peaks, which may be UK\-wide and involve overnight stays.
* A full UK driving licence would be helpful but is not essential.


You don’t need previous experience with heat pumps or to meet every point above. What matters most is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in building a career in low\-carbon heating. If the role appeals to you, we encourage you to apply.

**What we offer**


At Kensa, we’re committed to creating a supportive, rewarding and purpose\-driven place to work. When you join us, you can expect:

* 25 days’ annual leave, increasing to 30 days after five years, plus bank holidays.
* Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid options where possible.
* Career development support, including training and support for recognised qualifications.
* Free 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme for you and your immediate family.
* Private healthcare after one year of service.
* Paid volunteering days to support community impact.
* Electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme.
* Company pension scheme with employer contributions.
* A collaborative culture where your work directly supports the UK’s transition to greener, more affordable heating.

**Ready to apply?**

new_jobs.title: Heating System Design Engineer (Field)
new_jobs.description:
##### **Upgrade Your Career With Aira**


Clean\-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net\-zero emissions.


Aira's mission is to advance the next generation of home energy solutions, creating intelligent, sustainable homes for a meaningful impact. Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy\-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting\-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

##### **About the role as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**


The survey/design visit is a key aspect of the customer journey to ensure an installation goes ahead as planned, and as the customer expects. You will find solutions to problems, ensure the project works in the interests of both the customer and Aira, and provide excellent customer service along the way. You will have the technical expertise to offer additional products and services we may offer in the interests of the customer.

##### **What you’ll be doing as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* Have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.
* Gather information from the quote, property and your survey data to generate an accurate heat loss calculation and emitter output requirements
* Find solutions to any technical issues where possible to ensure an installation can still go ahead
* Report any issues which may affect installation to your line manager from the customers property.
* Keep up to date with all manufacturer's guidance, and any legislative changes including but not limited to heat pumps, low carbon heating, clean energy, and building regulations.
* Operate within required Aira’s efficiency guidelines as well as MCS etc.

##### **What might a day look like?**

* Attend customer properties in your designated area
* Conduct a site survey and collect data relevant to the installation requirements
* Carry out a room by room heat loss assessment
* Determine which radiators need to be replaced, and communicate this with your customer
* Answer any technical queries the customer may have
* Communicate any price changes with the customer and explain the reason for these
* Obtain approval from the customer for your proposal to go ahead
* Create a list of materials required for the installation to be carried out

##### **What you'll need to have as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* You'll need to have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.


The following would be useful to have;

* Qualifications in System design such as Heat Geek Heating Mastery
* Level 3 Award in installation and maintenance of air source heat pump systems
* Water regulations certificate (WRAS) course
* Level 2 / 3 Award in plumbing
* Level 3 Award Low temperature heating and hot water systems in dwellings

**What is in it for you?**

* **Salary of £42,000**
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays
* Health Cash Plan
* Reward Gateway (shopping discount)
* Life insurance
* 25 days Annual Leave plus Bank Holidays
* iPad, Phone and all equipment provided

*(We encourage early applications as we may close the role once we find the right candidate.)*


At Aira, We’re not just champions of next\-generation energy, we’re champions in Diversity and Inclusion too. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks innovation and creativity and enables us to better serve our customers and communities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. We will never accept any form of discrimination and believe that together, we can drive a new era for our people and planet.

new_jobs.title: Senior Python Developer
new_jobs.description:
**Senior Python Developer**

**Salary:** From £50,000 per annum, depending on experience

**Location:** Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the UK. If you like to work alongside colleagues in person, our offices are in Birmingham, Bristol, Exeter and London.

**Term/Hours:** Permanent, 32–40 hours per week. We are flexible on working pattern, so please tell us what suits you in your application.

**Closing date for applications:** Monday 12th October 2026

**We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.**

**We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).**

**Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.**

**About the Role**


We are looking for a **Senior Python Developer** (or someone operating close to senior level) to join our five\-person energy development team. You will help lead the design and implementation of Python packages building on the Home Energy Model that will enable the next generation of energy performance assessment.


You will work closely with DESNZ, external collaborators, our internal domain experts and your dev team, turning tangible and pressing user needs into reliable, maintainable Python software. The team is supportive and high\-performing, and the work has a direct impact on carbon reduction.


This role includes **line management**. You may already manage one or more developers, or you may be ready to take that step, supported by our programme of leadership and management training. Either way, you will help the people you manage to do their best work and develop their careers.

**What you will do**

* Design, build and improve Python packages for modelling, simulation and data processing.
* Lead engineering decisions, architecture discussions and technical problem solving.
* Turn analytical and modelling needs into shippable software.
* Line manage one or more developers: regular one\-to\-ones, objective setting, performance reviews and support for their development.
* Mentor colleagues across the team and set a strong example through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing.
* Maintain high code quality through testing, documentation and thorough code reviews.
* Work across disciplines to integrate tools and deliver results for our customers.
* Drive continuous improvement in our tools, processes and engineering standards.
* Own your deliverables and keep projects moving with urgency and accountability.

 **About Us**


City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with one core mission: delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations that are serious about net zero achieve meaningful, quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.


We work collaboratively across the business to provide integrated solutions for a wide range of clients, from national bodies such as DESNZ and the Climate Change Committee (CCC) to forward\-thinking local authorities such as Oxfordshire County Council. Our award\-winning research, software and product development team builds innovative digital tools, such as our GIS software, Cadence, that sit at the heart of how we deliver our projects.

 **Essential**

* Strong professional experience as a Python developer, at or near senior level.
* Excellent command of Python and its ecosystem, including libraries, tooling and best practice.
* A track record of building production\-grade applications, ideally in data\-rich or scientific domains.
* The ability to write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code.
* Experience line managing or formally mentoring developers, **or** a clear willingness and motivation to take on line management responsibilities.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to explain technical ideas clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience working in multidisciplinary teams.

**Desirable**

* Experience with Pydantic and/or JSON Schema.
* Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD.
* A strong grasp of geometry and physics, ideally including building physics.
* Understanding of decarbonisation and energy systems.
* Experience supporting the growth of more junior engineers, such as onboarding or coaching.

**Aligned to Our Values**

* **Excellence:** You hold high standards in your code, your solutions and your engineering decisions.
* **Ownership \& Accountability:** You take responsibility for outcomes and proactively drive progress.
* **Data Driven:** You use evidence, analytical thinking and testing to guide your choices.
* **Results Orientated:** You focus on delivering outputs that create real\-world impact.
* **Adaptability \& Learning:** You embrace change, seek out new knowledge and learn quickly.
* **Passion \& Urgency:** You care about what you build and work with purpose.
* **Meritocracy:** You value competence and fairness, and you help raise the bar for everyone around you.
* **Entrepreneurial:** You are resourceful and creative, and you bring ideas that move the business forward.

 **What We Offer**

* **Fully remote working**, with optional access to **our offices in Birmingham, Bristol, Exeter and London** whenever you want them.
* **Flexible working hours** to support a healthy work–life balance.
* A **talented, friendly and supportive team** of engineers, data scientists and domain experts.
* **Impactful projects in decarbonisation and sustainability.**
* Real opportunities to grow, including as a people leader, and to shape exciting new products and capabilities.
* 25 days’ annual leave, plus bank holidays.
* Buy/sell annual leave policy.
* Membership of our group pension scheme.
* Enhanced maternity and paternity policy.
* Eye care policy.
* Cycle to work scheme.
* Employee assistance programme.

 **How to Apply**


Please include:

* Your CV, highlighting relevant experience.
* Examples of projects that show your technical skills.
* Links to relevant code repositories or portfolio work.
* A short note on any line management or mentoring experience, or what draws you to taking on line management.
* Your preferred working hours and pattern.


We look forward to hearing from you.

new_jobs.title: Senior Power Platform Consultant
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join our growing Data Analytics team within the Applied Technology Practice and play a key role in helping clients design, deliver and adopt high\-quality Power Platform solutions that improve how they manage information, automate processes and make decisions.


As a Senior Power Platform Consultant, you will combine deep technical expertise across Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and the wider Microsoft ecosystem with a practical consulting mindset. You will work with clients and internal stakeholders to understand business challenges, shape solution options, challenge assumptions constructively and translate requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable low\-code solutions.


This is a client\-facing consulting role suited to someone who can operate as a senior technical specialist while also contributing to wider delivery leadership, capability development and business growth. You will act as a trusted advisor to project teams and clients, provide technical direction to colleagues, support bids and proposals where appropriate, and help strengthen the Power Platform capability through reusable patterns, assurance, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead the design, development and ongoing improvement of Power Platform solutions using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, model\-driven apps and wider Microsoft Power Platform capabilities.
* Work with clients, project teams and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, facilitate requirements discussions and translate complex or ambiguous challenges into practical digital solutions.
* Provide advisory input on Power Platform solution options, helping stakeholders understand technical trade\-offs, delivery risks, licensing implications, governance considerations and opportunities for value.
* Configure and extend Dataverse data models, relationships, business rules, forms, views, security roles, environment settings, APIs and appropriate integration patterns.
* Develop canvas apps, model\-driven apps and Power Automate cloud flows using appropriate Power Fx, connectors, reusable components and maintainable design patterns.
* Design and support integrations with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Power BI, Azure services and external systems where appropriate.
* Own or lead Power Platform workstreams through discovery, design, build, test, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement activities.
* Investigate and resolve complex issues across apps, flows, Dataverse, connectors, permissions, integrations and deployments, applying structured problem\-solving and sound technical judgement.
* Ensure solutions align with organisational governance, cyber security, data protection, licensing, regulatory and client assurance requirements.
* Apply good ALM practices, including solution packaging, environment strategy, deployment planning, documentation, release governance and appropriate technical assurance.
* Act as a senior technical specialist within the Data Analytics and Applied Technology community, providing guidance, peer review, coaching and mentoring to junior developers and less experienced Power Platform makers.
* Contribute to the development of reusable delivery patterns, templates, standards, technical guidance and lessons learned that improve consistency, quality and scalability across Power Platform projects.
* Build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders, identifying opportunities where Power Platform, automation, analytics or wider digital capability can deliver additional value.
* Support business development activity where appropriate, including contributing technical content to bids, proposals, demonstrations, case studies, solution shaping and capability development.
* Promote good practice in user\-centred design, accessibility, adoption, supportability and maintainability so that delivered solutions create lasting value beyond initial deployment.

**About you**
-------------

* Experience developing Power Platform solutions, including canvas apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and model\-driven apps.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, relational data modelling, security model, environment administration and ALM.
* Experience delivering enterprise\-grade Power Platform solutions in regulated or governance\-led environments.
* Experience using the wider Dataverse capability set, including custom connectors, APIs and appropriate integration patterns to support secure, scalable enterprise solutions.
* Good knowledge of Power Fx, Power Automate expressions, Dataverse configuration and solution deployment approaches.
* Experience integrating Power Platform with Microsoft 365 services such as SharePoint, Teams, Outlook and Power BI.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, requirements gathering and solution design skills.
* UK SC clearance required, or willingness and eligibility to obtain it where required.

**Desirable skills and experience:**

* Experience using Microsoft Copilot Studio to design, build and integrate copilots or agents with Power Platform solutions and enterprise data sources.
* Experience developing custom code components, including Power Apps Component Framework controls, using appropriate web development technologies and Microsoft development tooling.
* Experience developing and deploying Dataverse plug\-ins using C\# to implement server\-side business logic, validation and integration requirements.
* Experience developing Dataverse workflow extensions or custom workflow activities where standard Power Automate and platform capabilities are not sufficient.
* Microsoft Power Platform certifications desirable, particularly PL\-200, PL\-400, PL\-600, AB\-410, AB\-100\.

**Rewards \& benefits**
-----------------------


Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.


Rewards and benefits – Careers at AtkinsRéalis

**About AtkinsRéalis**
----------------------


We're AtkinsRéalis, a world\-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

**Additional information**
--------------------------

**Security clearance**


This role may require security clearance and offers of employment will be dependent on obtaining the relevant level of clearance. If this is necessary, it will be discussed with you at interview. The vetting process is delivered by United Kingdom Security Vetting (UKSV) and may require candidates to provide proof of residency in the UK of 5 years or longer. If applying to this role please do not make reference to (in conversation) or include in your application or CV, details of any current or previously held security clearance.


We are committed to creating a culture where everyone feels that they belong \- a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop to be the best we can be. So, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements and employee resource groups to support all employees. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures and ability. As a Disability Confident Leader, we are committed to offering an interview to all applicants who have a disability and meet the essential criteria. If you would like to be considered under this commitment, please let us know at the application stage.

**\#LI\-ADST \| \#LI\-UK \| \#SGCampaign**

new_jobs.title: Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer**Locations:** DD, PH, TD, IV, KY and DG


Are you a qualified Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer looking for excellent earning potential, structured work and the security of working directly for an established energy supplier?


At Utilita, we're growing our award\-winning Field Services team. Join one of the UK's fastest\-growing energy suppliers and a business that has been recognised as one of the UK's Top 50 Best Workplaces for four consecutive years.


What is in it for you?


You'll receive a base salary of £38,993, alongside uncapped earning potential and a variety of opportunities to boost your overall earnings, including:


* **On\-call payment:** Receive £330 for each on\-call week, based on an average rota of one week in five. (OTE of £42,293 just with the base salary and conducting mandatory on call requirements)
* **Industry\-leading installation bonus:** Benefit from an uncapped installation bonus of £25 per meter or £50 per dual installation once you have completed a minimum of four installations in a day, with additional work opportunities available to further enhance your earnings.
* **London weighting:** Receive an additional £2,000 annual allowance if you live within the M25\.
* **Enhanced overtime:** Enhanced overtime rates for Sunday working.

Alongside your salary and uncapped earning potential, you will receive 25 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays, a healthcare scheme, mental wellbeing support, access to 24/7 GP and counselling services, and a generous pension scheme. You will also receive one paid volunteering day each year and have opportunities to win tickets to events at Utilita\-sponsored arenas and football matches.


Why work at Utilita?

**A schedule that supports your work\-life balance.**


We understand that a great Smart Meter Engineer role is not just about salary. It is also about having a structured working day and being able to plan your life accordingly.


You will be scheduled an average of 4 jobs per day, with an average travel time to jobs of approximately 35 minutes between appointments.


We aim to schedule your work several weeks in advance, giving you greater visibility of your schedule. This helps you plan life outside work while still giving you the opportunity to take on additional work when it suits you.

**First\-class training and support.**


Your journey will begin at our award\-winning training academy in Warrington, where you will receive a comprehensive induction.


You will then receive ongoing mentoring to help you strengthen your knowledge, understand our processes and confidently adapt to the Utilita way of working.

**A team that keeps you connected.**


We understand that working in the field can sometimes feel isolating, which is why creating a connected and supportive environment is so important to us.


Through regular manager check\-ins, access to technical experts, collaborative colleague networks and ongoing communication, you'll always have the support you need and someone to turn to throughout your working day.


What you will be doing.


As a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer, you will represent Utilita in customers’ homes, installing smart meters safely and professionally across domestic properties.


You will play an important role in delivering our customer\-first approach, providing a positive experience while maintaining high standards of safety, quality and service.

**What we need from you.**


To be considered for this opportunity, you will need:

* Smart Metering qualifications, including CCN1 or CMA1 and MET1, or equivalent.
* At least 12 months experience working as a Dual Fuel Smart Meter Engineer.
* A valid full UK driving licence.


Who are Utilita?


Founded in 2003, Utilita Energy was created to challenge the Big Six energy suppliers by offering a fair and flexible service that is good for both the pocket and the planet.


As the first supplier to install a Smart Meter back in 2005 and kick\-start Britain’s smart meter revolution, we continue to invest in smart technology and look for new ways to improve our services through innovation.


We are also committed to sustainability, with an ambition to become a Net Zero business by 2030\. We believe everyone can make a meaningful impact through small, positive changes.


Our values are simple but powerful:

**Fairness. Smart. Sustainability.**


Our employees and customers come from all walks of life. We are committed to championing diversity, creating an inclusive culture and providing an environment where you can be your authentic self.


Utilita is part of the Luxion group whichcomprises Luxion Group Ltd, Utilita Energy Ltd, Luxion Sales Ltd, Utilita Field Services Ltd, Procode Technology Ltd and Canary Care Global Ltd.

new_jobs.title: Backend & DevOps-konsult (direktuppdrag) - Kollarna.se
new_jobs.description:
På Doktor.se definierar vi om det svenska sjukvårdssystemet genom att göra det mer tillgängligt, smidigt och effektivt, utan att kompromissa med kvalitet eller säkerhet. Vår hybridmodell, som kombinerar fysiska vårdcentraler med moderna digitala lösningar, har gjort oss till den största digitala vårdgivaren i Sverige, med miljontals konsultationer varje år.

### **Om uppdraget**


Vi söker en erfaren Backend\- och DevOps\-konsult för ett uppdrag hos Kollarna.se, en tjänst som erbjuds av Doktor.se:s dotterbolag Doktor24\.se. Vi vill arbeta direkt med dig som konsult, utan mellanhänder.


Uppdraget syftar till att stärka och modernisera Kollarnas infrastruktur i Azure, med fokus på säkerhet, skalbarhet och automatisering. Du arbetar i nära samarbete med Kollarnas utvecklingsteam och driver dina leveranser självständigt mot överenskomna mål.

### **Vad uppdraget innebär**


Uppdraget omfattar följande leveranser:

* Genomlysning av nuvarande Azure\-miljö och säkerhetsläge, med prioriterade åtgärdsförslag.
* Införande av infrastructure as code för befintliga tjänster.
* Översyn och förenkling av CI/CD\-pipelines i GitHub Actions.
* Uppsättning av monitorering och larm, samt översyn av skalbarhet, t.ex. databaser och cachning (Redis).
* Rådgivning i design\- och arkitekturfrågor som rör leveranserna ovan.
* Dokumentation och överlämning till teamet vid uppdragets slut.

### **Vem vi söker**


Du har gärna 5 år eller mer som backendutvecklare med erfarenhet av DevOps, som infrastrukturingenjör eller i liknande roll, framför allt i Azure\-miljöer (erfarenhet av AWS är meriterande). Kollarnas backend är skriven i C\# .NET och frontend i TypeScript/React. Erfarenhet av TypeScript och/eller Python är meriterande.


Du kan drifta Azure\-tjänster med hjälp av exempelvis GitHub Actions, har god erfarenhet av databaser och SQL, framför allt MS SQL, och vet hur man bäst utnyttjar Azure\-tjänster och sätter upp exempelvis Redis. Du har erfarenhet av att sätta upp och underhålla monitorering, tänker säkerhet först och har gedigen kunskap om hur man skyddar infrastruktur mot intrång.


Du är van att driva uppdrag självständigt och leverera mot överenskomna mål, samarbetar gärna och har erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt. Du talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska.

### **Varför uppdraget är intressant**


Kollarna är en tjänst som hjälper människor varje dag, och infrastrukturen bakom den behöver vara säker, stabil och skalbar. Här får du ett tydligt avgränsat uppdrag med verklig effekt, stort mandat inom ditt område och ett engagerat team att samarbeta med.

### **Uppdragsvillkor**

**Uppdragsform:** Direktuppdrag. Du fakturerar via eget bolag med F\-skatt, helst aktiebolag.

**Uppdragslängd:** Enligt överenskommelse.

**Omfattning:** 40 timmar per vecka.

**Start:** Så snart som möjligt. Vi tar hänsyn till eventuella pågående uppdrag.

**Arbetsplats:** Uppdraget utförs delvis på plats i Göteborg (Första Långgatan 18\) för samarbete och avstämningar, enligt överenskommelse.

**Ersättning:** Enligt överenskommelse. Ange gärna ditt timpris i ansökan.

**Övrigt:** Uppdraget kan kombineras med andra uppdrag, så länge det inte innebär en intressekonflikt.

### **Var med och gör skillnad i vården!**


Som en del av vår urvalsprocess genomför vi ID\-kontroll och begär utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Vi söker konsulter som vill arbeta direkt med oss och ber därför vänligt men bestämt att konsultmäklare, konsultbolag och rekryteringsföretag avstår från att kontakta oss.
